MotionMate is a very simple and lightweight step counter app for Android that tracks your daily steps and displays the results by selecting a specific day from the calendar view and presents the values in a nice weekly bar chart as well as some other statistics.

izzyondroid:de.synyx.android.meetingroom.name: MeeRoo
izzyondroid:de.synyx.android.meetingroom.description:
MeeRoo is an Android app to manage reservations for meeting rooms.
 Main purpose of this app is to display the availability of an meeting room. It is expected to have one tablet or phone next to the meeting room to see if it is available, see the current and upcoming meetings and reserve the room now or in the future. There is an overview for all meeting rooms, too. This makes it easy to find available rooms or a current meeting very quickly.
 How it works 
 The app reads calendar and event data stored on the device. To get this to work the calendars must be configured in the android calendar on the device. On the first start of the app you have to choose the calendar mode (for synchronization). This is necessary, because Google Calendar marks meeting rooms as resources. With CalDav synchronised calendars are storing every calendar as normal calendars, no difference between a personal calendar and a meeting room (resource).
 Supported calendar synchronizations 
 Google Calendar
 CalDav Calendar

izzyondroid:org.breezyweather.description:
Breezy Weather is a feature-rich free and open source Material 3 Expressive weather app with well-thought-out visualizations, supporting forecast, real-time weather conditions, nowcasting, air quality, pollen, alerts, from more than 50 weather sources, such as NWS, Met Office UK, Met Éireann, ECCC and Open-Meteo.
 Features

 Precipitation in the next hour
 Real-time weather conditions
 Air quality, allergen and ephemeris information
 Severe weather and precipitation alerts
 Opt-in data sharing with other apps (such as Gadgetbridge)
 Focus on accessibility for screen readers and other locales
 Design 
 Material 3 Expressive
 Detailed 24-hour charts
 Automatic dark mode
 Custom icon packs
 Large selection of widgets
 Live wallpaper
 Sources 
 In all flavors: Open-Meteo, ANAM-BF, Bright Sky (DWD), DCCMS, DMN, DWR, EMI, FOSS Public Alert Server, GMet, IGEBU, INM, KNMI, Mali-Météo, Météo Benin, Météo Tchad, Météo Togo, Mettelsat, MSD, Pirate Weather, SMA (Seychelles), SMA (Sudan), SSMS
 Not libre/self-hostable (not included in versions with suffix _freenet): AccuWeather, AEMET, Atmo Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Atmo France, ATMO GrandEst, Atmo Hauts-de-France, AtmoSud, Baidu IP location, BMD, BMKG, CWA, DMI, ECCC, EKUK, EPD (Hong Kong), GeoNames, GeoSphere AT, HERE, HKO, Ilmateenistus, IMD, IMS, IP.SB, IPMA, LHMT, LVĢMC, JMA, MET Éireann, MET Norway, Met Office UK, Meteo AM, Météo-France, MeteoLux, MGM, Mixed China sources, NAMEM, NCDR, NCEI, NLSC, NWS, OpenWeather, PAGASA, SMG, Veðurstofa Íslands, WMO Severe Weather
 Permissions 
 Required:
 Network (ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE, INTERNET): fetch weather data from sources over the Internet
 Optional:
 Background services (RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, WAKE_LOCK, SET_ALARM, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE): weather updates in the background and scheduled forecast notifications

 Storage (READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE): helps setting the live weather wallpaper and/or widgets on some devices

izzyondroid:ski.wischnew.shield.name: SMS Shield
izzyondroid:ski.wischnew.shield.summary: Rule-based SMS filtering with block lists, archive, and OTP tools
izzyondroid:ski.wischnew.shield.description:
SMS Shield is a default SMS app focused on private, rule-based message filtering.
 It supports keyword, sender, number, wildcard, and country-based block and allow rules, including Unicode and non-ASCII SMS content. Blocked messages are suppressed from regular notifications and kept in a dedicated blocked folder.
 Messages can be searched, archived, returned to the inbox, deleted, grouped into chats, filtered by sent or received status, and marked to skip automatic archiving. Manual block overrides help recover false positives without changing the whole rule set.
 The app also includes OTP copy support, local JSON import and export, dual-SIM send options, SIM indicators, delivery reports, and light, dark, and AMOLED themes with selectable accent colors.
 SMS Shield does not use any web services or data connectivity at all. No cloud spam detection, no advertising SDKs, no analytics SDKs, no Firebase, no Google Play Services, no AI services. Pure rule-based on-device handling.

izzyondroid:top.donmor.droidfrpd.name: DroidFRPD
izzyondroid:top.donmor.droidfrpd.description:
This is an Android FRP daemon manager based on fatedier/frp project.
 frp is a fast reverse proxy that allows you to expose a local server located behind a NAT or firewall to the Internet. It currently supports TCP and UDP, as well as HTTP and HTTPS protocols, enabling requests to be forwarded to internal services via domain name.
 frp also offers a P2P connect mode.
 Configurations
 Manage configuration files
 Aside of internal configuration editor, the configuration files can be managed via Files app or SAF-compliant apps.
 Start daemon on device boot
 You may have to grant start on boot permission manually.
 Ignore battery optimization
 There's an option in Settings that jumps to system battery optimization setting page.
 Remove activity from recents
 If enabled, DroidFRPD will be removed from Recent Activities, preventing it from being killed unexpectedly.
 Note: Some Malware scanners might mark this app as ELF:Agent-BIQ or something else, this usually does not mean the app is malicious. You can check the code of FRP and this project, and check if the apk is reproducible.

fdroid:com.crest247.flickarraykeyboard.summary: 本輸入法的核心主打為Flick行列輸入模式，透過flick的方式拖曳按鍵，在手機上提供更好按的行列30輸入體驗。
fdroid:com.crest247.flickarraykeyboard.description:
Flick行列輸入法 是一個 100% 使用 Kotlin 與 Jetpack Compose 開發的現代化Android輸入法。
靈感源自於 Flick日語輸入法 以及 行列10 輸入法。行列10輸入法雖然按鍵少，但是每個字拆解出來的字根碼數量，很多都比行列30多了很多，而行列30的字根碼帶有上(^)、中(-)、下(v)的元素，正好也能對應成flick拖曳的方向，因而設計出了這一款輸入法。
 核心特色 Flick行列模式 ：創新的 行列30 輸入方式，為本專案的核心主軸，將行列30傳統字根中的上、中、下元素，直覺地映射至觸控螢幕的flick拖曳操作。專為手機窄螢幕配置設計。
 特殊功能鍵與D-Pad ： D-Pad ：在數個輸入模式中皆可單獨使用，提供拖曳實現游標移動的功能。
 特殊功能鍵 ：此功能僅在 Flick行列 模式中實作。使用者可以透過向下拖曳不放，或向上拖曳不放，來分別觸發 Ctrl 或 Shift 狀態。而D-Pad鍵會與特殊功能鍵產生交互作用，進而實現全選、複製、貼上、復原、重做，以及選取上下行或前後字元等進階文字編輯功能，免去觸控螢幕長按選取文字的繁瑣操作。
 Flick語言切換鍵 ：語言切換鍵使用flick的方式，能夠一步直達指定的輸入模式，免去傳統設計需要連續點擊依序切換語言或需要設計多個不同的按鍵。
 輸入模式 Flick行列 ：字根碼與行列30相同，可以 點擊數字鍵輸入「-」 、 向上拖曳數字鍵輸入「^」 、 向下拖曳數字鍵輸入「v」 ，來輸入行列30的字根碼。
 行列30 ：標準的行列30輸入方式。
 英文 ：一般的英文鍵盤，雙擊⇧可以鎖定大寫。
 數字 ：提供0~9以及多種符號可供輸入。
 符號 ：提供多種常用符號、箭頭符號、數學符號以及希臘字母。
 Emoji ：提供各式各樣的Emoji，並且可以透過flick的方式選擇膚色。

fdroid:com.fixupxer.name: FixupXer - URL Enhancer
fdroid:com.fixupxer.summary: Clean tracking, choose link frontends, and spot sensitive data in URLs
fdroid:com.fixupxer.description:
FixupXer removes tracking from URLs before you copy, share, or open them. Processing runs entirely on your device, with no ads, account, analytics, or Android permissions.
 Clean and improve links 
• Remove known tracking parameters from YouTube, Instagram, X, TikTok, Facebook, Amazon, Google, Reddit, and many other services. A universal cleaner covers other websites.
• Keep unknown and functional parameters by default. Instagram post/Reel links keep a valid carousel image selector; individual Story permalinks lose query parameters and fragments. Complete X post links remove changing share tags while retaining supported options and media path selection.
• Unwrap supported redirect links entirely offline.
• Optionally convert links to embed-friendly frontends for chat previews or readers that can display public content without an account. Choose built-in options or add custom domains in Settings.
 Use it your way 
• Share a URL to FixupXer, paste it into the app, or select text and choose "Clean link" where the source app supports it.
• Choose the next action: open in an app or browser, share, or copy.
• Shared links show the result by default. Opt in to Skip result screen & share to go straight to Android's share menu with the cleaned link; choose the recipient yourself. Link Guard warnings, incomplete processing or errors stay for review.
• Optional Auto-copy shared links starts off. It copies before the sharesheet when both options are on, and pauses for Link Guard findings or incomplete processing.
• Enable Browser Mode in Settings and select FixupXer as Android's default browser to process eligible links automatically. Verified App Links may bypass it.
• Keep Browser frontend choices separate from Main/Share choices. Remember a preferred browser or an app choice for a website host.
• Native actions restore supported X, Instagram, and TikTok embed links to the original platform. Browser, Share, and Copy keep the processed URL; failed actions offer Retry.
 Private Link Guard 
Get an offline warning when a link still contains credentials, email addresses, auth tokens, or precise coordinates. Review the finding before sharing. Remove a flagged query parameter when available, or go back. Sensitive originals stay out of history and cache; fully cleaned results may be saved as redacted entries when History is on. The guard cannot detect every private value.
 Custom rules and local controls 
• Create optional rules for hosts or URL patterns, with ordered processing phases, templates, and Teach-from-example drafts.
• Preview changes in Test Lab, save per-rule test cases, and import or export rule bundles. Custom rules start disabled.
• Use optional local history with Undo, manual settings and rule backups, and System, Light, or Dark themes.
• Open online Help for setup, examples, and troubleshooting.
 Privacy and third-party services 
FixupXer makes no network requests. Opening or sharing a result hands it to another app or service with its own privacy policy. Optional frontends are independently operated and may change or stop working; conversion can be disabled.
Free and open source under GPL-3.0-or-later.
Visit the official website or the getting started guide .

fdroid:com.iwadjp.wollight.name: WolLight
fdroid:com.iwadjp.wollight.summary: Wake-on-LAN app with device list, LAN scan and stale-IP recovery. LAN-only.
fdroid:com.iwadjp.wollight.description:
WolLight sends Wake-on-LAN magic packets to PCs on the same local network and
keeps a small list of the devices you wake regularly.
Features:
* Wake-on-LAN: sends a standard magic packet as a UDP broadcast on the local
 network, with a configurable port.
* Registered devices: save the devices you wake often with a name, MAC address,
 broadcast address and port. The list is kept on the device.
* LAN scan: detects the current Wi-Fi subnet and probes addresses in parallel to
 list reachable hosts, attempting host-name resolution over NetBIOS and mDNS.
* Online / offline indication: a per-device indicator based on ping results,
 refreshed on app start, on return to the foreground and on manual ping. The
 state only changes after two consecutive matching results, to reduce false
 readings from transient packet loss.
* Ping: sends ten pings at one-second intervals and shows each result plus a
 summary.
* Stale-IP recovery: if a Wake-on-LAN or manual ping fails to reach a registered
 device's saved IP address, WolLight runs one LAN scan and looks for the same
 device by its registered MAC address. If it is found at a different address,
 the saved IP address is updated only after you confirm.
Privacy and network behaviour:
* All traffic stays on the local network. Magic packets, pings and host-name
 resolution (NetBIOS, mDNS, ARP) are local-network only.
* No account, no cloud sync, no external HTTP services.
* No analytics, telemetry or crash reporting.
* Registered device details are stored only in a local database on the device.
Limitations:
* Local network only. Wake-on-LAN uses broadcast packets, so only devices on the
 same LAN can be woken. Waking a PC across the internet needs a separate VPN or
 port-forwarding setup that WolLight does not provide.
* The target PC must already support and be configured for Wake-on-LAN in its
 BIOS/UEFI, network adapter driver and (on Windows) power settings.
* Whether the PC actually wakes depends on that PC's hardware and settings, not
 on WolLight. Waking from full shutdown (S5) in particular depends on the PC,
 its NIC and the OS power configuration.
* UDP is connectionless, so delivery of a magic packet cannot be confirmed. Use
 ping to check whether the PC has come up.
Requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or later and a Wi-Fi connection.

fdroid:com.lenshrv.foss.name: Lens HRV
fdroid:com.lenshrv.foss.summary: Measure heart-rate variability with your phone camera, no extra sensors
fdroid:com.lenshrv.foss.description:
Lens HRV is an Android app that measures heart-rate variability — how much the time between your heartbeats changes from one beat to the next, measured in milliseconds. It uses Photoplethysmography (PPG), a simple optical technique that detects tiny changes in blood flow through your fingertip using only your phone’s camera and flash. Completely non-invasive and requires no extra sensors.
 Why HRV matters 
Heart-rate variability is more than just a heart measurement. The small changes between your heartbeats come from many processes happening in the body at the same time. Your heart does not work alone. It is constantly interacting with the rest of the body — the nervous system, the lungs, hormones, temperature, the immune system, digestion, circadian cycles, emotions and more. HRV works like a microscope that lets us observe that interconnected network.
 What makes Lens HRV different 
Most HRV apps today work like closed boxes. They are usually paid, require expensive extra sensors, and only show you the final numbers they decide to calculate. You rarely get access to the raw signal. Many of them also oversimplify the body’s state into a single score or color.
Lens HRV is completely open source. Every algorithm it uses comes from publicly available, peer-reviewed research. The focus is on classic digital signal processing instead of heavy artificial intelligence. This keeps the app lightweight, understandable, and able to run on a wide range of devices.
All data is processed directly on your phone — nothing is sent to the cloud. You keep full privacy and full control.
The app does not offer “readiness” scores. That kind of metric is considered too complex and often oversimplified. Instead, Lens HRV focuses on clear and simple measurements. The goal is a frictionless tool that is accessible to everyone.
 How it works 
Place your index finger over the camera lens until the preview turns a deep red. A short calibration starts the recording. Keep the finger still. When it ends, the full signal is processed offline. The preset is meant for normal indoor conditions.
 What you get 
Time domain: Heart Rate , RMSSD , SDNN and Stress Index .
Frequency domain: Total Power , LF , HF , LF/HF , LF Peak , respiration rate and Coherence Score .
Each session also shows artifacts and coverage . Below 5% is excellent, below 15% is good, and 15% or more is invalidated.
Each session is compared with a 7-day baseline . Settings can export your data as CSV.
 Disclaimer 
Lens HRV is a technical tool for personal data tracking and analysis. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for any health-related decisions.

fdroid:io.github.lordofpolls.shellwave.name: Shellwave: SSH Client & SFTP
fdroid:io.github.lordofpolls.shellwave.summary: Open-source SSH client and terminal with SFTP, port forwarding and jump hosts
fdroid:io.github.lordofpolls.shellwave.description:
Shellwave is an open-source SSH client and terminal for Android phones, tablets and foldables. Connect to your Linux servers, Raspberry Pi or homelab with SFTP, port forwarding and sessions that survive a dropped connection.
It exists because every mobile SSH client makes you choose between convenient and trustworthy — and that's a stupid choice.
Sessions that survive
Your train goes into a tunnel and the connection drops. When the signal comes back, your session is still there — reconnected without re-typing a password, and with optional tmux-backed sessions, reattached with scrollback intact. You don't do anything. Hosts can also keep a persistent session running, so you can close the app and come back to exactly where you left off.
Nothing is trusted for you
Host keys are checked the first time you connect and remembered after that, with the fingerprint shown so you can check it yourself. If a host key ever changes, Shellwave stops you before you go any further. There is no accept-all mode, and a script running from a widget or a tile never answers a prompt on your behalf.
Your keys stay on your device
Password, an imported private key, a key generated on your device (Ed25519, ECDSA or RSA), OpenSSH certificates, or keyboard-interactive/2FA — whatever you already use. Everything is encrypted on-device, with hardware-backed protection on phones that support it, and an optional biometric lock. You can generate a key on the device and install it in a host's authorized_keys without the private key ever leaving the phone.
Save yourself the typing
Save commands or scripts against a host, with parameters you fill in when you run them. Watch them run live, run them in the background and check back later, or fire them into a session you already have open. You can launch a script from the app itself, a home-screen widget, an app shortcut, or a Quick Settings tile. The same widget and tile can wake a sleeping machine with Wake-on-LAN.
Networking, done properly
- Local and remote port forwarding
- A SOCKS5 proxy
- Jump host/bastion chaining through multiple hops
- Import your existing ~/.ssh/config as-is — hosts, ports, users, keys, jump hosts, Match blocks
Forwarded ports and the proxy bind to loopback unless you say otherwise.
File transfer
Browse a host's files over SFTP from inside a session: upload, download, rename and delete without switching apps.
A real terminal
256 colours, wide character support, correct cursor and scroll handling. If you use vim, tmux, or htop, they will look and behave the way you expect. No weird redraws, no broken keys, no compromises. Search the scrollback, log a session to a file, and the visible screen is readable by TalkBack.
Built with foldables in mind
On unfolded or wide screens you get a two-pane layout, host list next to the terminal. Tabletop mode keeps the terminal above the hinge and the keyboard below it. Fold or unfold mid-session and nothing drops.
Make it look like yours
A handful of bundled monospace fonts, or bring your own. Colour schemes like Solarized, Gruvbox, Nord, Dracula, Tango and Campbell, plus a full editor if you want to build your own. A key bar you can customise per host with macros and layouts. Material You colour throughout.
Privacy
No usage data, no analytics, no crash reporting. Shellwave only connects to the hosts you tell it to — nothing else.
The Play Store build has an optional one-time tip for the developer. It does not unlock anything, and the F-Droid build leaves it out entirely.
Open source, GNU GPLv3.

gnome-extensions:NetworkSpeed@m0hithredd.name: Network Speed
gnome-extensions:NetworkSpeed@m0hithredd.summary:
Highly customizable Network Speed Monitor.
Quick install: 
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -sL https://git.io/JkFoh)"
What's in this extension:
* Preference Menu to customize the extension.
* Five configurable network speed modes.
 1. Total net speed in [g, m, k]b/s.
 2. Total net speed in [G, M, K]B/s.
 3. Up and down the speed in [g, m, k]b/s.
 4. Up and down the speed in [G, M, K]B/s.
 5. Total Downloaded in [G, M, K]B.
* Extension color can be customizable.
* Option to show upload speed first in modes 3 and 4.
* Align the extension horizontally or vertically.
* Different font sizes.
* Option to autohide the extension, when idle.
Mouse click events on the extension:
* Left click: Cycle through the modes.
* Right-click in the first four modes: Toggle the visibility of total downloaded.
* Right-click in the fifth mode: Reset total downloaded.
* Four consecutive right-clicks: Toggle the horizontal/vertical alignment.
* Middle click: Cycle through the font sizes.
Thanks to bijignome of creating the extension. Special thanks to prateekmedia for giving rebirth to the extension.
What I added:
* Revamping the whole codebase to create a roadmap for many feature additions.
* Color customizations, Upload speed first, AutoHide.
* Adopted Make build system to manage the extension (for developers).
* Quick install method.

bluejetty:00131413:ios.description:
Rakuten Viber is a secure, fun, and exciting messaging and calling app, connecting over a billion people worldwide!
You can do it all with Rakuten Viber: group chats, disappearing messages, reminders, and more:
Send messages for free
Staying in touch has never been easier. Send a free text, photo, sticker, GIF, voice or video message, along with many other types of files.
Make free audio and video calls
Enjoy unlimited Viber-to-Viber calls to anyone in the world for free. You can even call up to 60 people at the same time! Great for connecting with friends, family, and colleagues :)
Experience end-to-end encryption
On by default for all 1-on-1 calls, chats, and group chats, end-to-end encryption allows to you to communicate with confidence knowing that all messages will remain private. No one, not even Rakuten Viber, can read your messages.
Make low-cost calls to landlines with Viber Out
Call any landline or mobile phone with Viber Out’s low-cost international calling service. Get a Viber Out subscription to call a specific destination or keep your options open and buy minutes to call anywhere in the world. 
Open a group chat
Catch up with friends, family, and colleagues by opening a group chat for up to 250 members. Use polls and quizzes, @mentions and reactions to get the most out of your group!
Express yourself with lenses, GIFs, and stickers
Personalize your chats! Get creative with fun, funny, and beautifying Viber lenses. GIFs and over 55,000 stickers also await you - you can even create your own.
Use disappearing messages
Send disappearing messages in your 1-on-1 and group chats by setting a timer for each message. You can choose how long the message will be available after it’s opened - 10 seconds, 1 minute, or up to 1 day!
Connect in Communities and Channels
Whether it's sports, news, cooking, travel or entertainment, get the content you really want and connect with others with similar interests. You can even start your own Community or Channel and gain a global following. 
Chat with AI bots
Rakuten Viber's AI bots will answer all your questions and turn your words into beautiful art. You can also find verified bots to get the latest news on fashion, book your travel, and even pay your electricity bills!
React to messages
React to messages with emojis to express exactly how you feel in chats!
Create notes and reminders
Forward interesting messages, keep meaningful links, and add your thoughts to your notes. You can also set reminders to ensure you never forget important tasks and events. 
Rakuten Viber is part of the Rakuten Group, a world leader in e-commerce and financial services. 
Terms & Policies: https://www.viber.com/terms/

bluejetty:00014534:ios.description:
Orange Flex is like two apps in one: choose the full mobile phone Plan and transfer your number in the app or get Orange Flex Travel, i.e. an eSIM with Internet abroad. Just like that!
ORANGE FLEX IS YOUR SUBSCRIPTION NUMBER
This option is more flexible than a standard subscription and easier than a prepaid plan. Transfer your number conveniently in the app and switch plans freely – without waiting till the end of the contract as there are no long-term contracts in the Orange Flex subscription. And what do you get? Unlimited data and calls, 5G, eSIM, multiSIM, stress-free roaming… and much more.
FLEX OR FLEX TRAVEL? CHOOSE YOUR ACCOUNT VERSION
Create an Orange Flex account to get a full mobile service you can manage all by yourself in the app. Or create an Orange Flex Travel account if you only need good roaming without changing your operator. Get an eSIM with Internet abroad to be fully free, travel with convenience and control your costs. You’ll love it!
WITH ORANGE FLEX YOU GET:
EASE OF USE. Just sign up, transfer your number or add a new one, and then activate an eSIM or order a regular SIM card – all using the app in the comfort of your home with no calls required.
LOTS OF EVERYTHING. You get unlimited calls, SMS and MMS in Poland and roaming in the EU. Plus a big or huge data package!
AND MORE. Still not enough? Orange Flex offers you unlimited Internet. Get a package for 7/30 days or a fixed Plan. Perfect for digital ninjas, for whom Internet = air. You can add up to 3 SIM or eSIM cards to your Plan for free. After all, it’s cool to have an extra SIM for your other phone, smartwatch, tablet or router.
FLEXIBILITY. You can upgrade, downgrade, activate or deactivate your monthly Plan – whatever you want with no extra charge. Set up everything at once and enjoy a monthly subscription or choose differently every month – that’s cool too. And if you prefer long-term commitments, annual subscription is your perfect choice. Unused data? Keep it in the Data Safe! And withdraw data whenever you need.
EVERYTHING UNDER CONTROL. Link your card and forget about transfers and top-ups. You prefer another way? We also have BLIK and ApplePay. You’ll know what you pay for in advance and you can track your data usage in real-time.
ROAMING? THAT’S ALSO UNDER CONTROL. A city break in the EU? Check your remaining data allowance with ease and buy an extra roaming package in the app. Holidays outside the EU? Get the inexpensive Here and There Package or the British Package and surf the web how you want it. Pay for data in advance and don’t stress about your bill after holidays.
SPEED AND 5G. Each plan includes innovative 5G, which is like broadband but without the cable. Fast, stable, reliable. Pick an eSIM and join us digitally in seconds without waiting for the delivery. Got a regular SIM? No worries, we’ll manage!
THE OPTION TO SHARE GIGABYTES. The mobile offer in the app provides endless possibilities and that’s why Orange Flex lets you share unused data with friends. Help another Flex user with data and make their day. Or receive such a gift yourself.
24/7 SUPPORT. The Flex app is super easy and intuitive, but if you need help, our handy chat is available 24/7.
BONUSES. Join the Flex Club and get discounts for products and services from Orange Flex partners.
ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION. Last but not least. Flex uses wind energy, doesn’t use paper and reduces plastic use. Furthermore, we have planted and are protecting biodiverse forests in Poland.
WITH ORANGE FLEX TRAVEL YOU GET:

bluejetty:00159566:ios.description:
Affordable, Accessible Transit Service, Your Way!
METRO Connect is Rock Region METRO’s on-demand microtransit service.
WHY MICROTRANSIT?
For certain service areas, including areas of emerging or low transit demand, microtransit does a better job of meeting transit demand than a full-size bus operating on a fixed route. Microtransit allows Rock Region METRO to provide on-demand, shared transit rides using smaller vehicles within a set zone, during regular operating hours, via its METRO Connect on-demand service.
BENEFITS TO RIDERS
METRO Connect offers:
• POINT-TO-POINT SERVICE: METRO Connect on-demand microtransit service takes riders from a point within the zone to any other point within the zone.
• AFFORDABLE FARES: A METRO Connect trip is more affordable than trips using traditional Transportation Network Companies, as METRO Connect is part of the Rock Region METRO publicly funded public transit service.
• NEW PLACES: METRO Connect access central Arkansas destinations that have not previously been served by non-paratransit public transit service.
HOW TO USE METRO CONNECT MICROTRANSIT SERVICE
Download the METRO Connect app to schedule ride-hailing trips occurring within a set microtransit zone, during regular METRO Connect zone operating hours (hours vary per zone). Each zone allows riders to travel from point-to-point within the zone to access destinations, including additional METRO transit service, such as fixed bus routes. Find METRO Connect microtransit zone maps, zone hours of operations and connecting fixed routes at rrmetro.org. Standard METRO fares apply.

bluejetty:00015419:ios.name: LP Ancient Greek
bluejetty:00015419:ios.summary: One of the challenges of studying Ancient Greek is to memorise its unfamiliar vocabulary, and the many forms each word can take. The most reliable way to learn this material is by constant practice, which is where Liberation Philology Ancie
bluejetty:00015419:ios.description:
One of the challenges of studying Ancient Greek is to memorise its unfamiliar vocabulary, and the many forms each word can take. The most reliable way to learn this material is by constant practice, which is where Liberation Philology Ancient Greek can help.
Wherever you have your phone and a free moment, Liberation Philology Ancient Greek is ready to drill you on Ancient Greek vocabulary and grammar with a continuous multiple-choice test. Your answers are immediately confirmed or corrected, and reinforced through repetition.
• Vocabulary: 110 levels, each testing the translation of 10 words between English and Ancient Greek. Additional sections contain 220 levels of Homeric, 210 levels of New Testament vocabulary, and 110 levels based on Plato’s Apology. Interspersed among these are cumulative levels reviewing what has been learned earlier (giving a total of 733 levels).
• Nouns: Tests your ability to parse and decline all classes of Ancient Greek nouns.
• Adjectives & Pronouns: Tests your ability to parse and decline all classes of Ancient Greek adjectives & demonstrative pronouns.
• Verbs: Tests your ability to parse and conjugate a range of paradigmatic Ancient Greek verbs.
• Participles: Tests your ability to recognise and decline Ancient Greek participles.
A further Reference module allows you to review the vocabulary word-list and paradigms. Beginning students also have the option of displaying Greek text in transliteration.

bluejetty:00114930:ios.description:
Rhyme - Itinerary Planner
Build Trips From Travel Reels
Thousands of travel videos saved across your Instagram and TikTok… and zero time to turn them into a plan? You can’t search those folders, you keep rewatching clips to find the exact spot, pinning places on Google Maps takes forever, and spreadsheets don’t tell you how far anything is. We get it. Trip planning from scratch is painful—and your saved folder is begging to be used.
Rhyme fixes the mess. With one tap, pull every location mentioned in a video, drop them onto a map, and see your entire collection of spots—clearly, visually, and all in one place. When you’re ready to go, just tell Rhyme how many days you have. We’ll build a sensible, day-by-day itinerary that connects the dots for you. Trip planning, minus the stress.
Who Rhyme is for
- You’ve got dozens of folders and thousands of saved travel posts across Instagram and TikTok.
- You love picking the spots—but hate the logistics.
- You want everything in one place: your saved locations, a clean map, and a plan that actually fits your days.
How it works
- 1-tap save from socials: Import places from TikTok/Instagram with a single click. Rhyme detects locations mentioned in the video and adds them for you.
- See everything on a map: No more scattered folders or notes. Your saved spots appear on a clean map so you can visualize your trip at a glance.
- Your master collection: Keep every restaurant, landmark, café, and hidden gem in one organized list—with links back to the original posts and reviews.
- Get your perfect itinerary: Tell Rhyme your trip length and we’ll arrange your days into a logical route so you’re not zig-zagging across town.
- Duplicate & share trips: Copy community guides or friends’ itineraries and customize them to your style—or share your own with a link.
- Review & go: Tap any spot for details, tips, and prep notes so you know exactly why it’s on your list.
Why people love it
- Turns chaos into clarity: Your social saves become a visual, actionable plan.
- Saves hours: Stop rewatching videos and manually pinning.
- Keeps your taste: It’s your collection—Rhyme just organizes it and makes it trip-ready.
- Stress-free planning: From “I saved it” to “I’m going” in a few taps.
Privacy Policy: https://www.rhyme.travel/privacy
Terms Of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00025359:ios.description:
Introducing the Visual Code Editor for iOS, the ultimate solution for coding on-the-go. This powerful app is designed to provide you with a seamless coding experience that is both efficient and convenient.
The Visual Code Editor features a sleek and intuitive user interface that allows you to easily create, edit and manage your code. The app provides support for multiple programming languages, including Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and many more, so you can work on projects across a wide range of coding languages.
With the app's advanced suggestion and highlighting features, coding becomes even easier. The app's intelligent code completion system provides suggestions for code snippets as you type, while its syntax highlighting feature highlights syntax errors and other important code elements, making it easy to spot issues and correct them quickly.
The Visual Code Editor also offers a wide range of customization options, allowing you to choose your preferred color scheme and font size, making it easier to work on your code for extended periods of time.
With the ability to work with multiple files simultaneously, the Visual Code Editor is perfect for working on complex projects that involve multiple files and directories. You can easily switch between files, preview your code, and share your work with others, all from within the app.
Overall, the Visual Code Editor is an essential tool for any developer looking to code on-the-go. With its advanced features, multiple language support, and intuitive interface, coding has never been easier or more convenient. Try it out today and take your coding experience to the next level!
After a 3-day free trial, a subscription unlocks the complete experience:
- Editor customization
- Beautiful themes
- Complete Python guidebook

bluejetty:00062349:ios.description:
Simple and Useful Picture Card Scheduler.
You can easily create your To-Do List.
It is important to visualize your tasks as to work on them in order. With this app, you can easily create your task list by simply arranging the picture cards. All picture cards support voice sounds. In addition, you can create your original picture cards with your own picture and voice recording.
This app is developed from the needs of teachers and parents of children who attend LITALICO classrooms. It’s been hard to either create or carry a scheduler, but now with this app, you can use it anywhere at anytime. It motivates children by the function unique to digital, such as tapping stars and/or collecting cute fish when you finish a task…etc.
* LITALICO classrooms are run by teachers and professors who specialize in kids' development and education.
Characteristics of this app:
- 100 types of cards for everyday use.
- The app supports multiple languages.
- You can also create original cards with your own pictures and voice recordings.
- All picture cards support voice sounds.
- You can specify a time on each task.
- Tap the stars when you finish your tasks!
- Let's collect cute fish by finishing your tasks!

Do you know what your money is doing?
As a values-based financial co-operative, Vancity is committed to transforming how banking is done so we can help our members and their local communities thrive financially, socially and environmentally
bluejetty:00013521:android.description:
Do you know what your money is doing?
As a values-based financial co-operative, Vancity is committed to transforming how banking is done so we can help our members and their local communities thrive financially, socially and environmentally. 
Our full-service mobile banking app allows you to:
See balances instantly with QuickView
Check your account balances without logging in.
Deposit cheques on the go
With Vancity Mobile Deposit, you save time by avoiding a trip to the ATM.
Find the nearest ding-free® ATM or Vancity community branch
Your MEMBER CARD® provides you with ding-free access to over 4,000 ATMs Canada-wide including all credit union ATMs. Locate one of our community branches in the app. 
Find a transaction using easy search filters
With the improved account activity filter, searching for transactions is easier and more precise. Use date ranges or filter transactions by amount or type (like cheques or bill payments).
Get a Fair & Fast Loan™ in less than 10 minutes
Unexpected expenses can happen to any of us. We may be able to help you get back on your feet with $100-$2,500 in your account, in as little as 10 minutes. No fees, no hassle.
Pay your bills and add new payees on the go
Pay your bills easily and on time by scheduling in advance. Manage your bill payees from within the app.
Request, send and receive funds with INTERAC e-Transfers®
No need to run to the ATM to pay back a friend. It can all be done through INTERAC e-Transfers.¬
Messaging and Alerts
Messages and epost™ mail can be accessed through their icons. Financial reminders are accessible under Alerts and displayed under the Received tab.
Safety & Security
We’re committed to keeping your personal and financial information safe and protecting your security no matter how you choose to bank with us. For us, “security” means safeguarding your personal and financial information and working with you to prevent fraud, theft and other scams that could lead to losses for both you and your credit union.

bluejetty:00146269:ios.description:
Get ready to embark on a challenging and relaxing puzzle-solving journey with Super Dots, the ultimate dots-matching and connecting game!
Connect the Dots: In Super Dots, your mission is simple yet incredibly engaging - connect more than two dots of the same color to create colorful, dazzling pathways. Each level presents you with a unique grid of multicolored dots, and it's your task to draw lines to match and collect them. The more dots you connect, the closer you get to mastering the challenging levels! Use our unique booster system to blast through the levels even faster.
Features:
Challenging Puzzles - Super Dots offers a wide range of meticulously crafted puzzles that will test your matching and connecting skills to the limit. From basic dot matching to complex formations, each level presents a fresh challenge that will keep your brain engaged and helps you to relax.
Strategic Gameplay - Super Dots requires strategy and careful planning. You'll need to think ahead and make wise decisions to connect the dots efficiently and achieve your goals. With every move, you'll feel the thrill of strategy paying off.
Vivid Graphics and Mesmerising Sound - Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant colors and eye-catching graphics as you navigate through the game. Super Dots features stunning visual effects and captivating soundtracks that enhance your gaming experience.
Collect and Master - Your ultimate goal in Super Dots is to collect as many dots as possible and master each level with the highest scores. As you progress, you'll discover power-ups, bonuses, and surprises that add a new layer of excitement to the game. The possibilities are without limit – Collect em all!
Endless Fun - With hundreds of levels to explore, Super Dots guarantees endless hours of fun and entertainment. The game's difficulty gradually increases, ensuring that players of all skill levels can enjoy the challenge.
Social Features - Connect with your friends and compete to see who can master the most challenging levels. Share your accomplishments and challenge others to beat your high scores in thrilling leagues to gain the best rewards.
Relaxing and Addictive - Super Dots strikes the perfect balance between relaxation and addiction. Whether you want to unwind after a long day or challenge yourself to conquer complex puzzles, this game offers it all.
Train Your Brain - With its strategic gameplay and intricate puzzles, Super Dots is not just about connecting dots but also a fantastic way to exercise your brain and improve your problem-solving skills.
Don't miss out on the Super Dots-connecting craze! Download Super Dots now and experience the ultimate dots-matching adventure. Connect, collect, and master the art of puzzle-solving in this addictive and challenging game. Whether you're a casual gamer or a seasoned pro, Super Dots has something to offer for everyone. Get ready to embark on a thrilling journey of connecting, collecting, and matching – one dot at a time! 
Remember, every dot counts. Can you connect em all? Download Super Dots today and find out!
Questions about the game? Ask our support team: sd-support@happy-games.net
Please note Super Dots – Brain Puzzle is a free-to-play experience; however, some in-game items can be purchased with real money. A network connection is required to play. For further details, please refer to our comprehensive terms of service.

bluejetty:00164329:android.description:
With the ad-free RegenRadar Pro from WetterOnline you can see when rain is coming!
Top functions of the RegenRadar App Pro:
• Current rain radar for Germany, Austria and Switzerland
• Radar film for rain 90 minutes into the future and past
• Automatic location determination
• Personal weather favorites
• Detailed map display
• Weather widget
RainRadar Pro:
See if it rains! The app with the precipitation radar detects where you are and marks your location. With the RainRadar you can see at a glance whether it will rain or whether it will stay dry.
Track rainfall for the past 90 minutes and the forecast for the next 90 minutes with the ad-free RegenRadar Pro app. Whether it's a bike ride after work or a short walk with the dog, use the precipitation radar to plan your outdoor leisure activities and see if you need to pack rain gear.
Weather Widget:
The RegenRadar Pro app has a weather widget. In order to use this, the app must be installed in the phone's memory due to the Android operating system's requirements. The 2x2 widget can be freely scaled (from Android 4.2). You can also choose between two zoom levels. With this widget you can see at a glance where it will rain without opening the app.
Even more weather with WetterOnline:
Know what the weather will be like! More than a precipitation radar! We offer even higher resolution as well as cloud, snow and lightning information with the WeatherRadar in the WetterOnline app for Europe and worldwide.
The weather forecast and other information about the weather can also be accessed directly via the app. To do this, simply press the “Weather” button in the settings menu and you will be redirected to our WetterOnline app. If you do not have this app installed on your device, our mobile offer will be accessed.
New features:
• Zoom further into the weather radar
• Weather radar in 5 minute increments
Permissions:
The permissions enable the app to offer the following:
• Location: Determine the location for a local weather forecast
• Photos / Media / Files: Save screenshots and weather photos
• WiFi connection information: Detect possible download speed
• Other: Load data from our servers
The app was developed entirely by WetterOnline. Please send your questions and suggestions to info@wetteronline.de.

bluejetty:00014985:ios.description:
'Animal Jigsaw Puzzle' is a lovely animal jigsaw which enables even very small children to develop observational skills, visual memory, personal achievement, perseverance, fine motor skills and organisation of shapes in space. 
With three levels of difficulty and 36 jigsaws in each one, the game is ideal for children from eighteen months to ten years of age. Thanks to a total of 108 jigsaws, children will be provided with hours of amusement! 
When you complete a puzzle, you'll hear the animals that appear in each jigsaw making its sound and watch them come to life. 
The game is made up of a total of 108 jigsaws: 36 at easy level (6-piece jigsaws), 36 at medium level (12-piece jigsaws) and 36 at the difficult level (12-piece jigsaws without guiding lines). 
With over 400,000 downloads, this game is bound to be a success among the youngest members of the family!

bluejetty:00117341:android.summary:
An official Shaun The Sheep Movie game from Aardman Animations and Lionsgate.

bluejetty:00117341:android.description:
An official Shaun The Sheep Movie game from Aardman Animations and Lionsgate.
Shaun The Sheep Movie hits the big screen in 2015 and to celebrate Aardman Animations brings you an all-new, action-packed game where only the fastest survive!
Turbo-charge your hooves and get ready for the race of your life! Shear Speed challenges you to lead the Flock through the bustle of the Big City, dodging obstacles and keeping your distance from the dastardly Trumper, an evil animal catcher with the Flock firmly set in his sights. Drop the pace and you could find yourself spending the night in the pound…
Race through a colourful cityscape, jumping, rolling and dodging a variety of hazards along the way, keeping your eyes peeled for the grass you’ll need to munch to keep that boost meter powered up.
Shear Speed is a racing challenge that’s simple to play but tricky to truly master. Are you ready? On your marks, get set, GO!
Immerse Yourself in Shaun’s Movie Universe
Experience real movie environments as you play – the game features unique stop-motion animations and real scenes from Shaun The Sheep Movie.
FREE Fun! Shear Speed is free, with no In-app purchases.
This game allows players to connect to social networks such as Facebook and Twitter to share scores. This connection is not required to progress through the game.
Get Ready for Shaun the Sheep The Movie!
When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets a little more action than he bargained for. A mix up with the Farmer, a caravan, and a very steep hill lead them all to the Big City and it's up to Shaun and the flock to return everyone safely to the green grass of home.

bluejetty:00129030:ios.description:
REALISTIC TOP DOWN RALLYING! 
Rush Rally Origins combines the classic top down racing action from the original Rush Rally with the highly praised graphics and physics from Rush Rally 3. Take on 36 new and unique stages across the world, each with the ability to change the time of day and weather. Drive over many challenging surface types including snow, gravel, dirt, mud and tarmac!
EXPERIENCE THE RUSH
Race at 60fps (120fps on supported devices) with one of the best car dynamics models to date, highly tuned for Rush Rally Origins to give a more fun top down racing experience. Feel the grip change across different surface types and multiple weather conditions.
WORLD RALLY RACING
Compete in a series of rally championships, race against others in our unique A-B Race mode or hold your nerve and focus on improving your times in the time trial game modes.
REACH THE TOP
Smash stage records to rise-up the global online leaderboards. Download ghosts across 4 different car classes to compare your racing lines against the very best in the world.
UPGRADE YOUR CARS
Unlock and upgrade a selection of classic Rush Rally cars. Use our simple upgrade system to tailor each car to your own specific driving style.
OPTIMISED CONTROLS
A control system designed to work with both touch screens and game controllers allows racing to become more fun and consistent however you choose to play. Including the ability to scale, move and swap buttons to suit your needs.

bluejetty:00076912:ios.description:
Optiway Route Planner for Multi-Stop Deliveries
Optiway is the smart multistop Route Planner designed to optimize your delivery routes and build the most efficient routes. Whether you're a delivery driver, courier, field service agent, or a business owner, Optiway Route Planner ensures the fastest, most efficient routes for your deliveries.
Why Choose Optiway Route Planner?
1. Fast & Easy multi-stop Route Planner – Add stops in seconds and get the best optimized multistop delivery route.
2. ETA for Stops – Get real-time estimated arrival times for stops in your multistop Optiway Route Planner.
3. Import Routes from XLSX/TXT files – Easily upload delivery routes from your files directly into your multistop Optiway Route Planner.
4. Export Routes – Share optimized delivery routes with your team or clients.
5. Time Windows & Priority Stops – Set delivery time windows and priority levels for specific stops with your Optiway Route Planner.
6. Works with navigation Apps – Use Google Maps, Apple Maps, Waze, or HERE WeGo with your Optiway Route Planner.
How Optiway Route Planner Helps Delivery Drivers Save up to 30% in Time & Money?
- Avoid Traffic & Delays – Optiway multi-stop delivery route planner maps the fastest paths, so you spend less time on the road.
- Make Last-Minute Changes – Easily adjust your delivery route while on the go.
- Set Priority Stops – Prioritize specific stops in your delivery route to improve efficiency.
- Customize Stop Durations – Set stop times manually in your multi-stop route planner for maximum delivery efficiency.
- Real-Time ETAs & Navigation – Get accurate arrival times for every stop with Optiway route planner.
Who Uses Optiway Route Planner?
1. Delivery Drivers & Couriers – Optimize your delivery route planner to complete more stops in less time.
2. Field Service Agents, – Plan efficient service routes with Optiway route planner.
3. Business Owners – Organize multistop deliveries and client visits with Optiway route planner.
4. Sales, Insurance agents, Cleaning services, Landscapers, Food delivery, Realtors and more others…
"I've tried multiple route planners, but Optiway saves me the most time on deliveries. It's easy to use, fast, and helps me complete my delivery routes more efficiently." – John, USA
Start optimizing your delivery routes today with Optiway Route Planner!
Free vs. Paying Optiway subscription plan
 • Optiway Route Planner Free Plan: Plan delivery routes with up to 5 stops per route, unlimited number of routes.
 • Optiway Route Planner Subscription Plan: Plan delivery routes with up to 200 stops per route, unlimited number of routes. 
The following plans are available for the user: 
Monthly
The pass is valid for 1 month from the date of purchase. 
Annual
The pass is valid for the 1 year from the date of purchase.
The pass auto-renews at the end of the subscription period for the same duration until cancelled.
The pass should be canceled 24 hours before the renewal for the renewal not to take effect.
Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Pricing varies by country, and the exact cost will be displayed before checkout.
Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period. However, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
FAQ:
Can I create multiple routes with Optiway Route Planner?
Absolutely! Optiway Route Planner lets you generate unlimited delivery routes, regardless of whether you’re using the free version or a subscription plan.
Still have questions? Contact our support team directly through Optiway Route Planner: support@optiway-app.com
Privacy policy: https://optiway-app.com/Privacy_Policy/
Terms of use: https://optiway-app.com/terms/

bluejetty:00019564:ios.summary:
The 2025 hunting season is in full swing! Dust off your gun, travel to hunting locations, and observe animals in their natural habitat. Ready to hunt? Let’s play Hunting Clash - a next-generation hunting simulator & shooting game!
Breathta
bluejetty:00019564:ios.description:
The 2025 hunting season is in full swing! Dust off your gun, travel to hunting locations, and observe animals in their natural habitat. Ready to hunt? Let’s play Hunting Clash - a next-generation hunting simulator & shooting game!
Breathtaking shooting areas
Feel like an American marksman hunting in the woods of Montana, in the freezing forest of Kamchatka or go on a hunting safari in Africa! Stunning views and realistic animals like in no other hunting games offline! Feel the thrill of a big game hunter in the free hunting game like never before!
A sniper shooting game on your mobile
Track animals - deer, elk, grizzly bear, wolf, duck or some big American game like a buffalo. Choose an animal, prepare your gun, aim and shoot! Big buck hunter games are a combination of hunting games and sniper games genres. Master your sniper shooting skills like a real American marksman and become a big buck hunter in a top hunting game!
Hunt or be hunted
Precise shooting is crucial for every hunter and marksman. And there are tons of events to participate in every day! You have to show off your animal tracking and sniper skills like in the American sniper games! Hunt for specific wild animals like deer or big buck in locations in Africa, USA, and Canada. Level up and become a big buck hunter marksman!
A weapon of your choice
An American sniper rifle or a bow? Your call. Gun hunting is much more popular than bow hunting, but bow shooting still has admirers amongst old-fashioned American hunters in big buck hunter games - especially on a deer hunt. Whether you prefer an American gun hunting or a bow, there are plenty of upgrades to choose from. Enhance your shooting gear and shoot animals with the deadly sniper precision of a hunting game marksman.
MvM - Marksman vs. Marksman
Who said sniper games are all about solo sport? Big buck hunter games are much more exciting while playing with others! Go deer hunting in a PvP duel facing the other marksman. The call of the wild - it’s what drives you to the top of leaderboards. Especially if you’re capable of hunting some big American game like a buffalo.
Realistic hunting locations
Hunting simulator isn’t only about being a good American sniper. To become a master of big buck hunter and marksman games. You have to pay attention to your surroundings. Hunting Clash offers dozens of real nature-based locations where buck hunters can blend in and wait for their prey. Travel across Africa, Australia, Canada, USA, Poland and many more! Not all sniper games or hunting games can encourage hunters with such a variety of amazing American locations - and not only American! Grab your guns and go for a great sniper games adventure!
Train a hunting dog!
A dog is an American hunter’s best friend. Especially in hunting games where you play as a marksman. Get a dog, train it and gain bonuses for a big buck, deer, and more. With such a trustworthy ally hunting a big game is a real pleasure.
Join a Hunter Club!
Join forces with fellow hunters and together drive your Hunter Club to the top. Share gear and your marksman experience and fulfill Club’s goals. Whether you prefer to hunt solo or try your gun in a PvP hunting duels, gun shooting practice in Hunter Clubs is something for every buck hunter, even an American marksman.
Answer the call of the wild, feel the thrill of a marksman and unite with your gun to hunt animals like a big game hunter. Pick your guns, track animals, collect hunter gear and fight in sniper games. Look no further for other hunting games. Download Hunting Clash now for free and start your adventure with big buck hunter games. Sniper games in 2025 couldn't be better!

[Key Feat
bluejetty:00161073:ios.description:
INTEGRA CONTROL is a nifty app for your smartphone that lets you control your INTEGRA system. Once connected, you can command your system and multiple connected devices quicker and easier than before, from anywhere in the world. 
[Key Features]
- Control the arming status of the entire system or specific partitions
- Run scenarios and let your system devices work together to create the ideal conditions for you
- Quickly access and control connected system devices
- Check the current temperature at your place and adjust it on the go
- Access the stream from selected IP cameras
- Receive status updates about your system
- Enable the app to send critical notifications to make sure you always receive important updates on your system
- Monitor energy consumption of connected devices, and save money by scheduling your devices to run only when needed
- Allow other users to control your system by sharing your unique QR code
- Use the Shortcuts app to add selected app functions to your home screen
- Run your devices or scenarios using your voice
- Build your unique schedules and program your devices to run according to set time
- Command multiple INTEGRA systems through a single app
[Ensuring your safety]
- We use advanced 192-bit encryption to secure the communication between your phone and system
- We don't store any of your personal data
- Secure your app with user-password or biometrics
- Preview our Privacy Policy: https://www.satel.pl/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/Privacy-Policy_INTEGRA-CONTROL_2017-02-28_EN.pdf

bluejetty:00066305:ios.summary:
Rediscover classic Solitaire, beautifully reimagined for iPhone and iPad.
Solitaire Classic brings the timeless Klondike card game you know and love to a polished, modern experience with smooth animations, satisfying card sounds, beautiful
bluejetty:00066305:ios.description:
Rediscover classic Solitaire, beautifully reimagined for iPhone and iPad.
Solitaire Classic brings the timeless Klondike card game you know and love to a polished, modern experience with smooth animations, satisfying card sounds, beautiful backgrounds, and plenty of ways to make the game your own.
Whether you call it Solitaire, Klondike, or Patience, it’s the familiar card game that’s perfect for a quick break, a daily challenge, or a relaxing way to unwind.
PLAY YOUR WAY
• Classic Klondike Solitaire
• Draw 1 or Draw 3 cards
• Standard and Vegas scoring
• Portrait and landscape play
• Unlimited Undo
• Helpful hints
• Auto-complete when a game is ready to finish
• Your game is saved automatically
MAKE THE TABLE YOURS
Choose from beautiful dynamic scenes or traditional static backgrounds, then personalize your game with a variety of card backs.
Dynamic backgrounds bring your table to life with subtle visual effects and relaxing ambience, while classic backgrounds keep things simple and familiar.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
See how your Solitaire skills improve over time with detailed statistics, including:
• Games won and lost
• Win percentage
• Current and best streaks
• Best scores
• Fastest wins
• Fewest moves
• Overall and game-mode statistics
COMPETE WITH GAME CENTER
Compare your performance with other Solitaire players through Game Center leaderboards and achievements. Challenge yourself to improve your score, finish faster, use fewer moves, or build a winning streak.
OPTIONAL COIN MODE
Want something different? Switch to Coin Mode for an optional Vegas-style challenge using virtual coins — or stick with Classic Mode for the traditional Solitaire experience.
A CLASSIC, MADE BETTER
Solitaire Classic has been bringing Klondike Solitaire to Apple devices since 2008. This latest version has been extensively modernized while keeping the simple, familiar gameplay that longtime Solitaire players enjoy.
If you love classic card games, Klondike Solitaire, Patience, Draw 1, Draw 3, or Vegas Solitaire, make Solitaire Classic your everyday card game.
Free to play and supported by advertising.
Privacy Policy: https://winkpass.com/SolitairePrivacyPolicy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00187585:ios.name: Hours and Pay Tracker: TimeLog
bluejetty:00187585:ios.summary:
Hours and Pay Tracker lets you easily track your time and earnings. It is a perfect app for hourly employees, freelancers, or anyone interested in organizing their work in a better way.
The app allows you to record your daily working hours
bluejetty:00187585:ios.description:
Hours and Pay Tracker lets you easily track your time and earnings. It is a perfect app for hourly employees, freelancers, or anyone interested in organizing their work in a better way.
The app allows you to record your daily working hours for each client. You can specify hourly rate for a job, daily and weekly overtime rates, taxes, deductions, pay periods and more. You can clock into multiple jobs simultaneously. Your earnings and hours are calculated automatically. 
The job dashboard lets you easily clock in, clock out and start or end breaks. You can also add manual work entries in case you forgot to start the clock. The app displays all your work entries in a well designed, easy to use, intuitive interface. You can filter your time log by days, weeks, months or jobs.
Export your work entries to CSV or PDF format and send them to your clients. The app lets you customize time format, currency, clock in and clock out reminders, comments for entry and many other options. You can also lock the app and keep your data safe by enabling password protection. 
Features:
- Simple and easy to use interface
- Clock in, clock out, breaks
- Manual time entry
- Daily and weekly overtimes
- Custom pay periods
- Export time log to CSV or PDF
- Reminders
- iCloud backup and restore
- Reports by days, weeks, months and jobs
- Entry comments
- Password protection
- Custom time formats, currency, rounding time, taxes and deductions
If you have any problems or suggestions, then please contact us at support@svgapps.com. 
Information about the auto-renewable subscription
- You can purchase either a monthly subscription ($0.99/month) or an annual subscription ($9.99/year).
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- For more information on how to cancel your subscription, please review - https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
- Privacy policy: http://www.svgapps.com/privacy-policy
- Terms of use: http://www.svgapps.com/terms

bluejetty:00073703:ios.name: Natural Cycles: Fertility App
bluejetty:00073703:ios.summary: Natural Cycles is a 100% non-hormonal birth control app cleared by FDA. Get an NC° Band with our annual subscription, or a compatible wearable to measure your basal temperature and track your biomarkers. Trusted by 6M+ women, using Natural
bluejetty:00073703:ios.description:
Natural Cycles is a 100% non-hormonal birth control app cleared by FDA. Get an NC° Band with our annual subscription, or a compatible wearable to measure your basal temperature and track your biomarkers. Trusted by 6M+ women, using Natural Cycles as an ovulation tracker is a great way to start your birth control or fertility journey.
Trust in science to support you
• Natural Cycles is 98% effective when used as intended, and 93% with typical use. 
• Typical use is in the same effectiveness category as the contraceptive pill, which is 93% effective.
• Unlike period trackers, our algorithm uses personalized temperature trends data to detect ovulation.
Naturally prevent pregnancy
• NC° Birth Control is a non-hormonal contraception with no side effects.
• Our algorithm updates your fertility and ovulation status daily based on your temperature, showing not-fertile days, or days to use protection.
Organic pregnancy planning
• NC° Plan Pregnancy measures your body temperature to track ovulation when trying to conceive. 
• Powered by biometrics, our algorithm pinpoints ovulation and peak fertility - you can try when it matters.
• NC° partner view lets you choose to allow your partner to follow your pregnancy planning journey. 
Monitor your pregnancy
• NC° Follow Pregnancy helps you monitor your baby’s developmental stages.
• Get tailored guidance, tracking baby movements, morning sickness, and other symptoms.
Get postpartum support
• NC° Postpartum supports you after pregnancy with daily check-ins, tracking symptoms, post-partum bleeding and providing articles with expert guidance.
• Use temperature to know when ovulation returns post-pregnancy.
Track perimenopause symptoms
• NC° Perimenopause measures your temperature to track hormonal changes and symptoms until post-menopause. 
Gain sleep insights
• See how and why your sleep changes across your cycle with Sleep Insights.
Choose your measuring device
•Natural Cycles is an ovulation tracker that can be used with the NC° Band, basal thermometer, Oura Ring, WHOOP, compatible Garmin devices or Apple Watch Series 8 or newer.
• Easily measure your temperature to track your fertility, using your choice of compatible wearable.
• Sign up to NC° Annual subscription and receive a free NC° Band.
More than a period tracker
• The NC° app adapts to your unique cycle, tracking fertility and ovulation even with irregular periods.
• Most period trackers assume you have a 28-day cycle, when most women don’t. We give you tailor-made guidance based on your menstrual cycle.
Subscription service
• Subscribe to our monthly or annual plan to unlock core features.
• Subscriptions are FSA/HSA eligible for reimbursement.
Every Natural Cycles subscription includes our advanced data protection program. Some free period tracking apps don’t have the same level of accountability. Your privacy is a priority. Natural Cycles is designed to keep your data safe.
The NC° app is more than just a period tracker, use it as a birth control, or to plan pregnancy with our ovulation tracker and daily fertility updates. Join 6 Million+ women who trust Natural Cycles.
Natural Cycles connects with Apple Health to read and write your health data, including medications, body temperature and cycle information.
___________
Precautions
• Natural Cycles does not protect against sexually transmitted infections (STIs). Use a condom to protect against STIs.
• No method of birth control is 100% effective. Even when using the birth control app perfectly, there is still a chance of pregnancy.
• Natural Cycles is for women 18 and older.
• Natural Cycles is authorized for use as birth control in the US, Canada, the UK, the EU/EEA, Australia, Singapore, Brazil, and South Korea. Outside these regions, the app is intended for fertility monitoring only.
• To use Natural Cycles, you need to understand English or one of the supported languages.
• Consult with a doctor before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00081373:ios.description:
"It's perfect, honestly." - Myke Hurley, Connected
"What makes Sticky Widgets great is the simplicity of the experience." - Ryan Christoffel, MacStories
"This is a great concept." - Dave Mark, The Loop
Welcome to Sticky Widgets, the absolute easiest way to put a sticky note on your home screen and edit it quickly. Add as many Sticky Widgets as you'd like, in every widget size. It's simple! It works on iPad! You can even pin notes to your Lock Screen with a premium subscription so they're visible even when your phone is locked!
1. Add a Sticky Widget to your home screen
2. Tap on the widget to edit it
3. That's about it!
But that's not all. Once you have a widget in place, you can customize it: change color, background, font, alignment, size, even rotation! And your widgets now sync to your iCloud account, meaning you can put a note on multiple devices logged into the same Apple ID and they'll stay in sync.
Sticky Widgets supports deep system integration with Siri, Shortcuts, the Dynamic Island, and more so there are even more ways to view and update your notes and lists.
Sticky Widgets is free to download and use. You get unlimited widgets, three classic background colors, three fonts, iCloud sync, Siri and Shortcuts integration, and full control over alignment, size, and rotation: all without paying a thing.
An optional upgrade unlocks everything else: the full color picker with any color you want, gradients and mesh gradients, hundreds of additional fonts, custom text colors, Lock Screen pinning, separate styling for light and dark mode, saved presets, the ability to restore archived notes, scheduled reminders, and no ads. Premium features can be accessed with a monthly, quarterly, or annual subscription, or with a one-time purchase.
The Sticky Widgets Terms of Use and Privacy Policy can be found at https://www.tylerhillsman.com/privacy-sw/. The Apple EULA can be found at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00015323:ios.description:
Insomnia Coach is designed for Veterans, military Servicemembers, and others who are suffering from insomnia. The app is based on Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-i) and provides:
* a guided, weekly training plan to help you track and improve your sleep
* a sleep coach with personal feedback about your sleep and fun sleep tips
* an interactive sleep diary to help you keep track of daily changes in your sleep
* 17 tools to help you get your sleep back on track
This app is based on scientific research about how people can change their behaviors and thoughts to improve their sleep. This app does NOT replace professional care.
Insomnia Coach is designed to be used daily for 5 weeks by following the Training Plan. After that, you can continue using the app to track your sleep and maintain good sleep habits. 
Insomnia Coach was created by VA’s National Center for PTSD.

bluejetty:00174354:ios.description:
The Allina Health app puts your health information at your fingertips and makes managing your health care quick and simple. The app also gives you turn-by-turn directions to and around multiple Allina Health hospitals so you can confidently find your destination. 
Download the Allina Health app for quick access to the following:
• access your health records through MyChart
• schedule and manage appointments
• communicate with your care team via secure messaging
• get turn-by-turn directions to and around multiple Allina Health hospitals
• find a doctor or care location
• share biometric data with your provider via Apple Health app, using the Track My Health activity
To access health record information (MyChart) you must be an Allina Health patient and have an Allina Health account. If you already have an account, you are ready to use all features of this app. To create an account with Allina Health go to allinahealth.org.
You do not need a username or password to get directions, find a health care provider or a location.
Includes support for Apple Health app for integration with your personal medical record. As part of this feature, there is built‐in integration to collect data, such as step count, calorie intake, blood pressure, or blood glucose, from other health and fitness apps and incorporate it into a patient's medical record.

It’s never been easier to organize your life

Avoid disturbing alarms, we'll send a quiet notification you won't be able to miss!
◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆◆
• Deadlines are no longer a problem with Reminder; simply create a reminder for each deadline and let the app do the work for you.
• Meetings – work schedules can get busy and the last thing you want to do, when such a thing happens, is miss one of your meetings. Create a weekly reminder for each meeting and be sure you will never miss one.

bluejetty:00164707:ios.description:
I like to think about this app as a natural evolution of the traditional drawing mannequin. As artistis around the world started supporting it and appreciating it, it eveolved beyond my best expectation in what it is now. Muliple mannequins, shuffling of parts, export of 3d models and much more. The screen space rotation method and others automatic features make your posing process fast and dynamic. Pose and view your reference just the way you need it and strengthen and improve your human figure drawing skills or export the 3d models for your 3d projects.

I hope it now can serve others as good as it served me. If you decide to unlock the pro version please be aware that, as solo indie developer, and being a pet project and not my main job, I cannot guarantee a proper support and further development of this app.

AAPC stands for The American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC), which offers certification opportunities for medical coders, billers, and other healthcare business professionals. CPC stands for Certified Professional Coder Certification CPC stands for Certified Professional Coder Certification Exam, a medical coding proficiency test that focuses on the correct application of CPT process codes, HCPCS Level II process and supply codes, and ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes. Our application not only perfectly supports the preparation for these two exams, but also makes it easier for you to pass the exams through the professional design of the exam experts!
Want to pass the exam on your first try? Of course, that's exactly what we aim to do. We customize your individual study plan based on your current skill level, study frequency, and goals, and we offer an efficient study system. Once you get started, you'll find that you're getting closer to your goals, and you'll thank us after the actual exam.
It is not a waste of your time and money to prepare for your exams with the well-designed and developed application Medical Coding Exam Prep 2026, you will find that you have made a wise decision.
Key Features:
- Scientific study system
- Beautiful interface and good experience
- Professional test experts are responsible for the design and content writing
- 1,400+ specialized questions with detailed explanations
- All questions are categorized by exam subjects
- Quizzes that simulate actual exams
- Leading artificial intelligence technology for tracking and analysis
- Multiple efficient test modes
- More features to explore!
We understand how difficult and arduous Medical Coding certification exam preparation can be, let our app work with you to complete this challenge and you will find it a memorable and valuable experience!

bluejetty:00155961:ios.description:
CL6™
------- HARDWARE PURCHASE REQUIRED FOR USAGE -------
CL6™ is the fastest, easiest, most versatile and complete telematics system utilizing a smartphone solution to stay connected with your vehicle from anywhere in the world. Using the CL6™ app, you can control your vehicle doors (Lock/Unlock), remote start or Stop your engine and even find your current vehicle’s location.
PROFESSIONNAL INSTALLATION REQUIRED
In order to use CL6™ on your vehicle, a CL6™ device and compatible remote starter must be installed onto your vehicle. To find an authorized CL6™ retailer, visit https://mycarcontrols.com/find-a-dealer.html
NOW COMPATIBLE WITH APPLE WATCH
Control any of your vehicles securely. Remote Start/Stop your engine, control your vehicle doorlocks and GPS locate your vehicle from your Apple Watch using the CL6™ watch app. Download the smartphone app and the watch app will automatically download onto your Apple watch. For more details, please visit https://mycarcontrols.com/watch.html
INTERNET CONNECTION REQUIRED
In order to use the CL6™ App, it will require a connection to the internet via cellular or WiFi.
KEY FEATURES
• Remote start engine
• Remote shutdown engine
• Keyless entry access
• Trunk release
• Open/Close motorized liftgate (if equipped)
• Factory or Aftermarket Security system Arming/Disarming
• Up to 4 Customizable auxiliary functions
• GPS position*
• Push notifications for remote starter trouble codes
• Push notifications for security alerts
• Low battery condition alerts
• Current vehicle status, Battery level and MyCar device signal strength
*Instant locate feature included with basic plan.
REMOTE STARTER COMPATIBILITY
CL6™ is currently compatible with the following brands of remote starter and/or security systems:
ADS
• iDatastart HCx
• iDatastart BMx
• iDatastart BZx
• iDatastart VWx
ADS-AL-CA (adapter required)
• AKX / OEM
ASTROSTART
• AF-D600
AUTOSTART
• ASD200
• ASD600
COMPUSTAR
• CM-7XXX
• CM-6XXX
• CM-900
• FT-xxx-DC
• FT-DC2
• FT-DC3
CRIMESTOPPER
• RS-00
• RSx-G5
• SP402
• SP502
DIRECTED
• DBALL 2
• DB3
• 4X10
• 5X10
• DS4+
FORTIN
• Evo-All
• Evo-One
MIDCITY ENGINEERING
• All modules with Drone telematics port
OMEGA
• All modules with Blue telematics port
POLARSTART
• PRS-13
• PRS-16
VOXX
• Flashlogic: All FLRS, FLRSBA, FLCMVW remote start modules
• FLCAN (adapter required)
• Prestige/Pursuit: All E model’s w/ telematics port (Except PRO9233E)
• Code Alarm: CASECRS, CARS, CA4555, CA4055 & CA5055
NOTE: All Prestige/Pursuit/CodeAlarm systems must be updated to the latest firmware version (this will require the VOXX USB updating cable, Part# VEPROG)
STANDALONE MODE
Only Instant GPS locate function is active. All other functions are disabled.
For more details on which product is compatible with CL6™, visit https://mycarcontrols.com/find-a-dealer.html
APP OWNER’S GUIDE
Please consult the "Help section" inside our App for a detailed Owners Guide.
KEYWORDS
CL6, MyCar, Car Starter, Remote Starter, MyCar Controls, Vehicle Control, Car Access, Locate my car, Voxx
