bluejetty:00095093:ios.summary: Dive into a world of relaxing gameplay, vibrant colors, and satisfying strategy with Woody Block Color Blast. If you're a fan of classic block games but crave something fresh, engaging, and beautifully designed, this is the game for you.
bluejetty:00095093:ios.description:
Dive into a world of relaxing gameplay, vibrant colors, and satisfying strategy with Woody Block Color Blast. If you're a fan of classic block games but crave something fresh, engaging, and beautifully designed, this is the game for you.
Why You’ll Love Woody Block Color Blast
- Natural Wood Vibes: Immerse yourself in the calming, elegant look of handcrafted woody blocks. The warm tones and smooth textures offer a soothing visual experience unlike any other.
- Classic Puzzle, Modern Twist: Enjoy the familiar 10x10 grid puzzle gameplay, but enhanced with vibrant color blasts and exciting combos that bring the screen to life.
- Casual Yet Addictive: Play at your own pace, whether you're unwinding after a long day or trying to beat your personal high score. Every move matters!
- Perfect for All Ages: Whether you're new to puzzle games or a seasoned block master, Woody Block Color Blast offers a fun and challenging experience for everyone.
Gameplay Features
- Drag & Drop Simplicity: Pick from a variety of colorful woody blocks, place them on the grid, and complete rows or columns to clear the board.
- Combo and Streak Fun: Strategically place your wood blocks to trigger satisfying combos and keep your streaks going for bonus points.
- Relaxing Sound & Visuals: Calming sound effects and wood-themed visuals create a peaceful, meditative gameplay experience.
Why Woody Blocks?
There’s something deeply satisfying about working with wood. The soft clicks, the natural colors, the feeling of placing a perfect piece — all combine to create a uniquely calming experience. Each woody block in the game is thoughtfully designed to bring you joy, one piece at a time.
Start your journey with Woody Block Color Blast today – where every block fits, every move matters, and every puzzle feels like a masterpiece.

bluejetty:00148039:ios.name: Gratitude Jar
bluejetty:00148039:ios.summary: Adopting a grateful attitude is one of the most powerful things you can do to create positive changes within your life. Gratitude has the power to energize, the power to heal and the power to bring hope. Research has shown that practicing g
bluejetty:00148039:ios.description:
Adopting a grateful attitude is one of the most powerful things you can do to create positive changes within your life. Gratitude has the power to energize, the power to heal and the power to bring hope. Research has shown that practicing gratitude regularly can help boost feelings of happiness and increase your well-being.
Gratitude Jar is a simple gratitude journal that easily helps you cultivate gratitude by reflecting on what you are thankful for each day and allowing you to be more present. Sometimes it’s the simple things that make life wonderful – an encouraging text from a friend, watching your plant grow or even a random act of kindness from a stranger. When you take just a few minutes to reflect on your day, you might be surprised to see even a not so great day may turn out to be an amazing one!
Sometimes you just need a small reminder for all the things – big or small you have done. Our world is full of things to be grateful for – Gratitude Jar helps you notice, appreciate, and share your gratitude. Add a daily dose of gratitude to your day! 
 FEATURES:
- Jar Shake: Whenever you just need a reminder of the good things in your life, you can use the Jar Shake feature which displays a random memory from your previous gratitude entries. Additionally, each star represents entries you have made, so slowly watch as the number of stars fill the jar with the more entries you write.
- Streaks: Keep track of your personal progress with a calendar view and streak to keep your momentum going. Build a mindful gratitude journaling habit.
- Gratitude Log: Look back and cherish your previous gratitude entries. You have the option of searching by keywords or date and by tapping on an entry, it allows you to edit it. 
- Reminders: Set daily notifications to help you turn gratitude into a daily habit.
- Share Your Gratitude: Expressing gratitude can be fun, why not share your gratitude with your loved ones and show your appreciation with those you are grateful for.
- Dark Mode: Dark mode is great for late night mindful journaling and helps improve sleep quality without glare from your phone.
- Ad-free space for you to reflect on things you are grateful for.
WE RESPECT YOUR PRIVACY:
We do not store any of your data, and we do not require you to sign-in or make an account. We built this gratitude journal with your privacy in mind.
“Gratitude helps you to grow and expand; gratitude brings joy and laughter into your life and into the lives of all those around you.”
- Eileen Caddy
Read more about our Privacy Policy/Terms of Service here:
- Privacy Policy: https://github.com/karen-kc/GratitudeJarPolicies/blob/master/privacy-policy.md
- Terms of Service: https://github.com/karen-kc/GratitudeJarPolicies/blob/master/terms-and-conditions.md

bluejetty:00082979:ios.summary:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Your relationship is on the line in this interactive story game based on the hit series. Are you ready to say "I do," or will you find someone new?
Jump into the whirlwind social experiment of "The Ultimatum"
bluejetty:00082979:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Your relationship is on the line in this interactive story game based on the hit series. Are you ready to say "I do," or will you find someone new?
Jump into the whirlwind social experiment of "The Ultimatum" in this narrative dating sim, where you'll create a character and make high-stakes choices to shape your own love story. You and your partner Taylor have signed on to participate in the show, with "Too Hot to Handle" and "Perfect Match" star Chloe Veitch as host. You'll meet other questioning couples, choose someone new to live with in a trial marriage, and then make a life-changing choice: Will you fully commit to your relationship, or pursue love with someone else?
CREATE YOUR DREAM CHARACTER
Customize every detail of your look (and your partner's) with a huge range of avatar creation choices, from gender to eyebrows and accessories. You'll choose specific interests and hobbies, decide what you value most in a relationship and pick fresh new outfits for big date nights and story events.
YOUR CHOICES SHAPE YOUR STORY
Tell the story that's true to you by making key choices as you interact with other characters. Will you lean into spicy, seductive moments or hold back? Will you start drama or play the peacemaker? So many different possible love stories could unfold, and a single choice can make a big difference. 
WIN THE GAME OF LOVE
As you progress through the game's story, you'll complete achievements and earn reward diamonds you can use to unlock extra outfits, bonus pictures and new story events. You'll also see other characters rise and fall on your Love Leaderboard as you make each choice about who to flirt with, fight with or fall for.
LOVE TRIANGLES AND TROUBLES
This experiment is a chance for you and your partner to grow, but will it be together — or apart? As you each start dating other people and choose a new trial spouse, things are guaranteed to get complicated. Buckle up and get ready to ride this romantic roller coaster!
- Created by XO Games.

bluejetty:00182705:ios.description:
Dive into the world of classic Pinochle with our immersive card game that combines strategic gameplay with whimsical characters that respond to the game. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a newcomer to the game, our app offers a captivating experience that will keep you coming back for more.
Key Features:
Advanced AI Opponents:
Challenge yourself against our top-notch AI opponents, each designed to provide a challenging and realistic gameplay experience. Sharpen your skills and enjoy the thrill of strategic card play as you face off against virtual opponents who adapt to your every move.
Animated Characters:
Watch your gameplay come to life with animated characters that respond to the twists and turns of each match. Our characters express joy, frustration, and anticipation, adding an extra layer of entertainment to your Pinochle experience.
Customizable Gameplay:
Tailor your Pinochle experience to your liking with customizable settings. Adjust difficulty levels, choose your preferred rules, and explore different variations of the game to keep things exciting.
Detailed Statistics:
Track your progress and analyze your gameplay with detailed statistics. Monitor your win-loss record, study your strategies, and become a Pinochle master.
Engaging Rewards and Achievements:
Earn rewards and unlock achievements as you progress through the game. Celebrate your victories and strive for new milestones, adding an extra layer of motivation to your Pinochle journey.
Download now and immerse yourself in the ultimate Pinochle card game experience. The cards are dealt, the characters are ready – are you?

bluejetty:00043566:ios.description:
TATTOO GURU – YOUR ULTIMATE GUIDE IN THE WORLD OF TATTOOS
Thinking about getting a tattoo? Looking for the perfect design? Whether you're an artist, a tattoo lover, or getting inked for the first time, Tattoo Guru helps you create and visualize your next masterpiece.
With our AI-powered tattoo generator, you can create stunning designs, visualize them on your body, and make confident choices before getting inked.
► FEATURES:
● AI TATTOO GENERATOR – YOUR PERSONAL INK ARTIST
Describe your idea, and our advanced AI will generate a unique tattoo design tailored just for you.
● EXPLORE POPULAR STYLES
Explore a diverse range of styles, from traditional and tribal to geometric, realism, Japanese, and the trending cybersigilism – a fusion of futuristic and mystical elements.
● TRY BEFORE YOU INK – AUGMENTED REALITY PREVIEW
Not sure where to place your tattoo? Visualize designs directly on your body before making a commitment.
● HIGH-QUALITY TATTOO STENCILS
Designed for artists! Generate professional-grade stencils to bring your AI-generated designs to life.
● SAVE & SHARE YOUR DESIGNS
Save your favorite tattoos, share them with friends and your artist, and get feedback before deciding.
► WHY CHOOSE TATTOO GURU?
• SAVE TIME – No more endless searching. Let our AI instantly create the perfect design for you.
• PERSONALIZED FOR YOU – Every tattoo is one-of-a-kind, based on your unique input.
• MAKE CONFIDENT DECISIONS – See how different tattoos look on your body before committing.
• DESIGNED FOR ARTISTS & ENTHUSIASTS – Whether you’re a tattoo artist or just exploring ideas, Tattoo Guru is your creative companion.
HAVE FUN & SHARE YOUR DESIGNS!
Tattoo Guru is more than an app – it’s your tattoo playground! Found an awesome design? Show it off and tag #TattooGuru for a chance to get featured!
SUPPORT & TERMS
If you have any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the app, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Privacy Policy: https://www.appsx.lv/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.appsx.lv/terms

[O] Joy of Growth: Vast content and endless growth!

bluejetty:00095084:ios.description:
Noteleap AI Note Taker – Your smart voice to note assistant for every meeting, discussion
Noteleap AI Note Taker is an all-in-one voice memos, note taking app designed to transform the way you capture, organize, and interact with information. Noteleap transcribes all your meetings, interviews, lectures in real time with precision summarize content effortlessly, so you can stay focus on the discussion and never miss a detail
VOICE MEMOS: CAPTURE EVERYTHING LIVE
Noteleap enables real-time voice recording, instant audio to tex transcription, ensuring you capture every word clearly, accurately as it’s spoken. Ideal for lectures, meeting minutes, business discussions, interviews, and more – just hit record, let Noteleap do the rest.
Here's how:
* Record & live transcription
* Record audio up to 60 minutes, process it seamlessly
* Snap photos of documents, whiteboards, or handwritten notes
* Upload files including PDF, TXT, etc for quick conversion
* Import content directly from YouTube videos and links URL for analysis
AI SMART NOTE TAKING, SUMMARIZATION
Noteleap AI helps you automatically summarize, classify, and interact with your notes. Whether you’re reviewing a long lecture or summarizing a client meeting, sale call, the app distills key points in seconds—saving you time and effort.
AI Features include:
* One-tap summaries of any recording or text, get actionable to-do lists, notes
* Automatic topic detection and tagging
* AI chat assistant that allows you to ask questions, get insights from your notes instantly
STAY ORGANIZED & PRODUCTIVE
Boost your productivity with Noteleap
* Smart tagging system organizes content by theme, topic, or project
* Advanced search lets you search across all inputs—voice, text, files, or web content
* Notes are automatically categorized to keep your workspace neat
* Export, share important meeting notes, voice memos instantly to streamline your workflow.
Noteleap is versatile, easy to use for everyone:
* Students, Educators: record, transcribe lectures, classroom discussions, and personal study sessions, organize notes, materials before exams or group projects, save hours of studying.
* Professionals – Capture meeting minutes, generate summaries, retrieve insights instantly making it easier to stay present, engaged in discussions.
* Experts, Analysts – Gather multi-source input and let AI do the heavy lifting of organizing and synthesizing
Noteleap AI Note Taker is engineered for performance. From rapid transcription to seamless file handling, the app delivers a fast, responsive experience. Even large audio files—up to 60 minutes—are processed with minimal delay, so your workflow remains smooth. With Noteleap, your recordings and transcriptions are also fully secure. You control your data—easily export or delete any files when needed.
Download now, transform the way you learn, work, and think with Noteleap!
Unlock new levels of productivity with Noteleap AI Note Taker Premium:
- Weekly subscription: $6.99
- Annual subscription: $59.99
Information about the auto-renewal of subscription:
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. The cost depends on the selected plan.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://kainsuite.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://kainsuite.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00092894:ios.description:
Hole it: Black Hole Puzzle Game
Swallow the world, one puzzle at a time!
Get ready for Hole it, the most satisfying brain game of the year!
Dive into a universe of colorful puzzles where you are the all-powerful black hole. Forget mindless eating—here, your brain is your greatest asset!
Can you solve the challenge and swallow only the objects you need to win?
In this addictive new puzzle game, you’ll navigate vibrant maps.
Each level gives you a unique mission: collect all the red cars, eat only the donuts, or use the boosters to add to yourself time! It’s the perfect mix of relaxing gameplay and a fun brain challenge.
Key Features:
UNIQUE PUZZLE MECHANICS: More than just an io game! Each level is a new brain teaser.
INCREDIBLY SATISFYING: The feeling of clearing the map and collecting objects is super relaxing.
VIBRANT & COLORFUL WORLDS: Explore dozens of beautiful, hand-crafted levels.
EASY ONE-FINGER CONTROLS: Simple to learn, but hard to master!
How to Grow Your Black Hole:
DRAG your finger to move the hole across the map.
CHECK the mission at the top of the screen.
EAT only the specific items required to solve the puzzle.
GROW bigger with every object you swallow!
CLEAR the board to become the ultimate puzzle solver!
Unlike other io games where you just eat everything, Hole it! challenges you to think before you eat. It’s not about being the biggest, it’s about being the smartest! It’s the attack hole game for puzzle lovers.
The challenge awaits! Are you ready to test your brain and have a ton of fun?
Download Hole it for FREE and start your puzzle-swallowing adventure NOW!

bluejetty:00140790:ios.description:
Pileometer by Brickit is a game-changer for anyone who loves building or misses the feeling of joy their bricks used to give them.
It is both an app and a storage system that provides you with exact digital catalog of the parts you own. Using cutting-edge recognition technology, Pileometer by Brickit helps you organize your parts, discover fascinating building designs, and build complex creations.
Precise Digital Catalog
Create an accurate digital inventory of your entire parts collection.
Advanced Parts Scanner
Take a photo of your parts and let Pileometer by Brickit auto-recognize 1600 different shapes with precision.
Parts Location Guidance
Intricate builds are much more fun when you always know where to find the exact shape and color you need.
Building Ideas Library
Access a vast catalog of building ideas tailored to your parts collection.
Pileometer is perfect for anyone who wants to bring a long-needed neatness into a usually scattered building experience, as well as anyone who’d love to find new inspiration in a box of Lego left somewhere in a distant corner.
Pro Subscription Terms:
— Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
— Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.
— Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period.
— Users can manage their subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to Account Settings after purchase.
— Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
— License agreement: https://pileometer.app/eula/
— Privacy policy: https://pileometer.app/privacy-policy/
Pileometer by Brickit was created by fans and is not an official LEGO® product. The LEGO Group of companies does not sponsor or support Pileometer.

bluejetty:00083819:ios.description:
Clear30: Your Guide to a Successful 30-Day Tolerance Break and So Much More
When you try to take a tolerance break, stop smoking, or reduce smoking weed, it can feel like everything is stacked against you:
 • Your friends asking you to smoke
 • Soul-crushing boredom
 • Your old stash waiting for you in your underwear drawer
 • Not knowing what to do with your free time
Clear30 is an all-encompassing 30-day digital T-Break guide designed to help you overcome obstacles while empowering you to live with intention and purpose, no matter what your long-term goals are. Whether you’re on a weed break, a tolerance break, or looking to quit weed entirely, we’re here to support your journey.
Clear30 is a subscription based app.
With an active subscription, you have access toL
 • Personalized feedback based on your current use
 • A preparation guide and supportive meditation
 • A progress tracker, sober counter, and video journal to document your patterns and growth
 • Access to the Clear30 community
 • An AI assistant to provide tips on having a successful T-Break
 • Personalized daily messages to guide you through your tolerance break
 • Educational pages with information and guidance on topics such as withdrawal, triggers, cravings, mental health, ways to succeed, and so much more!
 • Custom daily meditations to keep you grounded
 • Reddit threads and YouTube videos connecting you to others on the same journey
 • The option to enroll in long-term support programs tailored to your post-Clear30 goals
Live with Intention.
Drop the weed maps for a month and start your Clear30 journey today for free.
In-app subscription terms and conditions can be found at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00188157:ios.name: Sacred Space Daily Prayer
bluejetty:00188157:ios.developer: Rathfarnham Charitable Trust of The Jesuit Fathers
bluejetty:00188157:ios.summary: Sacred Space offers unique daily prayer, reflections, scripture, retreats, novenas and other ways to pray. The app is available in English, Belarusian, Catalan, Croatian, Czech, Dutch, French, German, Hungarian, Irish, Italian, Polish, Port
bluejetty:00188157:ios.description:
Sacred Space offers unique daily prayer, reflections, scripture, retreats, novenas and other ways to pray. The app is available in English, Belarusian, Catalan, Croatian, Czech, Dutch, French, German, Hungarian, Irish, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Slovenian and Spanish.
Inspired by the spirituality of Saint Ignatius of Loyola, a sixteenth-century Basque, whose insights into God's working with the human heart have been of great assistance to countless people over the centuries and are found more helpful than ever today.
Sacred Space is a work of the Irish Province of the Society of Jesus (the Jesuits). The website launched in 1999 and has been providing daily prayer ever since. Sacred Space is now translated into over 15 languages and continues to provide new ways to pray. 
It might seem strange to pray at your computer, in front of a screen or using your smartphone, especially if there are other people around you, or distracting noises. But God is everywhere, all around us, constantly reaching out to us, even in the most unlikely situations. When we know this, and with a bit of practice, we can pray anywhere!
We offer the pages of the site to guide you through a session of prayer, in six stages, including preparing your body and mind, and culminating in reflection on a scripture passage chosen specially for the day. The stages are: 
- The Presence of God
- Freedom
- Consciousness
- The Word
- Conversation
- Conclusion
Although they are written in the first person - "I" - the prayers are for doing, rather than for reading out. Each stage is a kind of exercise or meditation aimed at helping you get in touch with God, and God's presence in your life.
Scripture quotations are from the New Revised Standard Version Updated Edition. Copyright © 2021 National Council of Churches of Christ in the United States of America. Used by permission. All rights reserved worldwide.
All other material on our site/app is the copyright of Sacred Space. Contact the office for more information - see Contact details. The presentation, content and texts in use on the site have been developed in collaboration with the network of local language teams around the world. Copyright © 1999-2025 Sacred Space. All rights reserved.

Sacred Space is a work of the Irish Province of the Society of Jesus (the Jesuits). The website launched in 1999 and has been providing daily prayer ever since. Sacred Space is now translated into over 15 languages and continues to provide new ways to pray. 

It might seem strange to pray at your computer, in front of a screen or using your smartphone, especially if there are other people around you, or distracting noises. But God is everywhere, all around us, constantly reaching out to us, even in the most unlikely situations. When we know this, and with a bit of practice, we can pray anywhere!

We offer the pages of the site to guide you through a session of prayer, in six stages, including preparing your body and mind, and culminating in reflection on a scripture passage chosen specially for the day. The stages are: 

- The Presence of God
- Freedom
- Consciousness
- The Word
- Conversation
- Conclusion

Although they are written in the first person - "I" - the prayers are for doing, rather than for reading out. Each stage is a kind of exercise or meditation aimed at helping you get in touch with God, and God's presence in your life.

bluejetty:00100403:ios.description:
Never miss a prayer again. Aqimo is an Islam utility app that helps Muslims maintain consistent prayer habits with accurate prayer times, smart app blocking, and Qibla direction—all in one peaceful companion.
ACCURATE PRAYER TIMES:
Get precise Salah times based on your exact location with automatic GPS detection and timezone support. Never wonder when it's time to pray.
SMART APP BLOCKING:
Block distracting apps during prayer times to help you focus on what matters most. Choose which apps to block, and Aqimo automatically restricts access during each prayer window using native iOS integration.
PRAYER TRACKING & STREAKS:
Track your prayer consistency and build lasting habits. See your progress with prayer completion history and motivating streak counters.
QIBLA COMPASS:
Find the Qibla direction anywhere in the world using your device's built-in compass and sensors. Pray in the right direction, every time.
GENTLE REMINDERS:
Receive peaceful notifications before each prayer time so you're always prepared. Customize reminder timing for each of the five daily prayers.
PRIVACY-FIRST DESIGN:
Your data stays on your device. No cloud sync, no accounts, no tracking. All prayer history and settings are stored locally in your app's private storage.
KEY FEATURES:
• Accurate prayer times for all 5 daily prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha)
• Automatic location detection with manual city selection
• App blocking during prayer times using iOS Family Controls
• Prayer completion tracking and streak counters
• Qibla compass with device sensors
• Customizable prayer reminders
• Dark mode support
• Completely offline—works without internet after setup
• No registration or login required
PERFECT FOR:
• Muslims seeking to improve prayer consistency
• Anyone struggling with phone distractions during prayer
• Students and professionals with busy schedules
• Travelers needing accurate prayer times worldwide
• Parents teaching children about salah
WHY AQIMO?
Aqimo understands the challenges of maintaining five daily prayers in a distraction-filled world. Our app blocking feature helps you disconnect from your phone and reconnect with Allah.
WHAT USERS SAY:
"Finally, an app that actually helps me stay consistent with my prayers!"
"The app blocking is a game changer. I don't even think about checking my phone during prayer time anymore."
"Simple, beautiful, and exactly what I needed. Jazakallah Khair!"
TECHNICAL DETAILS:
• Requires iOS 15.0 or later
• Location permission required for prayer times
• Motion sensors required for Qibla compass
• Family Controls permission required for app blocking
PRIVACY & SECURITY:
All your data is stored locally on your device. We never collect, share, or transmit your prayer data, location, or personal information to any servers. Your spiritual journey is private.
Download Aqimo today and transform your prayer routine. Build the consistency you've always wanted, one prayer at a time.
May Allah make it easy for you to maintain your prayers.

bluejetty:00156947:ios.description:
WISHI app offers online personal styling. Booking a WISHI personal stylist is simple and affordable, once you chose the right personal stylist for you, an online styling session will begin in which you will provide all the information needed and the stylist will work with you to find the right look for each event.
Looks can be created from clothes you already have in your closet or by adding the final touch with a little bit of online shopping for unique items - it's your choice.
HOW WISHI WORKS 
WISHI is a community of hundreds of stylists. Tell us about yourself, and we’ll connect you to the right ones who help put together your unique looks. 
1. We match you with your personal stylist.
We’ll match you to 3 stylists who best get your vibe. Book one to get started.
2. Receive looks personalized to your style and budget.
3. Buy what you love.
Your stylist will send you a Mood Board to kick off the session that best expresses their vision for the session — from there you'll receive 2-5 Style Boards with the option to revise (two times) until you find the perfect look. 
Why people love Wishi
 - Look great without going over budget - WISHI stylists know how to find perfect items to complete a look for you.
 - Too busy to shop - save time by having your stylist find the best items for you to buy online.
 - Get ready for big events - from weddings, to important dates, or job interviews, WISHI stylists will help you get the right look.
 - Go out with your best foot forward - Stylists can create unique and amazing looks for you, no matter the occasion. 
 - Vacation Ready - pack the right items for your next vacation; focus on great clothing items and accessories that can create multiple looks.
 - Help stay within dress code - Get the right outfit for events you are unfamiliar with like a business meeting out of the country or a traditional wedding somewhere far far away.
 - Spend less time staring at your closet - wonder "what should I wear?" no more! Get ready right away on a daily basis with the help of a Wishi stylist.
THE WISHI STYLING SESSION
Professional Stylists - Our stylists come from all sorts of backgrounds -- from editors at Vogue, celebrity stylists, to fashion’s biggest influencers, we have the right style match for you!
Personal Guidance - Help your stylist get to know you and your preferences with one-on-one chats. 
No Splurge Necessary - You can ask for purchase recommendations, work with what’s already in your closet, or a mixture of both.
Our goal is to get you looking and feeling great. We have a 100% satisfaction guarantee rule, so if you don't love what you've gotten, we'll set you up with another stylist of your choice.
Try a WISHI session today. It’s like having a Personal Stylist in your pocket -- we know you're going to love it!

bluejetty:00120922:ios.description:
Welcome to Bible Coloring - Paint by Number, a sacred space where faith, art, and daily devotion seamlessly converge.
It's not just a paint-by-number game—it's your personal companion for daily prayer. We believe every stroke is a response to God's grace, and every flow of color transforms into a profound prayer.
Here, let tranquility blossom at your fingertips, let faith take root in your heart, and discover the peace and inspiration that come from God. 
High-Quality Biblical Artwork
High-Quality Illustrations: Exquisitely crafted HD biblical illustrations by our artist team, rich in detail and spiritual depth.
Classic Bible Stories: Covering Genesis, Exodus, the miracles of Jesus, and numerous biblical narratives.
Portraits of Biblical Figures: Encounter prophets and saints like Jesus, Moses, and David through color.
Sacred Symbols: Paint the cross, church, dove, and lamb with the colors of your heart.
Daily Prayer & Reflection
Coloring as Prayer: We blend coloring with daily prayer and meditation, helping you begin each day with peace and strength.
Scripture Guidance: Each day features an illustration paired with a dedicated Bible verse and prayer prompt, infusing your coloring journey with meaning.
Faith Growth & Sharing
Spiritual Growth: Transform screen time into meaningful devotional moments, deepening your understanding and memory of Scripture through creation.
Family Devotions: Suitable for Christian coloring enthusiasts of all ages, creating together in love and sharing the joy of faith.
Spreading Blessings: Easily share your inspired artwork with family and friends, conveying God's love and grace.
Peaceful Experience & Effortless Creation
Easy to Start: No drawing skills required—simply follow the numbered guides to effortlessly create stunning masterpieces.
Relaxing Music: Unwind to gentle background music, releasing stress to find inner peace and joy.
Anytime, Anywhere: Begin your coloring devotion journey during your commute or while reflecting at home.
Let Bible Coloring become your daily encounter with God. Pray through color, grow through creation, and feel God's love and peace in tranquility.
Download Bible Coloring now to start your coloring devotion journey, walk with God, and deepen your faith through Bible Coloring!
Bible Coloring Premium
With Bible Coloring Premium, you can subscribe to unlock unlimited hints, remove ads, and eliminate watermarks.
Bible Coloring offers a weekly subscription for $1.99, a monthly subscription for $4.99, and an annual membership that automatically renews at $39.99 per year after a 3-day free trial. Prices are equivalent to the “Apple App Store Pricing Matrix” for other currencies.
These purchases are subscriptions that automatically renew. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase or at the end of any free trial period, if applicable.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within the last 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.

bluejetty:00131876:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00131876:ios.description:
ZOMBIE SURVIVAL AND FIRST PERSON SHOOTER
Kontra is an FPS game that features single player zombie survival, multiplayer zombie mode, and other game modes like: surf online, deathrun online, deathmatch online and arms race online.
Choose your zombie class. Survive the zombie outbreak!
Experience Counter Strike 1.6 on mobile!
CLASSIC GRAPHICS 
Optimized graphics with thrilling action gameplay and intuitive controls, to get the most out of mobile fps experience.
SKILL BASED SHOOTER 
No auto aim, no auto fire. Play in training maps, become better and win matches against your friends and others. 
INTUITIVE CONTROLS 
Easy controls, easy to learn. Designed for best mobile fps experience. 
THRILLING LOCATIONS 
Interesting maps from sci-fi laboratory to huge rats room. 
INTERESTING GAME MODES 
5 game modes featuring different mechanics. Survive in online Zombie Survival game mode.
COMMUNITY SERVERS
You can download publicly available server build to host your own game with Admin/VIP features. Master server is also configurable in settings.
OPTIMIZED GRAPHICS TO INCLUDE HUNDREDS OF LOCATIONS 
Almost no limits to amount of maps in the game. Simple and engaging maps take as little space as possible! 
DIFFERENT ZOMBIE CLASSES 
In Zombie Mode different zombie class has different abilities.
UP TO 16 PLAYERS 
Participate in 8vs8 shootout. Become the last out of 15 players to survive zombie outbreak! 
ZOMBIE MODE
Try to survive zombie outbreak! Zombie Survival begins with one of the players getting infected. Your mission as humans is to eliminate zombies to not let the infection spread.
Survive zombie apocalypse in single player mode or join online game for unique experience.
DEATHMATCH MODE 
Traditional deathmatch mode where two teams, counter-terrorists and terrorists participate in shootout. Whenever you die, you instantly respawn. Kill opponents to earn money and buy better weapons. 
ARMS RACE MODE 
Classic arms race where everyone is against each other. Make your way through the cycle of weapons by killing opponents. The first player to complete the whole cycle wins. 
DEATHRUN MODE 
The team must avoid obstacles and eliminate the terrorist by reaching the end while the terrorist must stop them by eliminating all players.
SURF MODE 
Compete team vs team. Use your movement skills to reach the place with advanced weapons. Team with most kills wins.
MAIN FEATURES: 
Zombie Single Player
Zombie Multiplayer 
Deathrun Multiplayer, become a bhop pro 
Surf Multiplayer 
Deathmatch Multiplayer 
Arms Race Multiplayer

• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the 97.7 97.3 The Wolf app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the 97.7 97.3 The Wolf app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00070808:ios.description:
HUDA – Your Daily Ibadah Companion
HUDA is a beautifully designed app that helps Muslims stay connected to their faith. With a clean and simple interface, HUDA makes it easy to access prayer times, read the Quran, find the Qibla direction, and locate nearby mosques — all in one place.
Key Features
Prayer Times
- Accurate timings based on official sources: JAKIM (Malaysia), MUIS (Singapore), and KHEU (Brunei).
- Custom athan sounds and pre-athan alerts.
- Automatic location-based calculations.
- Monthly timetable and support for various calculation methods.
Al-Quran Al-Kareem
- Full Quran with audio recitations and multiple translations.
- Verse-by-verse playback with repeat.
- Search, share, and copy verses easily.
- Adjustable text size for a better reading experience.
- Write your own notes and read notes from others.
Mosque Finder & Qibla
- Locate nearby mosques easily on an interactive map.
- Access detailed mosque information at a glance.
- Get directions using Google Maps, Waze, or Apple Maps.
- Read reviews from the community or share your own experience.
- Browse and contribute mosque photos.
- Use the built-in compass to find the Qibla direction accurately.
Hisnul Muslim
- A rich collection of daily duas from the Qur’an and Sunnah.
- Search and filter with ease.
- Play audio, share and copy your favorite duas.
Widget
- Access today’s prayer times right from your home screen.
- Check prayer times at a glance from your lock screen.
40 Hadith An-Nawawi
- Read the most important hadiths compiled by Imam An-Nawawi.
Asma-ul Husna
- Learn and reflect on the 99 names of Allah.
Tasbih Counter
- Track your dhikr with sound and vibration feedback.
Additional Features
- Night-friendly Dark Mode for comfortable viewing.
- Shahadah with audio pronunciation guide.
- Choose from a variety of custom app icons.
- Curated Home Feed featuring articles, videos, and more.
- Follow and connect with other Huda users.
Download HUDA today and elevate your daily ibadah.
By using this app, you agree to Apple’s Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Questions or feedback? Reach out to us at contact@hudaapp.com
Visit hudaapp.com for more info.

Escape the ordinary and ignite your intellect with Trivia scapes, the perfect trivia game to challenge your mind and test your knowledge. Dive into a world of fun trivia games, brain
bluejetty:00137287:ios.description:
Trivia scapes: The Ultimate Brain Training Trivia Game!
Escape the ordinary and ignite your intellect with Trivia scapes, the perfect trivia game to challenge your mind and test your knowledge. Dive into a world of fun trivia games, brain games, and engaging quiz challenges designed to enhance your cognitive abilities and boost your IQ!
Trivia scapes offers an exciting blend of brain training and mind games that will push your memory and logic skills to the limit. Whether you're a fan of logic puzzles, trivia across history, science, geography, animals, food, and literature, or just love a good brain test, Trivia scapes has it all!
As you progress through question games, each correct answer rewards you with a piece of a beautiful new landscape. Collect all the fragments and unlock breathtaking views of nature's most stunning scenery! A true puzzle game at heart, Trivia scapes combines the joy of answering trivia questions with the satisfaction of completing visually stunning backgrounds.
In Trivia scapes, it's okay to make mistakes. If you get a question wrong, you'll lose one of your five lives. But don't worry! Trivia games are all about learning, and with the coins you earn, you can buy extra lives or helpful hints to guide you through those tricky IQ games.
Ready to challenge your brain? With a mix of both hard and easy quizzes, Trivia scapes is a brain training game that keeps you entertained while boosting your intellectual abilities. Test your memory, IQ, and logical thinking skills through fun and challenging logic puzzles that will sharpen your mind with every level!
KEY GAME FEATURES
- Challenging trivia quizzes to test your knowledge
- Beautiful, relaxing scenery and backgrounds
- Easy-to-use design with simple rules
- Calming atmosphere for a peaceful, focused experience
- Exciting brain games to train your mind
Trivia scapes is more than just a quiz game - it's a perfect combination of relaxation and intellectual stimulation. Relax with cosy atmosphere and enjoy the calming landscapes while you expand your knowledge and improve your mind. Whether you're looking to unwind or challenge your brain with a brain test, Trivia scapes offers a perfect mix of IQ games, question games, and mind games that will keep you coming back for more!

bluejetty:00153565:ios.description:
Most VPNs promise “no logs.” We made it impossible. VP.net is the only VPN built on Verified Privacy™. It’s a cryptographically enforced system that proves we can’t see your data. Not even if we wanted to. No logs. No leaks. No guesswork. Just privacy you can prove.
Other VPNs ask for trust. They run closed-source servers. They say they delete logs. You just have to believe them. VPnet is different. We don’t ask for trust. We use a zero-trust design backed by hardware-level isolation. Your identity and traffic are separated inside secure enclaves, meaning even we can’t see your connections. No human, no admin, no third party. No exceptions.

VPnet was built by engineers behind some of the most trusted privacy infrastructure in the world. We believe privacy isn’t something you should hope for. It’s something you should be able to prove.
Install VPnet. Tap to connect. See your Verified Privacy™ hash and know your traffic is safe.
Don’t trust. Verify.
Also available on macOS, iOS, iPadOS, Windows, and Linux. Supports up to 5 simultaneous connections.

• 5 simultaneous connections
• Unlimited bandwidth
• Access to our global Verified Privacy Network
• Access to our all our apps

• Your subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your App Store Account Settings.

bluejetty:00138716:ios.description:
Додаток "Кабінет продавця Prom.ua" дозволить вам легко керувати своїм інтернет-магазином в будь-який зручний час! Ви більше не будете прив'язані до робочого комп'ютера або місця, а можете продавати і заробляти буквально "на ходу"

Створюйте товари відразу з телефону, використовуючи камеру. Push-повідомлення дозволять миттєво дізнаватися про надходження нових замовлень, а чат - спілкуватися з потенційними клієнтами в режимі реального часу.
З мобільним кабінетом від Prom.ua тепер зручно і легко розвивати свій бізнес з будь-якої точки світу.
Статистика
Переглядайте кількість отриманих та виконаних замовлень, відвідувачів або переглянутих сторінок
Слідкуйте за трендами вашого бізнесу, легко порівнюючи дані за попередні тижні або місяці
Контролюйте свої рекламні кампанії ProSale, завдяки оперативній статистиці та можливості поповнення в 1 клік
Замовлення
Переглядайте список ваших замовлень і кожен зі статусів замовлень окремо
Шукайте замовлення так як вам зручно - по номеру замовлення або навіть по імені клієнта
Майте можливість швидко опрацьовувати замовлення і зв'язуватися з клієнтом відразу зі списку замовлень
При необхідності, можете створювати замовлення самостійно або редагувати існуючі
Миттєво опрацьовуйте замовлення, просто змахнувши його справа наліво в списку замовлень
Відправляйте реквізити або транспортну накладну своїм клієнтам безпосередньо з замовлення по смс або email
Зв'яжіться зі своїми клієнтами безпосередньо з екрану їх замовлення по телефону
Клієнти
Знаходьте потрібних клієнтів по імені або email
Швидко переглядайте інформацію про клієнта (телефон, email та історію замовлень)
Просто клікніть на номер телефону або email, щоб зв'язатися з клієнтом
Залишайте відгук або оцініть клієнта за допомогою рейтингу, щоб інші компанії мали про клієнта більше інформації
Створюйте замовлення відразу з профілю клієнта, якщо з'явилася така необхідність
Імпортуйте потрібні контакти зі своєї телефонної книги
Товари
Переглядайте список своїх товарів та оновлюйте їх в 1 клік
Створюйте товари в будь-який зручний момент за допомогою камери вашого телефону
Легко знаходьте потрібний товар за назвою або артикулем
Редагуйте вже існуючі товари
Додаткові корисні функції
Зручний перехід між вашими магазинами, не покидаючи додатка
Менеджер вашої компанії завжди радий допомогти, його контакти ми розмістили в розділі "Магазин"
Зворотній зв'язок та підтримка
Ви завжди можете поділитися своєю думкою або залишити відгук про роботу додатка в спеціальному блоці "Написати нам", розміщеному в розділі "Магазин"

bluejetty:00185085:ios.name: My Widgets
bluejetty:00185085:ios.summary:
Thanks to this application (and the other Widget apps from PacoLabs), you can now customize the Home screen and the Today view of your device, by adding custom widgets for some specific purposes.
From anywhere in your device, you'll have ac
bluejetty:00185085:ios.description:
Thanks to this application (and the other Widget apps from PacoLabs), you can now customize the Home screen and the Today view of your device, by adding custom widgets for some specific purposes.
From anywhere in your device, you'll have access to your own information and actions.
Add various widgets for your different needs.
You can, for instance, add a calendar that will display the current month and the busy days.
You can add your favorite photos of your beloved family and friends.
You can add your horoscope, a photo of the day (from the internet), some audio notes, some world clocks and more...
The application contains some free widgets like the Note widget allowing you to quickly view and edit some text notes and reminders and the Decision widget allowing you to randomly choose one item among several choices.
Each other widget type can be tried and can be unlocked separately.
You can also unlock all the current and future widget types at once, if you are a widget addict !
Those Widgets are compatible with the new iOS 14 Home Screen Widgets.
The application is really easy to use and is adapted to the fresh look of your device.
Dark mode of iOS13 is supported.
In Today view:
You can add as many widgets as you want and they will be displayed in up to 3 different lists. Those same lists will be available in the Today view and in the application (although it is possible, if you want, to hide some widgets in the Today view).
To avoid overloading the Today view, when too many widgets are displayed, an intuitive control will allow you to navigate from one widget to another.
Even if the main purpose of the app is to view the widgets in the Today view, it can also be very handy to view them directly in the application (a long press on a widget in the Today view will open it directly in the main application).

bluejetty:00172359:ios.description:
India’s largest Newspaper Group “Dainik Bhaskar” brings to you a slick, fast & smooth News app for the latest news in Hindi, Hindi e-newspaper & Video News about your town. 
Dainik Bhaskar is India’s leading newsgroup in Hindi. We have extensive coverage of 2000+ cities across the country. We are the leading news source for coverage for all cities of Madhya Pradesh (MP), Rajasthan, Bihar, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh and Himachal. 
List of cities that we cover include Jaipur, Gwalior, Jodhpur, Indore, Bhopal, Alwar, Kota, Sikar, Bharatpur, Udaipur, Raipur, Surat, Ajmer, Pali, New Delhi, NCR, Patna, Nagaur, Sri Ganganagar, Jhunjhunu, Bikaner, Sagar, Ujjain, Bilaspur, Dausa, Sawai Madhopur, Bhilwara, Ratlam, Karauli, Shivpuri, Hisar, Tonk, Panipat, Bhind, Morena, Barmer, Churu, Chandigarh, Ranchi, Khandwa, Bhilai, Dholpur, Hoshangabad, Chittorgarh, Bundi, Dhar, Rohtak, Jhalore, Rewari. 
Find all the news that matters from these categories - Local (City & Town), National, Global, Business, Sports, Health, Lifestyle, Tech & Auto. Get all the latest video updates.
Feature List:
City News: Dainik Bhaskar brings to you news from over 2000+ towns & cities to your phone. You will never miss out on what is happening around you or in your hometown. You will get updates on all the local current events like politics, weather, traffic, crimes, accidents, etc.
Video News: Get all the updates about Local (City & Town), National, Global, Business, Sports, Health, Lifestyle, Tech & Auto in your preferred video formats. Watch all the latest news through short videos. You can share news videos with friends & family
Epaper: Read the latest Hindi News epaper from your city. Get access to 200+ epapers editions all from till a year back for free. Download the epaper & read it anytime you want. 
Politics: Stay updated with all the latest news about politics from across the country. Get access to everything said by all the leading politicians from Narendra Modi to Rahul Gandhi. Be informed about all the policies & promises of leading political parties like the Bharatiya Janta Party (BJP), Indian National Congress (INC), TMC, BSP, SP, etc. 
Business: Get all the updates from the Business world with coverage of Share Market, SENSEX, BSE, NSE, NIFTY, Trading News, IPO, Gold Rate, Today’s Dollar Rate, Today’s Rupee Rate, Startups, SMEs, etc. We have merged our Business app “Money Bhaskar” within this app & now we have the most detailed coverage of the Business industry 
Sports: We bring to you all the latest sports updates, live cricket scores. Stay up to date with what your favorite athletes like Virat Kohli, M.S Dhoni are up to.
Bollywood: Stay updated with all the latest Bollywood gossips, rumors & reviews. Always remain on top of all the trends, see what your favorite stars like Salman, Shahrukh, Priyanka, Deepika & Akshay are doing. 
Rashifal: Get daily astrology & horoscope updates about Lovelife, career, health, wealth & more from well-known experts like Bejan Daruwalla, get Tarot card updates from Sheela M. Bajaj & know all about your numerology from Dr. Kumar Ganesh. 
Notification: Get the latest news notifications & breaking news alerts.
If you subscribe to Dainik Bhaskar via iTunes, payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and your membership will automatically renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscription will be renewed within 24-hours before the end of each period at the rate of your selected plan. Turn off auto-renewal anytime through iTunes.
Privacy policy: https://epaper.bhaskar.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://www.bhaskar.com/__widgets__/terms-and-conditions
No Fake News: Stay away from all the rumors circulating on Whatsapp. We give you the truth behind all the fake news 
Visit our site: dainikbhaskar.com
Other websites:

divyamarathi.bhaskar.com

ABOUT LIVESCHOOL
Bring out the best in your students—and your school — with LiveSchool.
Schools across the world use LiveSchool to reinforce good behavior with great rewards. Our real-time engagement tracking, digital points system, and community-building tools help your team create a school-wide feedback loop that drives positive culture. 
LiveSchool helps teams easily run school wide culture initiatives like PBIS, SEL, RTI, MTSS and more. Engage your students, enhance your culture!
***
LIVESCHOOL ON THE GO
The LiveSchool for Educators mobile app helps teachers and educators reward points to students on the go. Use it anywhere in your building, or in sync with your projector or whiteboard. 
- Give points to any student or groups of students as you move around the classroom or building.
- Motivate students with powerful synced notifications between your mobile device and your projector.
- Use simple classroom management tools like the Randomizer to save time and run an efficient classroom.
- Run your school rewards store from a mobile device.
- Review powerful student, teacher, or school data dashboards. Measure your school's culture initiatives, or provide helpful data in student and parent conferences.
- Run your school's House Points system. Pull up a real-time House Points dashboard on the go.
***
GO BEYOND BEHAVIOR TRACKING
Recognize, incentivize, and promote a positive school culture with points and rewards that inspire student participation.

bluejetty:00147472:ios.description:
For over 15 years Wine Spies has been a leading source of incredible wine deals. This app brings all the features of our desktop website to your phone, and makes it easier than ever to order wine quickly and manage your account from anywhere.
With our app you’ll be first to know when a new offer lands each day. You’ll get access to secret app-only deals not available on our desktop site. You can use our instant checkout to snag a deal before it’s gone (many sell out very quickly!) with one click in just seconds.
Plus you can enjoy the convenience and flexibility of our Locker feature. With Lockers you’ll never pay for expensive shipping again. You can build a case of wine, one or two bottles at a time, and consolidate multiple purchases into a single shipment. Store up to two cases of wine in our temperature controlled warehouse and ship them for free at your convenience.
About Wine Spies
Wine Spies is located in Sonoma Valley and every day we feature one carefully sourced wine at the lowest price you’ll find anywhere.
We source all kinds of wines across a wide range of styles and prices; from small boutique wineries in our backyard and 100-point rarities from Napa, to importing our own favorites - you never know what will show up each day.
No matter the wine, you can trust it’s the highest quality. We’re extremely picky, and choose only the most outstanding examples to share with you. If you ever run into a problem of any kind, our excellent customer support team will take care to reach a positive resolution.
Download it today and never miss another great deal again.

bluejetty:00141450:ios.description:
Filmic Remote v3 is now called Remote Legacy. Filmic Remote v4 is now integrated directly into Filmic Pro v7.5. 
Remote Legacy is designed for use with Filmic Pro v7.4.2 and earlier (including Filmic Legacy). It offers wireless control and monitoring of your Filmic Pro experience. Filmic Remote puts your spare iOS devices into the production process.
Remote v3 offers three modes of capability: Control, Monitor and Director.
Control mode provides the familiar Filmic Pro interface for complete remote camera control over hard to reach camera placements such as sliders, jib arms, car mounts, microphone stand or other compelling live event camera placements. Set up your Filmic Pro device and then control all settings and recordings from the Remote:
- Start/Stop record functions.
- Focus/exposure reticle placement and locking.
- Dual arc slider manual controls for focus and exposure.
- Pull-to-point focus and exposure pulls.
- Create and load Filmic Pro presets from Filmic Remote.
Monitor mode gives you cinema production capability for a fraction of the cost, offering a four-up display with the following powerful analytics:
- Video preview: Reference video for use with analytics screens.
- Waveform monitor: Visually identifies signal brightness segmented from left to right across a video feed. Used in conjunction with the video preview it can provide a quick snapshot of brightness in your video.
- Vectorscope: Displays color saturation, by channel, across the entire image.
- Histograms: RGB composite, Luminance, Zone and RGB channel. 
Director mode provides a clean video preview. This is perfect for providing a director, producer or crew with a device to monitor the production remotely. 
You can switch between modes on the fly to check analytics and composition. Remote can also be set up in ‘preview-only’ mode allowing a camera operator to perform all controls from the device running Filmic Pro and allowing the Remote to be used solely for monitoring.
Create your mobile studio today with Filmic Remote!
Notes: 
- The use of Filmic Remote on one iOS device requires the simultaneous use of Filmic Pro on an additional device. Both devices must be running iOS 13 or later.
- Filmic Remote connects to Filmic Pro using Wi-Fi either on an established network or using a peer-to-peer network (for using in areas where a Wi-Fi network is not present).
- Filmic Remote can connect to any iPhone or iPad running Filmic Pro and is not cross platform.

Ready to train your brain? Tile Link - Pair Match Games is a pair matching puzzle game with various challenging levels.
Find the matching tiles, connect the pairs with up to 3 lines. Remove all tile pairs before the time is over. Exercise your brain and become a tile matching master level by level. Enjoy the puzzle collections of lovely animals, yummy fruits, interesting professions, exciting emojis, and more.

Tile Link is the most challenging and sparkling game among the free puzzle genres, especially the ones that have onet connect game mechanics. This game is great for your memory! - Well-designed challenging levels
- Hint & shuffle boosters
- Various Tile collections
- Classic onet connect game mechanics
- Boost brain functions like memory, focus, attention, and concentration.

- Match all Tiles from the board and finish the puzzle before the time is over.
- Find two identical tiles on board and tap on them to connect.
- Connect the tiles on board with up to 3 lines and no other tiles blocking the line path.

bluejetty:00151759:ios.description:
Smart Logic Puzzle - Relaxing Brain Game
Train your brain with smart logic puzzles designed to improve focus, thinking, and problem-solving skills. This relaxing brain game offers a calm yet challenging puzzle experience where every move matters.
Perfect for fans of logic puzzles, brain games, and relaxing puzzle games, this game lets you play without timers, stress, or pressure. Analyze each board, plan your moves carefully, and clear the maze step by step using pure logic.
As you progress, levels become more challenging, requiring strategic thinking, spatial awareness, and smart decision-making.
Why Play This Logic Puzzle Game?
• Brain Training Game
Improve concentration, planning, and logical thinking with carefully designed brain puzzles.
• Relaxing Puzzle Experience
No time limits, no stress. Play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, satisfying gameplay flow.
• Strategic Gameplay
Every move counts. One wrong decision can block your path, so think ahead and choose wisely.
• Play Anytime, Anywhere
Enjoy quick puzzle sessions or longer brain-training moments, perfect for breaks or focused play.
• Simple Controls, Smart Design
Easy to play, challenging to master. Each level is a compact logic challenge that rewards smart thinking.
Key Features
• Addictive logic puzzle and brain game mechanics
• Relaxing and stress-free gameplay
• Gradually increasing difficulty
• Clean and minimalist puzzle design
• Handcrafted levels for strategic solutions
• Offline play, enjoy anywhere, anytime
A Calm Yet Challenging Brain Puzzle Game
Whether you want to relax, train your brain, or enjoy smart puzzle challenges, this logic puzzle game delivers a rewarding and satisfying experience.
Think smart. Stay focused. Clear every maze.
Download now and enjoy one of the most relaxing logic puzzle brain games on the App Store.

bluejetty:00140068:ios.summary:
The portal of despair opens again. The labyrinth calls you to destruction. Revel in the endless dangers, relish the risk, devour the rewards.
Savor the risk.
Wizardry Variants Daphne carries on the lineage of the classic RPG series, Wizar
bluejetty:00140068:ios.description:
The portal of despair opens again. The labyrinth calls you to destruction. Revel in the endless dangers, relish the risk, devour the rewards.
Savor the risk.
Wizardry Variants Daphne carries on the lineage of the classic RPG series, Wizardry. The portal to the labyrinth of despair, where even destruction is pleasure, has opened once again.
■ Story
Once every 100 years, the Abyss opens.
It is a curse of death that consumes the continent. A Warlock who coveted Death, devoured people and animals and enveloped the world in despair.
Inheriting the power to seal the Abyss over generations, kings have continued to protect the kingdom from its curse.
But now, the king has vanished, and the world is being consumed by death, moment by moment.
Resistance itself is meaningless.
There is naught but to perish.
■ Adventure with allies
Experience an adventure of your very own with unique allies based on combinations of classes and races.
■ Difficulty with a bite
Perilous traps and mighty foes await in the dungeon. Take on a high difficulty that only Wizardry can offer.
■ Intuitive Controls
Play a full 3D dungeon anytime, anywhere, with one hand on your upright smartphone.
■ Cadre of renowned creators
Main Character Design: Yusuke Kozaki
Manga artist and illustrator; in addition to writing manga, he also does design work for anime and games, and is well known for the fine touches in his character designs.
Boss Monster Design: Katsuya Terada
His work, centered on manga and illustration, includes character designs video games and movies, as well as poster for theater productions.
Sound: Hitoshi Sakimoto
Has composed for more than 130 game titles of all genres. With their rich sound and epic scale, his scores have received tremendous support not only in Japan, but also from overseas.
■ Magnificent cast brings the fully-voiced scenario to life
[English Voice Actors]
Lulunarde: Morgan Cambs
Pulgritte: Dev Joshi
Dylanhardt: Doug Cockle
Elmon: Laurence Bouvard
Vernant: Christopher Ragland
Pickerel: Alex Capon
Leaufonde: Garrick Hagon
Shagtis of Sorrow: Jay Rincon
- Other Voice Actors, etc. -
Beth Robb Adams, Mike Bodie, Sarah Borges, Davis Brooks, Shin-Fei Chen, Doug Cockle, Clare Corbett, Arlene Decker, Sarah Galbraith, Garrick Hagon, Arina Ii, Jules de Jongh, Dev Joshi, Samantha Kamras, Rae Lim,Elsie Lovelock, Meaghan Martin, Gianni Matragrano, Joseph May, Alexander McMorran, Eric Meyers, Sarah Pitard, Christopher Ragland, Matt Reeves, Jay Rincon, Cecily Bednar Schmidt, Kerry Shale, Martin T Sherman, Adam Sims, Ina Marie Smith, Colin Stinton, Alex Vincent, Alexandra Vincent, Glenn Wrage -- Other appearances (in alphabetical order)
[Japanese Voice Actors]
Lulunarde: Inori Minase
Pulgritte: Yui Ishikawa
Dylanhardt: Chikahiro Kobayashi
Elmon: Satomi Korogi
Vernant: Yoshimasa Hosoya
Pickerel: Junya Enoki
Leaufonde: Takaya Hashi
Shagtis of Sorrow: Takehito Koyasu
■What is Wizardry?
Wizardry is a computer role-playing game released in the United States in 1981 with elements such as party organizing, labyrinth exploration, monster fighting, and character development having such a tremendous impact on the various RPGs that followed, that it is often referred to as the origin of RPGs. Numerous sequels have been released, and nearly 40 years after its release, it remains a timeless masterpiece that enjoys strong popularity around the world.

bluejetty:00158285:ios.description:
Parkour on exciting levels in bhop and surf modes with great graphics and a cs go case simulator!
In the game you will see more than 50 levels in several game modes, neon cyberpunk style and modern graphics with excellent optimization.
If you like collecting cs go skins, then this game is for you! The store contains dozens of cases and more than 250 different skins with rarity from simple to legendary!
Gameplay:
In the parkour mode "Bhop" you need to jump, maneuver and control your speed. Be careful and try not to fall, compete with other players in the speed of passing and enjoy the incredible parkour from cs go!
In the "Surf" mode, you need to hold the player on triangular platforms and perform parkour tricks. Slide and jump on ramps to complete the levels.
If you want to get cases, you can do this in the game store!
And if you have mastered it well, you can try to earn game achievements: there are more than 300 of them and they are very different! Somewhere you have to complete a parkour level in the allotted time, somewhere you have to score a certain number of points or find a secret with a valuable reward! For each achievement you will receive a reward!
And when you collect a sufficient number of game achievements in CS: Surf GO - Parkour and Bhop, you can go to the game store to open cases with legendary knives, you can collect a collection of more than 250 different skins, such as a karambit, a butterfly knife or m9, so that your parkour looks as epic as possible!
If you want to really test your parkour skills in cs:go, then play the endless mode, it is available in both the "Bhop" and "Surf" versions, try to complete as many stages as possible, but remember - with each completed level, the parkour will become faster and more difficult! Set records and get incredible rewards and achievements for completing the endless parkour cs go.
Surf GO has many gameplay features:
- Neon cyberpunk levels!
- Modern graphics and excellent optimization!
- 7 game modes: you will definitely find the gameplay that you like!
- Case simulator and more than 250 different skins, such as a karambit or a butterfly knife
- Several mini-games
- Ratings and achievements
- Completing the game and getting all the achievements will keep you busy for a long time!
- Constant updates
Play Surf GO parkour, complete levels in normal and endless modes, open cs go cases, farm skins, get achievements and enjoy the graphics!
Website: https://denis22718.github.io
Support: deniskotpletnev@gmail.com

bluejetty:00138581:ios.description:
Voice Recorder: AI Note Taker captures every idea and meeting in crystal-clear audio with instant AI - record, transcribe, and summarize in one easy step.
Whether you’re in a business meeting, class lecture, interview, or podcast, transcribe dramatically faster than manual note-taking, instantly and accurately, with no typing required, so you never miss a single word. Loved by students, journalists, and professionals worldwide, it captures every detail in real time and creates clean, shareable text the moment you stop recording. 
Never miss a word again - start recording, transcribing, and summarizing with Voice Recorder: AI Note Taker today!
Key Features:
Effortless Recording
• Quickly and easily record and transcribe important content.
• Ensuring no detail is missed in your conversations and experiences.
• Automatically manage and name your recordings for easy organization.
Transcription Excellence
• Easily turn spoken content into written text from live speech or uploaded videos.
• Powered by advanced AI models including Whisper for on-device mobile offline privacy and offline use, ASR for real-time transcription, and Nova-3 for fast, multi-language transcription，ensuring high accuracy and versatility.
• Support multi-language note-taking and efficiently share speech-to-text content.
AI Note Taker
• Instantly summarize long recordings into clear, actionable AI-powered notes and summaries to save time, powered by cutting-edge AI models and designed to handle diverse tasks and complex scenarios.
- Google Gemini 3.1 Flash for long-text processing
- OpenAI GPT-5 for general tasks
- DeepSeek V4.0 for Chinese-specific scenarios
• Turn voice notes into organized to-do lists and highlights that are easy to review, share, and collaborate on.
• Draft polished emails from audio content to streamline communication and boost team productivity.
Folder Management
• Organize your transcribed audio recordings into custom folders for easy access and efficient management. 
• Create, rename, and move files to structure your voice notes intuitively.
• Move recordings between folders seamlessly to ensure all your audio files are categorized according to your needs.
Mastering Audio Editing
• Easily trim and cut your audio recordings to remove unwanted parts or create seamless transitions.
• Preserve original sound quality with advanced editing options - including optional reverse audio for creative needs.
Listen and Share
• Customize playback speed for efficient review of AI note summaries and transcriptions.
• Share multiple recordings in MP3, M4A, and WAV formats with ease.
• Effortlessly collaborate by sending transcribed text and audio files in various formats, including shareable links, to colleagues and friends.
Multi-Language Support
• Automatic recognition for accurate transcription and understanding of multiple languages.

bluejetty:00031950:android.description:
Money Clash is real-time strategy game - bank wars. Conquer the towers and expand your territory by increasing the number of banks - transfer cash from one bank to another and attack rival banks and takeover them.
Money Clash is a tower defense game that will immerse you in a world where cash is troops. With strategic gameplay and intense money clashes, it delivers an adrenaline-pumping experience that will keep you hooked for hours. Prepare yourself for a thrilling journey as you strive to dominate the financial landscape.
In Money Clash, money is not just a means to an end; it's the lifeblood of your success. Your goal is to accumulate wealth, build a powerful empire, and establish your dominance over other players. The clash of fortunes is inevitable as ambitious enemies like yourself vie for control and strive for takeover all competitors.
As a player, you will engage in real-time strategy battles, where careful planning and quick decision-making are crucial. Strategically allocate your resources, deploy your forces, and seize lucrative opportunities to expand your influence. Every move counts as you navigate through a dynamic environment, constantly adapting to the changing tides of the game.
How to play Money Clash: Conquer Bank
* Swipe to draw a line from your tower to others with the target banks and increase the number of cash.
* Find elegant tactical solutions to lift your enemies to crush your opponents bank
* Plan your moves and try to capture all the banks. When all the towers are occupied by your cash. You WIN the game.
* You have to stay sharp and focused to master the battlefield.
Features of Money Clash: Cash Takeover
* Free to play
* Hyper casual gameplay makes you relax.
* This tower game is easy to manage and includes
* Boosters that will come in handy in the fiercest battles
* Hundreds of challenging levels for your bank building and takeover expansion dreams.
*Train your brain with real-time strategic gameplay.
* Simple rules, but very addictive
In Money Clash, cash, money, and clash are not mere words; they are the essence of your journey. Embrace the thrill of the game, master the art of financial warfare, and prove yourself as the ultimate tycoon. Are you ready to rise to the top and establish your reign in this world of financial conquest? Join the clash now and let the battle for wealth begin!

It's an all-new era of digital soccer: "PES" has now evolved into "eFootball™"! And now you can experience the next generation of soccer gaming with "eFootball™"!
■ Welcoming Newcomers
After downloading, you can learn the basic controls of the game via a step-by-step tutorial that includes practical demonstrations! Complete them all, and receive Lionel Messi!
We have also added the Smart Assist setting to help users enjoy the fun and excitement of playing matches, even if they are new to the game.
Without entering complex commands, get past the opposing defense with a brilliant dribble or pass, then score a goal with a powerful shot.

Friend Matches and Co-op Matches with up to three a side are also in store. So get together with some friends and have a blast.

Build up your team and play thrilling matches based on the latest happenings in the world of soccer.

Add color to the game by arranging your stadium however you like!

New features, modes, events, and gameplay improvements will be continuously implemented.

[Downloading the Game]
Approximately 3.5 GB of free storage space is required to download and install eFootball™.

We also recommend that you use a Wi-Fi connection to download the base game and any of its updates.
[Online Connectivity]

bluejetty:00120125:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00120125:ios.description:
Flexge é uma metodologia de ensino de inglês totalmente interativa, construída exclusivamente para Centros de Idiomas e Instituições de Ensino Fundamental, Médio e Superior.
Na Flexge o aluno trabalha as 4 habilidades linguísticas de modo empolgante e eficiente, priorizando fala e escuta em inglês. A fala do aluno é comparada com a pronúncia de mais de cem nativos através da nossa poderosa ferramenta de reconhecimento de fala.
O aprendizado de qualquer idioma ocorre pelo desenvolvimento das 4 habilidades linguísticas, isto é, ouvir, falar, ler e escrever. Contudo, os métodos tradicionais de ensino de inglês trabalham com muito maior ênfase a leitura e a escrita do que a escuta e a fala. Tal situação decorre de o ensino ser focado na resolução de exercícios em livros didáticos, acarretando em maior insegurança do aluno para situações de conversação.
Através da união entre a tecnologia e o coach em sala de aula, conseguimos que o aluno ganhe confiança para se expressar cada vez mais em inglês, tornando o aprendizado ativo e significativo.
A Flexge promove a personalização do ensino através da aplicação de ensino híbrido (blended learning), combinando uso da plataforma online com as atividades regulares em sala de aula.
Os desafios propostos pela Flexge fazem com que o aluno estude inglês continuamente fora do ambiente escolar, podendo utilizar o momento da sala de aula para dinâmicas de conversação e suporte pedagógico de seu coach.
Na Flexge o aluno estuda inglês de maneira ativa. Através de um avançado sistema de reconhecimento de voz, o aluno fala inglês desde a primeira unidade e compara sua pronúncia com a fala de mais de 100 nativos de diferentes localidades.
A metodologia Flexge estimula a fala em inglês fornecendo feedback objetivo ao aluno sobre seu desempenho nesta habilidade. O foco é na aprendizagem personalizada onde cada aluno faz exercícios de acordo com o seu nível de inglês, permitindo que, numa sala de aula com diferentes níveis de proficiência, os alunos possam receber o estímulo adequado para ganharem confiança com o idioma.
Certificados de Inglês de Padrão Internacional
A metodologia Flexge está alinhada com o sistema de proficiência de idiomas do Quadro Comum Europeu, compreendido pelos níveis A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 e C2.
Os alunos podem cursar a disciplina de Inglês de maneira personalizada, de acordo com o nível pessoal de proficiência, e seguindo os parâmetros internacionais do idioma. Além disso, que recebam certificados a cada novo nível de inglês conquistado! É isso que a Todo conteúdo pedagógico da Flexge segue o Quadro Comum Europeu de Referência para Línguas, inclusive os testes de certificação. Assim, o estudo de inglês se torna algo vivencial e palpável onde o aluno sempre possui metas muito claras para alcançar novos níveis de proficiência.
Construída especificamente para instituições de ensino, nossa metodologia atende os diferentes atores do processo educacional, visando a aquisição da fluência em inglês num ambiente diversificado como uma sala de aula.

bluejetty:00060311:ios.summary:
We took over 35 years of traffic ticket-fighting experience and combined it with a redesigned app experience for 2026
Need help with any type of traffic ticket? Fast, reliable, and professional assistance for a speeding ticket, suspended
bluejetty:00060311:ios.description:
We took over 35 years of traffic ticket-fighting experience and combined it with a redesigned app experience for 2026
Need help with any type of traffic ticket? Fast, reliable, and professional assistance for a speeding ticket, suspended license, or other type of violation is just a few taps away. The Ticket Clinic has resolved millions of cases nationwide and counting. Let us help with your case via our convenient and powerful traffic ticket-fighting app! 
=== How it works ===
1) Scan your license or enter contact info
2) Answer a few questions about your ticket
3) Get Quote / Submit Payment
4) Standby for notifications such as your dismissal notice
In non-criminal, civil cases, our attorneys will go to court for you. Also, we have a full staff of legal assistants on standby if you have any questions. Just tap the call now button in the app.
The Ticket Clinic Difference
We Are A Law Firm
Many of our competitors are not real law firms! They are tech startups with no legal experience or attorneys on staff. It says so right in their disclaimer. They will just sell your case to another attorney in the area and take a fee for being the “middle-man.” Any matter that could affect your license needs to be taken seriously and handled with care. Who are you going to trust?
Our Track Record
We’re one of the first law firms ever to focus solely on traffic offenses. In our home state of FL, we have a 98% success rate. Our firm has been on the driver’s side since 1987 and shows no sign of slowing down.
Support By Humans
Technology is great, but we understand that when it comes to sensitive matters that could impact someone’s driving privileges, you might want to speak to a real person. For this reason, we have a support staff taking calls Monday - Sunday: 8:00am - 8:00pm. Just tap the call button in the app to speak with a real human during our business hours.
Why Should You Download Our App?
1) Utilize convenient features such as the license scanner, notifications and unlock phone-only promotions
2) Instantly check the details and status of your case quickly without a computer
3) Hire our experience traffic ticket attorneys without having to spend time on the phone
4) More traffic ticket fighting features coming soon
