bluejetty:00016240:ios.summary: The classic card game Cribbage also known as Crib, Cribble, and Noddy. A card game traditionally for two players, that involves playing and grouping cards in combinations which gain points. Cribbage has several distinctive features: the cri
bluejetty:00016240:ios.description:
The classic card game Cribbage also known as Crib, Cribble, and Noddy. A card game traditionally for two players, that involves playing and grouping cards in combinations which gain points. Cribbage has several distinctive features: the cribbage board used for score keeping, the crib, box, or kitty, a separate hand counting for the dealer, two distinct scoring stages (the play and the show), aces low, and a unique scoring system including points for groups of cards that total fifteen (15).
This Cribbage mobile app lets you play the classic card game Cribage anywhere without needing your wooden Cribbage pegging board. You can play online or even offline. The playing cards are large so Grandpa will have no trouble playing his favorite board game. All the scoring is automatic using the built-in calculator including a breakdown of the point details, so no need for Muggins or Shotgun Cribbage. 
Are you ready to skunk your family in one of the most popular card games created in the 17th century? The rules of Cribbage are built in making it easy to learn how to play Cribbage / Cribble.
This app track all your statistic including your hand, crib, pegging average, max, and life time point totals. Never get board with the plethora of achievements to master the perfect hand with a flush, pairs, three of a kind, 15, and super combos. Play at any difficultly: Easy, Medium, Hard, or Crazy Ninja. 
This multiplayer game classically plays 2 players in a head to head battle like Speed, Nertz, Canasta, Pinochle, Solitaire Showdown, Backgammon, and Gin Rummy, but only Cribbage is played with a cribbage pegboard.

bluejetty:00183478:ios.description:
WestStar Credit Union is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with WestStar Credit Union:
-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of 
receipts and checks.
 -Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
 -Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 -Transfer money between your accounts
 -Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
 -Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 -View and save your monthly statements
 -Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the WestStar Credit Union Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a WestStar Credit Union Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00155198:ios.summary:
Learn English and Kurdish through pictures, pronunciation, and everyday practice with ESL Kurd. The app is free, with no subscription required.
Explore vocabulary organized by subjects and topics, from home and food to travel, education, a
bluejetty:00155198:ios.description:
Learn English and Kurdish through pictures, pronunciation, and everyday practice with ESL Kurd. The app is free, with no subscription required.
Explore vocabulary organized by subjects and topics, from home and food to travel, education, and sports. Colourful 3D illustrations make words easier to recognize, while Kurdish vocabulary recordings voiced by a native speaker help you listen and repeat. Save words to revisit later and explore definitions suited to their subject and topic.
Learn useful phrases in Conversations, with 284 everyday examples across 27 topics. Practice shopping, ordering food, asking for directions, visiting the dentist, meeting new people, using computers, and more. Each example has its own illustration and saved English and Sorani audio. Switch between English and Latin-script Sorani, listen again, and move through examples at your own pace. Conversations audio is AI-generated.
Translate text between English, Kurdish Sorani, and Kurmanji using Google Translate. Copy text from either box and revisit previous translations in your history.
Build your skills in the Practice Hub with picture quizzes, listening activities, word matching, memory games, sentence completion, and spelling challenges. Practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division with Quick Math, then review your results and mistakes.
Browse supported vocabulary screens in English, Sorani, Kurmanji, or Latin-script Sorani, which provides a pronunciation guide. Enjoy layouts designed for both phones and tablets.
Whether you are a student, teacher, traveller, or curious learner, ESL Kurd helps you practice a little every day.
An internet connection is required for online images, audio, and translation.

bluejetty:00176099:ios.description:
Download the Arlington Transportation app to access On-Demand service — a public ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, affordable, and green.
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way.
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up on a nearby corner.
- Share your ride with others.
- Save cash and reduce carbon emissions. 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our corner-to-corner algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Questions? Reach out at support-arn@ridewithvia.com. Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00094918:ios.name: SpeakerTools: Sound Toolkit
bluejetty:00094918:ios.summary:
Need to check your speaker or monitor noise levels and sound quality?
SpeakerTools: Sound Toolkit is an all-in-one audio utility that helps enhance speaker clarity, generate custom sound frequencies, test your phone’s audio performance, and
bluejetty:00094918:ios.description:
Need to check your speaker or monitor noise levels and sound quality?
SpeakerTools: Sound Toolkit is an all-in-one audio utility that helps enhance speaker clarity, generate custom sound frequencies, test your phone’s audio performance, and accurately measure ambient noise in real time. Beyond troubleshooting and sound management, it also offers soothing sounds designed to support relaxation and mental well-being.
Some features require an active subscription or in-app purchase.
Paid features are clearly marked within the app.
1. Audio Tools to Improve Speaker Clarity (Water, Dust & Sand Cleaning)
Over time, speakers may lose clarity due to trapped moisture, dust, or sand - especially after exposure to water or outdoor environments like the beach. Our high-frequency sound wave tool emits targeted signals designed to help dislodge water droplets, fine particles, or debris, which may restore clearer sound. This method is commonly used to clean earbuds and phones affected by water or clogged with dust. Results may vary by device, but it’s a fast and simple step that can make a noticeable difference. You can also activate monthly cleaning reminders - a helpful habit to extend your speaker’s lifespan and performance.
2. Sound Wellness & Mental Clarity Tools
Go beyond hardware fixes and explore sound as a tool for wellness. Use calming mental tones like ambient soundscapes, white noise, or low-frequency waves to support relaxation, sleep, and focus. Whether you're winding down, meditating, or boosting concentration, these tones help create a balanced mind.
Learn how sound affects your sleep, concentration, and overall well-being.
3. Speaker Testing & Volume Boost
Run stereo speaker tests to check left/right channel output, identify distortion, or assess overall clarity. Use the Volume Boost tool to stimulate deeper speaker output. It's a great way to test how your phone handles different audio ranges and troubleshoot hardware inconsistencies.
4. Accurate Noise & dB Meter
Monitor your environment with precision. The built-in noise meter measures ambient sounds in decibels (dB), helping you track exposure to loud environments at home, work, or outdoors. Useful for checking room acoustics, detecting noise pollution, or managing volume levels to protect your hearing.
5. Custom Frequency Generator: 0Hz - 22,000Hz
Generate clean sine waves and test tones from 0Hz to 22kHz. Ideal for audio equipment testing, hearing checks, sound therapy, pet training (like dog whistles), or relaxation techniques. Experiment with different frequencies to explore the power of sound in your space.
6. Photo Logging of Noise Events
Take a photo while recording a decibel reading. Each photo is automatically timestamped and overlaid with the dB level, letting you document noisy environments, workplace exposure, or sound levels at concerts or events. Perfect for personal tracking or official reporting.
Why Choose SpeakerTools: Sound Toolkit?
• High-frequency sound tools to help clear your speaker of water, dust, and sand
• Accurate real-time decibel meter for everyday use
• Full-range frequency generator for testing and sound exploration
• Simple diagnostics to improve your phone’s audio performance
• Boost and testing tools that may help fix speaker issues
• Photo-based dB logging - unique and convenient
• Educational content to support hearing wellness
• Relaxing tones and soundscapes for mental clarity and focus
Download now and take full control of your audio space - whether you're optimizing sound clarity, monitoring your surroundings, or exploring audio as a tool for wellness and technology.
Privacy Policy: https://aaapps.wixsite.com/ultraclean-sound/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://aaapps.wixsite.com/ultraclean-sound/terms-of-use-1

bluejetty:00136351:ios.description:
Welcome to Idle Tycoon Farm Game, where your agricultural empire awaits! Cultivate diverse crops, from luscious tomatoes to golden corn, and process them into delicious items like ketchup, popcorn, and flour. Become a tycoon by optimizing your farm and factory operations. Upgrade machines, unlock new crops, and watch your profits grow in this engaging idle game.
Key Features:
Cultivate a variety of crops on your virtual farm
Process crops into ketchup, popcorn, flour, and more!
Manage a factory to enhance production
Earn coins and grow your agricultural empire
Automate processes for idle income
Unlock new crops and expand your processing capabilities
Upgrade machines for maximum efficiency
Factory Processing Adventure:
Experience the thrill of managing both a farm and a processing factory! Grow your crops, process them into valuable items, and witness your profits soar. The idle gameplay lets you enjoy the satisfaction of running a farm and factory at your own pace.
Tycoon Upgrades:
Invest your earnings wisely to unlock upgrades for your machines and boost your production. Become the ultimate crop tycoon by optimizing every aspect of your agricultural and processing operations.
Discover New Processing Lines:
Unlock new processing lines as your empire expands. From ketchup factories to flour mills, each processing line offers unique challenges and opportunities. Can you master them all and become the top crop tycoon?
Download now and embark on the journey of Idle Tycoon Farm Game! Harvest, process, and build your way to becoming the most successful crop tycoon in this addictive idle game.

bluejetty:00154190:ios.description:
Get Ready for the Ultimate Puzzle Challenge!
Embark on a thrilling journey of strategic sorting and matching in this vibrant and addictive puzzle game! Combine clever planning, quick thinking, and a splash of color coordination to master each level. With its engaging gameplay and ever-increasing challenges, this game is designed to keep you hooked for hours!
________________________________________
Box Matching Mini-Game
Tap to move colorful squares between boxes, ensuring each box contains 8 Coins of the same color. Once a box is filled, it clears from the board! But be careful—every move counts, and you only have a limited number of steps to complete the level. Can you strategize your way to victory?
________________________________________
Color Coordination Strategy
Master the art of sorting and matching! Plan your moves carefully to group Coins of the same color into their designated boxes. With each level, the challenge grows, testing your ability to think ahead and maximize efficiency. It’s not just a game—it’s a brain-boosting adventure!
________________________________________
Need More Moves? No Problem!
Running low on steps? Use the game’s power-up to add extra moves and keep the fun going. This handy lifeline is your key to overcoming tricky levels and continuing your progress. Use it wisely!

bluejetty:00023167:ios.description:
Get the latest Ohio lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Powerball
- Mega Millions
- Millionaire for Life
- Classic Lotto + Kicker
- Rolling Cash 5
- Pick 3 (Midday and Evening)
- Pick 4 (Midday and Evening)
- Pick 5 (Midday and Evening)
- Keno
Powerball, Mega Millions, Millionaire for Life and Rolling Cash 5 also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00015952:ios.description:
AdventureQuest 3D MMORPG – Battle, Build, and Become a Legend
Enter a living, growing multiplayer fantasy world where you can fight dragons, build anything, and explore epic storylines — all alongside friends!
AQ3D is the cross-platform MMORPG with weekly updates, wild customization, no pay-to-win, and endless ways to play.
NEW: SANDBOX HOUSING IS HERE
Build anything you can imagine. Sandbox housing lets you:
• Place, rotate, scale, and stack items freely
• Build castles, obstacle courses, theme parks — even flying sofas
• Create personal hangouts or insane parkour challenges for friends
• It’s chaotic, creative, and completely physics-free
No blueprints. No limits. Just imagination (and probably dragons).
CREATE YOUR HERO, YOUR WAY
• Customize your character’s look and gear with over 7,000 items
• Equip any item for power or style (transmog included)
• Change classes anytime: warrior, mage, rogue, ninja, necromancer & more
• Morph into 200+ travel forms: dragons, ghosts, birds, wolves, even bushes
• Ride on our newest Mounts for fast-travel and fierce looks
Be yourself. Or something much weirder. No judgement!
FIGHT, RAID, AND EXPLORE TOGETHER
• 5-player dungeons and 20-player raids
• Open-world bosses and seasonal scaled maps
• 5v5 PvP battlegrounds and challenge fights
• Epic loot, legendary weapons, and fashionably questionable outfits await
Whether soloing in the shadows, leading your guild into battle, or climbing the ranks in PvP, there’s always a fight to win… or flee from heroically.
TRULY CROSS-PLATFORM
• One account, one world — all devices log into the same universe
• Cloud save, real-time co-op, and zero platform restrictions
• Doesn’t hog space (download size under 250MB)
Take the full MMO experience from phone to desktop and back again without missing a beat.
WEEKLY EVENTS & FREE CONTENT
We never stop updating. Expect:
• New quests, items, and gear every week
• Special events and rotating challenge content
• Player suggested updates, weird experiments, and community surprises
From Trobblemania to Mogloween, there’s always something weird happening in AQ3D.
OLD SCHOOL SOUL. MODERN DAY CHAOS.
From the creators of AdventureQuest, DragonFable, and AQWorlds comes a full 3D reimagining of the browser MMOs you loved growing up.
• Return to iconic zones like Battleon, Darkovia, Ashfall, and Doomwood
• Meet familiar NPCs (Artix, Cysero, Warlic, etc.)
• Battle classic monsters like Zards, Slimes, and dragons too big to fit on the screen
• Experience all-new story arcs built around community feedback
This is the game you would’ve skipped homework for — now rebuilt with better graphics, more memes, and way more explosives.
FAIR, FUN, AND FREE
• No pay-to-win, ever
• Free to play, forever
• Optional cosmetics, travel forms, mounts, and supporter packs
• Earn gear the old school way: by playing — not paying
We believe in rewarding effort, not credit cards.
CHOOSE YOUR ADVENTURE
Play how you want:
• Story-driven main quests 
• Sandbox housing chaos
• Team up or try to solo everything
• Fish, dance, roleplay, craft, build, or just explore
• Scaled seasonal content makes things fun for any level
Whether you’re a casual player or hardcore gamer, AQ3D adapts to your pace.
Over 10 million heroes created. 100% dragon-approved.
Download AdventureQuest 3D now and start your next great MMO adventure – for FREE.
Battle on!
www.AQ3D.com

AQ3D is the cross-platform MMORPG with weekly updates, wild customization, no pay-to-win, and endless ways to play.

NEW: SANDBOX HOUSING IS HERE

Build anything you can imagine. Sandbox housing lets you:

• Place, rotate, scale, and stack items freely
• Build castles, obstacle courses, theme parks — even flying sofas
• Create personal hangouts or insane parkour challenges for friends
• It’s chaotic, creative, and completely physics-free

No blueprints. No limits. Just imagination (and probably dragons).

CREATE YOUR HERO, YOUR WAY

• Customize your character’s look and gear with over 7,000 items
• Equip any item for power or style (transmog included)
• Change classes anytime: warrior, mage, rogue, ninja, necromancer & more
• Morph into 200+ travel forms: dragons, ghosts, birds, wolves, even bushes
• Ride on our newest Mounts for fast-travel and fierce looks

Be yourself. Or something much weirder. No judgement!

FIGHT, RAID, AND EXPLORE TOGETHER

• 5-player dungeons and 20-player raids
• Open-world bosses and seasonal scaled maps
• 5v5 PvP battlegrounds and challenge fights
• Epic loot, legendary weapons, and fashionably questionable outfits await

Whether soloing in the shadows, leading your guild into battle, or climbing the ranks in PvP, there’s always a fight to win… or flee from heroically.

TRULY CROSS-PLATFORM

• One account, one world — all devices log into the same universe
• Cloud save, real-time co-op, and zero platform restrictions
• Doesn’t hog space (download size under 250MB)

Take the full MMO experience from phone to desktop and back again without missing a beat.

WEEKLY EVENTS & FREE CONTENT

We never stop updating. Expect:

• New quests, items, and gear every week
• Special events and rotating challenge content
• Player suggested updates, weird experiments, and community surprises

From Trobblemania to Mogloween, there’s always something weird happening in AQ3D.

OLD SCHOOL SOUL. MODERN DAY CHAOS.

From the creators of AdventureQuest, DragonFable, and AQWorlds comes a full 3D reimagining of the browser MMOs you loved growing up.

• Return to iconic zones like Battleon, Darkovia, Ashfall, and Doomwood
• Meet familiar NPCs (Artix, Cysero, Warlic, etc.)
• Battle classic monsters like Zards, Slimes, and dragons too big to fit on the screen
• Experience all-new story arcs built around community feedback

This is the game you would’ve skipped homework for — now rebuilt with better graphics, more memes, and way more explosives.

FAIR, FUN, AND FREE

• No pay-to-win, ever
• Free to play, forever
• Optional cosmetics, travel forms, mounts, and supporter packs
• Earn gear the old school way: by playing — not paying

We believe in rewarding effort, not credit cards.

CHOOSE YOUR ADVENTURE

Play how you want:

• Story-driven main quests 
• Sandbox housing chaos
• Team up or try to solo everything
• Fish, dance, roleplay, craft, build, or just explore
• Scaled seasonal content makes things fun for any level

Whether you’re a casual player or hardcore gamer, AQ3D adapts to your pace.

Over 10 million heroes created. 100% dragon-approved.

Download AdventureQuest 3D now and start your next great MMO adventure – for FREE.

Battle on!

www.AQ3D.com

bluejetty:00177276:ios.description:
Transform your smartphone into a powerful portable scanner with PDF Scanner Documents! Say goodbye to distorted scans and hello to clean and professional results.
Smart Scanning:
Automatically crop your documents and intelligently process them, removing shadows, correcting perspective, and distortions. No more twisted scans; your papers will look normal and crisp!
High-Quality Scans:
Whether it's books or folded receipts, our app ensures you get digital versions of your scans with far better quality. Your documents will look as good as the originals.
Built-In OCR:
Convert any scan into editable text that can be copied and exported with our built-in OCR feature. Now you can easily extract and share text from your scanned documents.
Easy Sharing:
Export and share your scans however you want, making it a breeze to collaborate and store your important documents.
Don't settle for subpar scans; download PDF Scanner Documents and start enjoying top-notch document scanning today!
KEY FEATURES:
* Instantly scan, save, and share any document in PDF, PNG or TXT formats.
* Smart cropping and auto enhancing make the texts and graphics look clear and sharp.
* Use file manager with folders, drag & drop, and document editing features
* Scan documents and share them in just a few taps
* OCR feature extracts texts from single page for further editing or sharing.
* Preview of the docs to see if small refine, tone up, highlights and mosaic need to be put on.
* Password protection to keep your documents save
Important:
To use all app features you should purchase one of subscription
If you choose to purchase one of subscriptions, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. The current subscriptions price starts at $4.99 USD/week and 19.99 USD/3 months. Prices are in US dollars, may vary in countries other than the US, and are subject to change without notice.

bluejetty:00150376:ios.description:
docUP Secure Document Upload is a mobile app that allows users to upload supporting documentation, to help them apply to DYCD funded programs, using their mobile device. They will need to enter basic information specific to the program and they are ready to go. No account creation is required, and the app can be used as many times as needed to upload all the supporting documents the DYCD program requires.
Once uploaded via the mobile upload app, the provider and DYCD users will access to review and process an applicant’s documentation. Each client’s application will have its own document inbox where submitted documents can be reviewed and validated. Due diligence will be completed by the provider and DYCD users to determine if the documents uploaded are sufficient for accepting the applicant into the program. Once all the needs are met, the application is ready to be processed and approved in DYCD Connect.

bluejetty:00123083:ios.description:
SET UP YOUR DIGIBANK APP IN UNDER 3 MINUTES. (3 STEPS)
- Step 1: Download DBS digibank app 
- Step 2a: Existing customer: Register with your DBS ATM/Debit/Credit Card number and PIN, or via SingPass Face Verification (Singaporean/PR only)

EVERYDAY BANKING MADE SIMPLE.
- Peek at account balance without logging in
- Open just one fixed deposit account for all currencies and change your maturity instruction in real-time 
- Apply for accounts, loans and credit cards
- Get multiple products and services at one go with Starter Packs 
- Transfer money overseas with DBS Remit – same-day transfers, S$0 fees 
- Save time with Smart Shortcuts, based on your top actions 
- Move seamlessly between digibank and PayLah! with just a one-time login
SMART SERVICES PERSONALISED TO YOU.
- Manage money better, from paying bills and subscriptions, to tracking cashflow and growing your money with personalised insights
- Get reminders on upcoming payments, insights on possible duplicated payments and sudden bill increases
- Verify your transactions securely with Digital Token
- Chat with digibot for help on your account, transactions, or even loan application – on-demand 24/7

- Get a financial overview with personalised insights to help achieve your financial goals on our newly designed dashboard
- View 'Your Net Worth' to see the big picture of your money, including other banks and government accounts

- Looking to buy your first home? Simulate how this goal affects your future cashflow and CPF balances 10, 20 years down the road
SUSTAINABILITY MADE EASY, AFFORDABLE AND MORE REWARDING
- Living sustainably doesn’t have to be inconvenient.
- Track, Offset, Invest and Give Better with just one tap.
- Learn how you can lead a greener lifestyle with bite-sized tips on-the-go.
- Gain access to green deals right at your fingertips.
- Make the world a better place with DBS LiveBetter!

listings.description:
SET UP YOUR DIGIBANK APP IN UNDER 3 MINUTES. (3 STEPS)
- Step 1: Download DBS digibank app 
- Step 2a: Existing customer: Register with your DBS ATM/Debit/Credit Card number and PIN, or via SingPass Face Verification (Singaporean/PR only)
- Step 2b: New customer: Sign up with MyInfo and start banking with a bank account, debit card, PayNow and PayLah! (for all nationalities – NEW!) 
- Step 3: Set up your Digital Token and you’re done!

EVERYDAY BANKING MADE SIMPLE.
- Peek at account balance without logging in
- Open just one fixed deposit account for all currencies and change your maturity instruction in real-time 
- Apply for accounts, loans and credit cards
- Get multiple products and services at one go with Starter Packs 
- Transfer money overseas with DBS Remit – same-day transfers, S$0 fees 
- Save time with Smart Shortcuts, based on your top actions 
- Move seamlessly between digibank and PayLah! with just a one-time login

SMART SERVICES PERSONALISED TO YOU.
- Manage money better, from paying bills and subscriptions, to tracking cashflow and growing your money with personalised insights
- Get reminders on upcoming payments, insights on possible duplicated payments and sudden bill increases
- Verify your transactions securely with Digital Token
- Chat with digibot for help on your account, transactions, or even loan application – on-demand 24/7
- With the new insights tab, you get improved links and prefilled information. We’re making the next step in your banking journey more convenient, so you can focus on what matters the most.

NAVIGATE MONEY WITH CONFIDENCE. 
- Investing in digiPortfolio has never been easier. You can now invest in new portfolios or monitor existing ones on-the-go.
- Get a financial overview with personalised insights to help achieve your financial goals on our newly designed dashboard
- View 'Your Net Worth' to see the big picture of your money, including other banks and government accounts
- Make your money work harder with Singapore’s first digital investment advice feature
- Looking to buy your first home? Simulate how this goal affects your future cashflow and CPF balances 10, 20 years down the road
SUSTAINABILITY MADE EASY, AFFORDABLE AND MORE REWARDING
- Living sustainably doesn’t have to be inconvenient.
- Track, Offset, Invest and Give Better with just one tap.
- Learn how you can lead a greener lifestyle with bite-sized tips on-the-go.
- Gain access to green deals right at your fingertips.
- Make the world a better place with DBS LiveBetter!

bluejetty:00033675:ios.description:
Welcome to Wood Bolts Brain Puzzle Tease, a captivating game that combines the thrill of unscrewing wood nuts and bolts with mind-bending challenges! Dive into a world where wood nuts, bolts, and wooden puzzles collide, putting your problem-solving skills to the ultimate test. This free game is designed to boost your IQ while providing an exciting journey filled with various difficulty levels and fresh challenges.
How to Play:
Get ready to conquer the wooden puzzles by unscrewing wood nuts and bolts to unlock secrets hidden deep within the wood. Armed with a screwdriver, you'll master the mechanics of the game while overcoming obstacles and avoiding whimsical creatures that stand in your way. Each turn reveals a new twist, making every level a unique adventure that keeps you engaged and entertained.
Key Features:
With over 300 levels ranging from beginner to advanced, Wood Bolts Brain Puzzle Tease offers a variety of impressive puzzles that will challenge your mind. Use helpful hints to navigate tricky situations, and customize your gameplay experience with 10+ unique skins. Compete globally on the leaderboard to showcase your puzzle-solving prowess and rise to the top, proving you are the ultimate screw master!
Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing wooden wonderland, where each level is packed with engaging conundrums and unexpected surprises. Enjoy the soothing sounds of woodworking complemented by a tranquil musical score, creating an ASMR experience that enhances your gameplay.
Are you ready to become a wood bolts puzzle master and a screw master? Download Wood Bolts Brain Puzzle Tease now and embark on a riveting journey through a world filled with wood nuts and puzzles that come to life! The adventure awaits, so let’s get started!

bluejetty:00033485:ios.description:
Pulse Monitor - Your Personal Health Companion
Welcome to Pulse Monitor, your dedicated health companion designed to enhance how you track and manage your well-being. Easily check your heart rate, and log your blood pressure and blood oxygen levels using your iPhone.
- Heart Rate Monitoring:
Effortlessly check your heart rate by placing your fingertip on the camera. Ensure your fingertip completely covers the camera lens and flashlight for an accurate reading.
- Health Records:
Keep track of vital metrics like heart rate and log your blood pressure readings over time. Gain insights into your health trends directly on your iPhone.
- BMI Tracker:
Calculate and monitor your Body Mass Index (BMI) with ease to support your fitness goals.
- Knowledge Hub:
Access valuable information on maintaining a healthy heart and achieving balanced well-being through our app.
- Secure Data Storage:
Your health data is important. Pulse Monitor employs advanced security measures to ensure your information remains safe and private.
Download Pulse Monitor now and embark on your journey towards a healthier you! With heart rate tracking integrated into your Apple Watch, staying informed about your heart health has never been more convenient.
Please note: Our app is intended for wellness and fitness purposes only. We do not provide medical treatment advice or diagnoses. If you have any health concerns, please consult a healthcare professional.
Subscription Options:
Choose between the following subscription options for unlimited access to all measurement and recording features:
Weekly Subscription
Yearly Subscription
Lifetime Subscription
FREE TRIAL FOR 3 DAYS - OFFERING UNLIMITED MEASUREMENT FOR A LIMITED TIME
Free trial allows you unlimited access to all features for the duration of 3 days. Your account will be automatically charged for renewal, based on the annual subscription plan, within 24 hours before the end of the 3-day free trial period.
You can cancel auto-renewal at any time, given that the cancellation is at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when making a purchase of an auto-renewing subscription.
Manage your subscription directly from your iPhone:
Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the Account Settings:
- Open the Settings app.
- Tap your account.
- Tap Subscriptions.
- Tap the subscription that you want to manage.
For app support and more information, reach out to us at:
kma45143@outlook.com
Privacy policy: https://sites.google.com/view/pulse-monitor-privacy-policy/
Terms of use: https://sites.google.com/view/pulsemonitor-termsofservices/

bluejetty:00127832:ios.summary:
Turn your phone into a smarter plant companion with Ficus — an all-in-one plant care app that helps you identify plants, diagnose problems, and build care routines that actually work.
Ficus combines plant identification, health checks, and
bluejetty:00127832:ios.description:
Turn your phone into a smarter plant companion with Ficus — an all-in-one plant care app that helps you identify plants, diagnose problems, and build care routines that actually work.
Ficus combines plant identification, health checks, and practical care tools to support everyday plant care — from the first scan to long-term routines.
IDENTIFY PLANTS FROM PHOTOS
Take a photo and instantly identify plants with up to 99% accuracy. Get a short, clear overview with essential details. Perfect for houseplants, garden finds, and everyday discoveries.
AI ASSISTANT HENRY — HELP ANYTIME
Meet Henry, your personal AI plant assistant. Ask questions about watering, light, pests, growth, or general care and get practical, easy-to-understand answers whenever you need them.
PLANT DOCTOR — DIAGNOSE AND TREAT
Noticing yellow leaves, spots, or wilting? Use Plant Doctor to check your plant’s health. Take a photo of the problem area and receive insights with care recommendations tailored to your plant.
SMART WATERING
Stop guessing how much to water. The Watering Calculator helps determine suitable watering volume and frequency based on plant type, pot size, light conditions, and humidity.
LIGHT METER
Measure light intensity using your phone’s camera. Ficus helps you understand whether your plant is getting too little or too much light and choose a better spot for healthy growth.
CARE TASKS AND REMINDERS
Create personalized care tasks for watering, misting, fertilizing, repotting, and pruning — or add custom tasks to match your routine. Set schedules and receive push notifications to stay consistent, even during busy weeks.
WEATHER-AWARE CARE
Get care recommendations adapted to your local weather. Ficus considers temperature, humidity, and seasonal changes to help you adjust routines as conditions change.
WARNINGS FOR URGENT CARE
Ficus tracks schedules and plant needs and alerts you when a plant requires immediate attention, helping prevent small issues from becoming serious problems.
VACATION MODE
Planning time away? Prepare your plants in advance with a simple care plan and share clear instructions with anyone helping while you’re gone.
CARE GUIDES AND PLANTOPEDIA
Explore detailed care guides and Plantopedia articles, from basic care to advanced growing tips. Learn from expert content and browse information on thousands of plant species.
WISHLIST AND SHARING
Save plants you want to buy later in a dedicated Wish List and research their care needs before purchasing. Share photos of your plants and your care progress, and create visual summaries to celebrate your green wins.
Whether you’re bringing home your first plant, managing a growing collection, or trying to help a struggling plant recover, Ficus helps you make informed care decisions and stay organized.
Download Ficus and make plant care simple and clear.
For questions, feedback, or assistance, contact us at mornhouse.ltd@yahoo.com We’re happy to help.
Privacy Policy: https://whatplantisthis.io/privacy-policy
EULA: https://whatplantisthis.io/terms-of-services

bluejetty:00185481:ios.description:
Futbol24 is back — rebuilt from the ground up with a cleaner design, faster navigation and tools that go well beyond the scoreline.
Follow live scores across 2,000+ leagues and competitions worldwide, from the Champions League to your local division. Whether you're tracking one match or keeping an eye on a full matchday, Futbol24 gives you everything in one place.
WHAT YOU GET
Live Scores & Events
Real-time scores with goals, cards and status updates as they happen. The Live Events Box lets you filter by event type, pin it to the top, enable sound alerts, or show only your favourite matches.
Team Compare
Pick any two teams and compare them side by side — recent form, head-to-head record, latest results, Under/Over stats and a full stat-by-stat breakdown.
Lineups & Match Stats
Full formations, player positions and substitutions for every match. Plus live match statistics, a momentum chart and play-by-play commentary to follow the game even when you can't watch it.
Leagues & Teams
Dedicated pages for teams and competitions — with form tables, recent results and standings all in one view.
Organised Your Way
Sort matches by kick-off time, competition or country. Choose from different match display layouts. Find teams and competitions faster with improved search.
Light, Dark or Auto
The app follows your phone's system theme, or you can set it manually. Looks good either way.
COVERAGE
Over 2,000 leagues and competitions across Europe, the Americas, Africa, Asia and Oceania — including the Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, UEFA competitions and much more.
Futbol24 is free to download and use.

Turn your daily steps into a real adventure!

WHY STEPS & BEASTS?
Every morning starts with a new egg. Walk toward your step goal and watch it hatch into a unique Beast. At the same time, your character moves forward on the Journey — a real path that grows with your steps, taking you through new biomes, landmarks, and levels.

bluejetty:00122965:ios.summary:
Monese is the banking alternative you’ve been waiting for.

bluejetty:00122965:ios.description:
Monese is the banking alternative you’ve been waiting for.
We’re the money app that helps you budget smartly, spend wisely and switch between currencies in a flash. 
Whether you need a GBP, EUR or RON account (or all 3!), you’ll be able to manage your money straight from your phone and enjoy the flexibility to live, work, travel, study and thrive wherever life takes you. We even have business accounts!
Join over 2 million people and open a Monese mobile money account today. 
It’s simple, fuss-free and easy – so how does it work?
• Open a GBP, EUR or RON account, straight from your phone
• Easily switch between currencies and manage your money all in one place
• Get a contactless Mastercard debit card you can use globally – online, in-store or at ATMs
• Spend abroad with no extra fees on card spending and ATM withdrawals
• Quickly send and receive money locally and internationally in multiple currencies
• Create a virtual card and pay online or in-store for an extra layer of security
• Open a joint account to easily spend, share and save with a loved one, roommate or friend
With our feature-rich smartphone app, you’ll also get:
• Real-time notifications: Instant updates whenever you use your account
• A detailed spending overview: Full transparency around your transactions
• Savings pots: Put money aside for something special
• Apple Pay: A fast, easy and secure way to pay with your Apple Pay
• Automatic Direct Debits and recurring payments: the easy way to pay for things like mobile phone contracts, rent, or gym memberships
Plus, you can also:
• Build your credit score: Use Credit Builder to grow your credit history and savings at the same time (UK only)
• Link your PayPal account: Manage your PayPal balance and transactions from Monese, and add your Monese card to your PayPal wallet
• Enjoy state-of-the art security features: 3D Secure, card locking, strong encryption and biometric login
• Get instant account statements in PDF or XLS whenever you need
Enjoy the convenience of being able to send and receive money straight from your phone, get your salary paid in, set up Direct Debits and recurring payments, all while maintaining a complete overview of your earning, spending and saving. Withdraw cash from ATMs worldwide for free, within generous allowances, and add money to your account by bank transfer, debit card, or with cash at over 84,000 locations in the UK, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, France, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal or Spain.
You can open an account with us regardless of your citizenship or financial history, as long as you’re at least 18 years old and live in the European Economic Area (EEA).

Pai Gow Poker is a variation of the Chinese domino game pai gow. 
The game is known for a slow rate of play and lots of pushes, resulting in low risk game.
While a game of skill, most hands are obvious how to play, and it is not difficult to learn proper strategy for the rest of them. 
Every player plays against the same dealer hand, which causes the table to often win and lose together, resulting in a fun and social game.
The Fortune bonus
"Fortune" is a side bet in Pai Gow Poker that pays based on the value of the player's seven cards. It doesn't not matter how the player sets his hand. Different casinos use different payout rate for this side bet, you can choose your payout that suit your best in setting panel
The house way
The house way is how the dealer arranges their own hand. It can vary from place to place the differences are marginal and happen infrequently.

bluejetty:00073051:ios.name: WTMP | Who Touched My Phone?
bluejetty:00073051:ios.summary: Our WTMP app is your dedicated partner in enhancing your phone security. Safeguarding your personal information is crucial. WTMP becomes your reliable solution, offering a range of innovative features that ensure your phone remains off-limi
bluejetty:00073051:ios.description:
Our WTMP app is your dedicated partner in enhancing your phone security. Safeguarding your personal information is crucial. WTMP becomes your reliable solution, offering a range of innovative features that ensure your phone remains off-limits to unauthorized access. 
Whether you worry about theft, want to identify intruders, or ensure safe charging, our WTMP app provides the protection you need. With our advanced features like WTMP/DTMP mode we will ensure your device safety. your privacy is non negotiable to us. Get yourself protected like never before.
Powerful Features of Our WUMP App:
Each feature of our app is precisely designed to provide unrivaled protection for your device, ensuring your peace of mind in an increasingly digital world. 
1. Stealthy Shield Mode
Activate WTMP's Stealthy Shield Mode to take control of your privacy. Set a personalized passcode to encrypt the app, ensuring that only you can access its robust security features.
2. Anti-Theft/DTMP mode:
WTMP's Anti-Theft feature transforms your phone into a vigilant guard against theft. Activate this mode to thwart attempts at phone snatching from horizontal surfaces. When someone tries to take your phone, an alarm will sound, alerting you to the potential threat. With customizable alarm sounds, you're always in command of your device's safety.
3. Intruder Alert/ WTMP mode :
Curious about unauthorized access to your phone? WTMP's Intruder Alert feature captures the moment anyone attempts to unlock your device. The app secretly takes a photo and generates a detailed report with timestamps, helping you identify potential intruders. Stay ahead of unauthorized users with this advanced protective feature.
4. Charging Unplug Alarm:
Keep your phone safe during charging with WTMP's Charging Unplug Alarm. Are you worried about someone unplugging your device without permission? Activate this feature to receive immediate alerts if your phone is disconnected from charging. Set your preferred alarm sounds to match your style.
5. Snap Intruders, Generate Reports:
Empower yourself with the ability to capture potential intruders in the act. WTMP's photo capture feature snaps a picture of anyone attempting unauthorized access to your phone. The app then compiles comprehensive reports with dates and times, helping you maintain complete control over your device's security.
6. User-Friendly Interface:
WTMP believes that security should be accessible to all. Our user-friendly interface ensures that even those unfamiliar with advanced tech can navigate and utilize our features effortlessly.
7. Own voice as alarm:
WTMP provides a feature where users can set their own voice/recordings as alarm sound for the given features like Shield Mode/WTMP/DTMP/Charging Unplug alarm.
Our Subscription Plans:
Monthly Subscription: For $2.99 every month, ensure continuous protection.
Half-Yearly Subscription: For $8.99 every six months, ensure continuous protection.
One-Time Purchase: Secure lifetime access to premium features for just $19.99.
Subscription payments are conveniently managed through your iTunes account. Auto-renewal ensures uninterrupted security, while you can cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
Your Step-by-Step Guide to Using the App:
Follow these simple steps to maximize the security features and protect your device.
* Download and install
* Open the app and set up your passcode
* Activate stealthy shield mode and set your preferred sound. 
* Enable WTMP mode and check out the report. 
* Connect charging alarm and moving alarm features according to your choice. 
Your Feedback Matters: Reach Out to Us
We're dedicated to improving your experience. If you have questions or suggestions, or need assistance, contact us at wtmp.ios@gmail.com, and our team will be ready to help.
Your Privacy is Non-Negotiable:
Review our Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/wtmpprivacypolicy
Terms of Service: https://sites.google.com/view/wtmpterms

bluejetty:00140577:ios.name: Bloodline: Last Royal Vampire
bluejetty:00140577:ios.summary: Bloodline is an anime-styled mobile role-playing card game with an emphasis on deep character leveling and customization, allowing for a roster of heroes that is distinctly unique to each player. The story follows the Last Royal Vampire Lil
bluejetty:00140577:ios.description:
Bloodline is an anime-styled mobile role-playing card game with an emphasis on deep character leveling and customization, allowing for a roster of heroes that is distinctly unique to each player. The story follows the Last Royal Vampire Lilo and her companion Ren in their quest to save their loved ones from a militaristic order called the Holy Land.
Meet Lilo, an ancient princess, and the last royal vampire in the world. Help this young bloodsucker and her friends fight against a religious order of monsters hunters called the Holy Land on a quest to exterminate all heretics and heathens. Build your squad of warriors, heroes, and fantastical creatures to defeat exorcists, hunters, as well as vicious demons, and many powerful beings pulling the strings from the shadows. Let your modern, slice of life, vampire highschool adventure start here today! Assemble, customize and infinitely enhance over 400 heroes as you do battle in an extraordinary combination of ultra-competitive PvE, PvP, and Guild vs. Guild gameplay! This will be the truest test of your strategic abilities, so take up the challenge and join the ultimate anime-action RPG!
-OVER 400 CHARACTERS TO COLLECT-
Level up your characters by taking them into battle and feeding them powerful upgrade materials. Evolve and awaken them with Job Changes, Fate Links, Tarot Cards, and Mystic Formations to unlock their true powers!
-EASY TO PLAY, HARD TO MASTER-
Send your heroes in to destroy your enemies with simple taps and swipes! Unleash the fury of their arcane abilities to take down tough bosses with spectacular effects and explosions!
-ADAPTED FROM THE POPULAR MANGA-
Enjoy a fully fleshed out story based on the popular manga of the same name, following the adventures of Lilo and her friends as they uncover dark secrets and the forgotten memories of the vampire bloodline.
-PERFECT YOUR STRATEGY-
Carefully craft your squad to effectively counter enemy forces and know when’s the best moment to attack or defend! Pay close attention to elemental attributes and character types to counter bosses and keep your teams healthy and buffed in battle.
-Exciting Guild Battles-
Destroy opposing forces in REAL-TIME Guild War battles with friends and guild mates. It’s gonna be pure PVP bloodshed!
-BLOODY COMPETITION-
Claw your way through other players in a multitude of PVP features like the Arena, Tower of Fate, as well as giant Guild Battles, and live cross-server Wars! Who will end up as the Champion of Bloodline?
-PLAY MORE, GRIND LESS-
Thanks to features like Auto Battle, Raid, and Auto-Mine, Bloodline allows you to devote more of your time to managing your squad and fighting off the Holy Land. Clear stages and progress through the game effortlessly while earning all the items and materials to level up your fun!

bluejetty:00027517:ios.description:
Our app is developed to measure the level of ambient noises. We have tried to make it as clear, simple and accurate as possible so that each person has the opportunity to quickly measure and monitor hearing health.
To ensure precision, we calibrated our app using a real professional-grade sound meter.
Key Features:
- Smart AI noise meter to detect noise type
- Accurate sound pressure measurements
- Various types of audio waves
- Sync with the Health app - track noise levels and monitor your hearing health
- Reference table to compare noise levels
- Various types of measurements: dBa, dBc, dBz
- Sound recording and noise data saving
- Possibility to share records
- Convenient dosimeter
- Selection of standards for allowable hearing loads: OSHA and NIOSH
- Measurement range from 20db to 160db
- Microphone calibration for more accurate measurements
- Response speed settings
- User-friendly and intuitive interface
- Display of current, average and maximum values
Our app has the possibility to synchronize with the Health app. To do this, you need to go to the app settings and turn on the health tab there. After that, information about the volume of the ambient noise will be transmitted to the Health app, so you can track the amount of consumed noise. You can also set the interval of data on the incoming noise.
The app uses a microphone to track the sound pressure level. You can record information about the ambient noise in real time, as well as save all data in a playlist so that you can return to this data at any time.
Do you work in high noise environments? Do you want to find out if the neighbors are not exceeding the permissible volume values? Or maybe you want to monitor the health of your ears? If yes, our app can serve you as a faithful assistant.
Important! The application does not guarantee a 100% result, since the measurements you obtain depend on your device and may contain inaccuracies. For a more accurate result, it is better to calibrate the app or compare the obtained data with a professional sound level meter.
-------------------------------
* Subscription: Get access to all premium functions of the app.
* You can turn off the auto-renewal at any time: you'll find the option to do this change to a different payment plan in the settings of your iTunes and App Store account.
* The first time you can try the free trial for 3 days. After that, your account will be automatically charged for the subscription if you will not stop it before the end of the free trial.
* The length of the subscription is 1 month, this subscription is auto-renewing. You can stop the subscription at any moment;
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the and of the current period, and identity the cost of the renewal.

bluejetty:00095450:ios.description:
The Silent Thief: Covert Operation is a thrilling stealth adventure game where every step, every breath, and every decision matters. You are a master thief silent, precise, and invisible to the world. Your mission: infiltrate high-security locations, steal valuable intel, and escape undetected.
Set in a dark and mysterious world filled with laser traps, patrolling guards, hidden passages, and locked vaults, you'll need to use your brain as much as your stealth skills. Timing is everything 
 one wrong move and the mission fails. Use shadows, distractions, and gadgets to outsmart your enemies and disappear like a ghost.
From breaking into museums and secret labs to escaping with priceless treasures under the cover of night, every mission challenges your instincts and stealth tactics. As the story unfolds, you'll uncover a deeper conspiracy that could change everything. Are you ready to steal the truth?
The Silent Thief: Covert Operation Key Features:
Intense stealth gameplay with smooth controls
Dozens of challenging missions with increasing difficulty
Customizable thief outfits and tools
Intelligent enemy AI that reacts to sound and movement
Hidden loot and secrets in every level
Cinematic cutscenes and immersive story
Offline play supported — steal anytime, anywhere!
No guns. No violence. Just pure stealth strategy.
Whether you're a fan of stealth games or new to the genre, The Silent Thief: Covert Operation offers an unforgettable experience. Can you complete the mission without being seen? The shadows are waiting.

bluejetty:00130806:ios.name: NeoServer SSH Mosh Terminal
bluejetty:00130806:ios.summary:
NeoServer manages your servers over SSH, with no extra software to install.
Whether it's a Home Server, NAS, cloud server, development environment, or AI compute node, you can connect, monitor, manage files, and operate containers directly
bluejetty:00130806:ios.description:
NeoServer manages your servers over SSH, with no extra software to install.
Whether it's a Home Server, NAS, cloud server, development environment, or AI compute node, you can connect, monitor, manage files, and operate containers directly through NeoServer.
◉ Terminal and Remote Access
• Mosh support — stays connected when switching networks
• Deep tmux and zellij support for fast session recovery after disconnects
• ZMODEM (rz/sz) file transfer — send and receive files right in the terminal
• Built for Claude Code, with direct paste or upload of images, videos, and files
• Password, Private Key, 2FA, and SSH Agent forward authentication
• Jump Server, Failover, and Socks5 Proxy support
• Automatically run Shell initialization scripts after connecting
• Built-in special keyboard, copy and paste, and quick actions
• Command completion hints, with double-tap to trigger TAB
• Custom themes and fonts, including programming ligature fonts
◉ AI Assistant
No Agent installation required. Manage your servers directly with AI: it can read metrics, run commands, and manage files — like an always-on operations assistant that helps you handle complex maintenance tasks.
• Supports mainstream LLM APIs via standard protocols. No model service is included — bring your own API configuration for any provider you need
• Custom Skills system: AI can read and create skills, synced across devices via iCloud
• Built-in browser skill: AI can open web pages, extract content, and run scripts in-app
• Local file sandbox: AI can read and write local files with live preview
• Runs continuously in the background, with automatic notifications when tasks complete
• Upload images, screenshots, and files for AI to analyze in context
• Plan mode: plan first, then execute — more control over complex tasks
◉ File Management (SFTP)
• Browse server files and directories
• Upload, download, delete, and rename files
• View file size, permissions, and modification time
• Edit files online
• Syntax highlighting for common programming languages
• Preview images, logs, configuration files, and more
◉ Batch Script Execution
• Run scripts on one or multiple servers
• Organize servers into groups
• View script execution history
• Run maintenance tasks in batches at once
• Suitable for batch updates, deployments, and inspections
◉ Server Monitoring
View server status in real time:
• Uptime
• 1 / 5 / 15 minute system load
• CPU model, temperature, and usage
• Memory usage
• GPU usage and GPU task information
• Disk capacity, IOPS, and I/O Wait
• Disk read/write speed and total read/write volume
• Network upload and download speed
• Total traffic statistics
Key metrics can also be shown directly in iOS widgets.
◉ Process Management
• View the system process list
• Show PID, user, CPU, memory usage, and more
• Sort by columns
• Send signals to terminate processes
◉ Docker and Podman Management
• View container status
• View container logs
• View Inspect information
• Create, start, stop, and restart containers
• Pause and delete containers
• Manage images and container resources
◉ Remote Wake and Automation
• Wake-on-LAN (WOL) remote startup
• Remote shutdown and daily operations support
◉ Security and Data Sync
• Face ID / Touch ID app protection
• Sync data with your private iCloud storage
◉ Who NeoServer Is For
• Home Server enthusiasts
• NAS users (Synology, QNAP, TrueNAS, and more)
• Website administrators and operations engineers
• Developers and programmers
• AI model researchers
• Cloud server administrators
◉ Feedback and issues: makerneo.lab@gmail.com
◉ Data Privacy:
◦ Your private data — such as SSH private keys and server configurations — is stored only on your device and your own iCloud storage (if you enable sync). It is never uploaded to our servers or shared with any third party.
◦ Privacy Policy: https://www.makerneo.com/en/doc/neoserver-privacy.html
◦ Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00006569:android.name: Barcode Scanner for Amazon
bluejetty:00006569:android.summary:
Save money on in-store items and find the same product at a discount on Amazon! 
With Barcode Reader for Amazon United States , you’ll be able to access and compare ratings and reviews for products you see in-store, find deals and discount
bluejetty:00006569:android.description:
Save money on in-store items and find the same product at a discount on Amazon! 
With Barcode Reader for Amazon United States , you’ll be able to access and compare ratings and reviews for products you see in-store, find deals and discounts on Amazon, make smart purchases and save more of your hard-earned cash!
★ EASY TO USE
Simply find a product you like, scan the barcode with the reader and find the same product on Amazon to compare the price, reviews and ratings. 
★ FIND DEALS & DISCOUNTS ON AMAZON
Seen a product you like in a store? We’d wager that you could find it cheaper on Amazon. Using our barcode scanner, you’ll be able to check to see if the item is stocked on Amazon and how much it costs, potentially saving you lots of money.
★ COMPARE RATINGS & REVIEWS
We all want to know whether a product is worth the money or not, don’t we? With our barcode reader for Amazon, you’ll be able to instantly access the reviews and ratings for that particular product. Save yourself the hassle of purchasing a poor quality item – check the reviews first! 
★ SEARCH AMAZON
If have no barcodes to scan and you just want to shop on Amazon – we have that covered, too. With a convenient search bar, you’ll be able to browse for products on Amazon United States from within the app and have products delivered directly to your door. 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
BARCODE SCANNER FOR AMAZON – HIGHLIGHTS
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
⦁ Scan barcodes and view the product on Amazon in seconds
⦁ Find deals, discounts and savings on Amazon
⦁ Use the barcode scanner as a price comparison tool
⦁ Search and shop for items on Amazon directly from the app
⦁ Compare ratings and reviews for items
Is Amazon a good place to find deals and discounts?
Yes, Amazon is a great place to find deals and discounts. Amazon often offers discounts on its own products, as well as special deals and discounts from third-party sellers. You can also find discounts and special offers with Amazon Prime, Amazon's subscription service.
What is Black Friday and Cyber Monday on Amazon?
Black Friday and Cyber Monday are two of the biggest shopping days of the year on Amazon. On Black Friday, Amazon offers discounts across its entire site, including electronics, toys, clothing, and more. Cyber Monday is the Monday after Thanksgiving and is dedicated to online deals. Amazon typically offers some of its best deals of the year on Cyber Monday.
What are the main competitors of Amazon?
The main competitors of Amazon are eBay, Walmart, Target, Apple, Best Buy, and Costco. These companies offer a variety of products and services and compete with Amazon in areas such as ecommerce, retail, and digital media.
Can I trust the rating and reviews on Amazon?
Yes, you can generally trust the ratings and reviews on Amazon. Amazon has a strict policy against fake or misleading reviews and works hard to ensure that all reviews are genuine. Additionally, Amazon reviews are often moderated by the company, ensuring that they are reliable.
What are the countries Amazon delivers to?
Amazon delivers to a number of countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, India, Japan, China, and Australia. Amazon also delivers to other countries, but the selection of products may be limited.
What is Amazon Prime?
Amazon Prime is a subscription service offered by Amazon. Prime members get free two-day shipping on eligible products, access to streaming services like Prime Video and Prime Music, exclusive discounts and deals, and more.
---
This app was not created or endorsed by Amazon, eBay or Walmart.
---
👁️🗨️ As an Amazon, eBay and Walmart Partner, we may be compensated if you make a purchase 👁️🗨️

#1 source of pediatric point-of-care clinical information. One-of-a-kind pediatric formulary. 35+ Built-in calculators. 35+ Interactive flowcharts
Your #1 source of pediatric point-of-care clinical information.
Every three years, The Harriet Lane Handbook is carefully updated by residents, edited by chief residents, and reviewed by expert faculty at The Johns Hopkins Hospital. Easy to use, concise, and complete, this essential manual keeps you current with new guidelines, practice parameters, pharmacology, and more. This portable reference continues to be the most widely used and most recognized pediatric reference worldwide—an indispensable resource for pediatric residents, students, nurses, and all healthcare professionals who treat young patients. 
Key Features
- Trusted for 70 years for fast, accurate information on pediatric diagnosis and treatment. 
- New audio case files: Listen to residents and faculty at The Johns Hopkins Hospital discuss case studies and healthcare disparities based on topics from this bestselling book. 
- The popular and comprehensive Pediatric Drug Formulary, updated by Carlton K. K. Lee, PharmD, MPH, provides the latest in pharmacologic treatment of pediatric patients. 
- Outline format ensures you’ll find information quickly and easily, even in the most demanding circumstances.

Whether you’re checking if y
bluejetty:00142095:ios.description:
Stay effortlessly connected to your loved ones with Scout: Family Location 360, the trusted GPS family tracker and location sharing app designed for real-time visibility, peace of mind, and safety on the road. 
Whether you’re checking if your kids made it to school, coordinating with a spouse, or monitoring your teen’s driving habits, Scout makes it simple to track, share, and stay informed.
Live Location Sharing 360 & Real-Time GPS Tracker
Track your family’s live location on a real-time map using our advanced GPS tracker. Scout provides accurate, up-to-date positioning so you always know where your loved ones are -no more guessing or constant texting. Scout doubles as a family location tracker, ensuring the safety of your loved ones. Stay connected and worry-free with improved accuracy for all your Location Sharing needs.
Family Location & Place Alerts
Get instant notifications when family members arrive at or leave key locations like home, school, or work. Set up custom location alerts and receive real-time updates to help keep everyone in sync.
Find Family & Friends Location Instantly
Use our enhanced 360 Locator to quickly see everyone’s location at a glance. Need to see someone in person? Our new feature lets you instantly start navigation to any family member's location - right within the Scout app. Just tap and go!
Driving Safety Insights & Child Safety Reports
Scout Family Location 360 acts as a powerful child safety app, helping parents monitor teen drivers. Track speeding, hard braking, acceleration, and phone use behind the wheel. Get alerted to critical safety events.
Weekly Driving Reports
Stay informed with automatic weekly driving reports that show trip history, behavior trends, and safety scores. Use this data to coach safer driving and recognize improvement.
Visual Status Indicators
Quickly check who’s at home, at work, or driving with status icons displayed next to each family member’s avatar, making it easier than ever to stay in the loop.
Location History and Safety Tracking
Review past trips or verify locations anytime. Scout: Family Location Sharing keeps secure location history for each family member, giving you peace of mind and visibility over time.
Why Families Choose Scout
• Built for modern families who want reliable GPS location sharing
• Combines live tracking, place alerts, and driving safety in one app
• Helps parents stay connected to kids and teens on the move
• Easy to use, beautifully designed, and privacy-first
• Navigate directly to family members when needed
Have feedback or questions? Email us at scout@telenav.com — we’d love to hear from you.
Thank you for being with Scout: Family Location 360!
Please keep in mind:
Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.
Scout’s map and search coverage are currently for the USA only.

bluejetty:00183093:ios.description:
Simple yet extremely addicting puzzle game that everyone will enjoy! 
Block Puzzle: Star Finder is an exciting line completion puzzle using colorful wooden blocks of a wide variety of shapes. All you have to do is use the wooden blocks to complete lines horizontally and vertically. Lines will disappear upon completion. Sounds easy, right?
This simple-sounding puzzle will test your spatial intelligence and geometric skills!
Do you think you’re up for the challenge? Let’s find out!
HOW TO PLAY
1. Drag the given blocks and put them into the grid
2. Obliterate the blocks by forming full lines horizontally or vertically!
3. Rotate the blocks by collecting stars and charging up the booster gauge.
4. Remove multiple lines at a time to score higher!
SPECIAL FEATURES
• NO WIFI? NO PROBLEM! Enjoy anytime, anywhere!
• FREE TO PLAY!
• NO penalties & time limits! play at your own pace!
• STUNNING GRAPHICS! Catchy sound effects with mesmerizing visuals
NOTES
• Block Puzzle: Star Finder supports mobile phones & tablet PCs.
• Block Puzzle: Star Finder contains ads varying from banners, interstitials, videos to house ads.
• Block Puzzle: Star Finder is free to play, however, you may purchase AD FREE.
Privacy Policy
• https://www.bitmango.com/privacy-policy/
Need Help? Have Questions?
We value your feedback! Please email us at contactus@bitmango.com.
Visit Bitmango for more exciting games!

- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
- Aggregate your financial accounts
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode or biometric on supported devices.

bluejetty:00148778:ios.summary: At UNC Health, we are always looking for ways to improve the experience of our patients and visitors. We want to be there to help you at every step of your health care journey, including finding your way through our facilities. That is why
bluejetty:00148778:ios.description:
At UNC Health, we are always looking for ways to improve the experience of our patients and visitors. We want to be there to help you at every step of your health care journey, including finding your way through our facilities. That is why we created the UNC Health app. This wayfinding app will make it easier for those visiting UNC Medical Center and UNC REX Healthcare by providing turn-by-turn navigation from your front door to our front desk, parking support and real time indoor guidance. The app also brings together resources to help you access care easily, whether that’s seeing the urgent care location nearest you with the shortest wait times, or helping you find a provider anywhere in our system.
Special features include:
• GPS enabled turn-by-turn navigation to UNC Health Care locations
• Find a convenient parking spot and set a parking reminder at UNC Medical Center and UNC REX Healthcare
• Real-time indoor step-by-step directions to get you to where you need to go at UNC Medical Center and UNC REX Healthcare
• Sign up or connect with My UNC Chart to make an appointment and for appointment reminders
• Get in line for an on demand Virtual Care Now video visit with a UNC Health primary care provider 6 a.m. – 10 p.m 7 days per week, 365 days per year, without leaving your home or office. NOTE: This will not be your own primary care or specialist provider.
• Find a Doctor: find information about more than 3000 UNC Health Care providers
• Pay your bill online
• Subscribe to UNC Health Talk to get free health tips and patient stories once a month

bluejetty:00043834:ios.description:
Paint Color Match identifies the paint color of any wall or object from your iPhone camera and gives you the closest match by name and code across 130+ brands—Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Behr, Valspar, PPG and more—then lets you preview it on your own walls. Compare shades across brands and see exactly how a color will look in your home before you spend a dime. No more mismatched walls, wasted sample cans, or trips back to the store.
Visualize any paint color on your actual walls in real time. Try dozens of shades in seconds. Walk into the paint store knowing you've already found the one.
2027 COLORS OF THE YEAR
See each brand's 2027 pick in one place: Sherwin-Williams Celery, Behr Grounded, Valspar Cottage Door, Glidden Artifact and Dutch Boy Deep Rooted, with Benjamin Moore and Pantone added as they're announced. Each pick shows its closest match in 130 other brands, and you can try it on your own walls.
FIND THE EXACT COLOR YOU'RE LOOKING FOR
Point your camera at any surface—a throw pillow, a magazine page, a neighbor's front door—and instantly identify the closest matching paint color by name and code. Works with Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Behr, Valspar, PPG, Dunn-Edwards, Dutch Boy, KILZ, Vista, Farrow & Ball, Dulux, Pantone, RAL, and IKEA.
SEE IT ON YOUR WALLS BEFORE YOU BUY
Use the live wall paint visualizer to preview colors on your actual walls in real time—with matte, eggshell, satin, semi-gloss, and glossy finishes. No painting, no mess, no regret.
TRY COLORS ON ANY ROOM PHOTO
Snap a photo or choose from your gallery, then apply any paint color instantly. Compare shades side by side, save your favorites, and share painted room previews with family, friends, or your contractor.
CALIBRATED WITH A WHITE REFERENCE
Use the white-reference calibration tool to compensate for any lighting condition and get professional-grade color matching results—ranked across every brand in the app.
SAVE, ORGANIZE & COMPARE
Build a personal color library with your matched colors. Create project palettes, compare shades across brands, and access your saved colors anytime—even at the paint store.
BROWSE 130+ PAINT BRANDS IN ONE APP
Search thousands of paint colors from major manufacturers worldwide. Switch between brand libraries instantly and discover alternatives across Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Behr, Valspar, PPG, Dunn-Edwards, Dutch Boy, KILZ, Vista, Farrow & Ball, Dulux, Pantone, RAL, and IKEA.
WHY HOMEOWNERS & DESIGNERS LOVE IT
• Real-time AI paint color matching with impressive accuracy
• AR wall paint visualizer—see colors in your actual lighting
• Works for interior painting, exterior painting, renovations, and remodels
Download Paint Color Match—the fastest way to find, preview, and choose your perfect paint color.

With exclusive commentary, insider analysis and award-winning photos and videos from The Des Moines Register and Iowa City Press-Citizen team, the Hawk Central app is your one-stop shop for all coverage of the Hawkeyes.

• This app is free to download and all users can access a sampling of free articles every month.
• Subscriptions are charged to your account at confirmation of purchase and automatically renew each month or year, unless turned off in your account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable. See "Subscription Support" in the app's Settings for more details and customer service contact information.

MORE INFORMATION
• Terms of service - https://cm.desmoinesregister.com/terms/
• Privacy Notice/Your California Privacy Rights - https://cn.desmoinesregister.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00174985:ios.description:
WORLD WAR HEROES
Looking for free WW2 first person shooter games around? Battle players from around the world in a crazy WWII-era online first person shooter game!
Destroy the enemy and survive tank battles in the center of Berlin and other cities. Participate in team and deathmatch battles, plant bombs and defend them, take part in world war massive warfare!
Why you'll love World War Heroes first person shooter:
- 12+ legendary WWII battle warzones!
- 4 types of combat equipment from the USA, USSR, Japan and Germany!
- 6 tactical shooter game modes and Custom Games where you make your own rules!
- Operate your own tank on the battlefield!
- 100+ unique weapon types: pistols, sniper rifles, machine guns, shotguns and more!
Rules of war:
Team deathmatch!
Two teams fight for domination. The team with the highest score at the end of the round wins;
Death match!
World at war! You fight for yourself. Player with the highest score wins the round;
Point capture!
Both teams capture points on the map that give them battle points. The team with the highest score wins the round;
HQ defense!
Each team must protect their own headquarters and destroy the enemy one;
Capture the flag!
Capture the flag of the enemies' team and bring it to your base. The team that brings more flags to the base wins the battle;
Team battle!
Two teams fight each other with no respawns. The team which has at least one member alive wins;
Officer defense
Each team must protect its own officer and destroy the enemy one;
Custom mode!
Your game - your rules! Create a lobby, invite friends and enjoy the shooting warzone!
HUGE ARSENAL OF WEAPONS! 
All sorts of new weapons will be available to help your team come out on top. Use the whole arsenal, featuring machine guns, grenades, rifles, sniper rifles, bazookas, etc.
AMAZING GRAPHICS AND OPTIMIZATION! 
Dive into online shooter combat with crisp graphics and intuitive controls.
UPGRADE ARMOR AND WEAPONS! 
Build your dream arsenal by upgrading damage and max ammo and decreasing kickback and reload time
DAILY REWARDS! 
Play pvp shooter every day to earn free prizes and get daily tasks and tons of free stuff!
Complete daily tasks and upgrade your gear!
You will love World War Heroes first person shooter action game if you are a fan of tactical realistic PVP shooters, world war shooting games, and multiplayer online army battle shooter games!
The FPS multiplayer game is specially optimized to work on both strong and weaker mobile devices!
Action shooting game is absolutely free to download!
