bluejetty:00084456:android.description:
Please note our current information about SecureApp:
No support for x86 architecture devices anymore.
New permission required with Android 8.0
Due to an adjustment of the permissions of Google, it is now necessary to grant access to the phone status.
Access to phone status
The app needs access to the phone status of your device to perform certain security checks. The app does not make phone calls and does not accept calls.
------------
Use the SpardaSecureApp - our new security procedure - and confirm your transfers, standing orders, service orders and much more with just one touch of a finger.
Our free SpardaSecureApp not only offers security but also a lot of comfort for you.
Here's how to unlock your SpardaSecureApp:
1. Request your user ID and activation code through SpardaNet Banking, SpardaApp or at your branch.
2. Download the SpardaSecureApp from the Play Store.
3. Activate the SpardaSecureApp by entering the user ID, the activation code and a personal password.
(The user ID can be found in the SpardaNet Banking Service Center or in the administration of the SpardaApp.) The activation code will be sent to you either directly in the store or by post.)
And this is how you use the SpardaSecureApp:
1. Log in to the SpardaApp (version 3.0 or higher) or your SpardaNet Banking.
2. Make an order (transfer, standing order, rebooking etc.) and select the SpardaSecureApp as TAN procedure.
3. Via a push message you will now receive the order for approval sent to your smartphone.
4. Open the SpardaSecureApp and enter your personal password.
5. Please always check the order details carefully and then issue your approval.
Note:
The SpardaSecureApp can be used in the SpardaApp (from version 3.0) and in SpardaNet-Banking. It is not possible to use external software via FinTS.
For optimal use you need a stable internet connection.
Requirements:
- Android 5.0
- From Android 6.0 Fingerprint support - please note that we currently do not support older fingerprint sensors, which are not natively supported by Google's fingerprint hardware, for security reasons

bluejetty:00049463:android.description:
Meta Rivals is a battle Royale esport game. 
● Win-to-Earn: Real Tournament Real Reward 
● Complete quests to qualify for free NFT airdrops
● Win and earn Trophy Point (TP)
● Challenge other online players in PvP, battle royal games.
● Join now Free play and test your skill!
The game’s objective is to take down opponents' snakes and consume the gold bars left in their wake to gain gold points. Feeding on gems scattered around the arena elongates the length of a snake. Meta Snakes die whenever their heads strike another Snake's tail or an obstacle. They respawn with a 5% deduction to their gold score and return to their initial length. At the end of
the game, the player with the highest gold point wins.
Subduing Opponents
Players must be skilful at forcing opponents into mistakes by strategically cornering their snakes into awkward positions and grabbing as many gold bars as possible before time runs out. Having a longer and faster Snake makes it easier to hunt down other players.
Alternatively, players can damage an opponent's Snake with direct attacks from projectiles and bombs. Snakes can shoot flames at opponents or leave bombs that detonate on a timer. A Snake's health bar reduces every time they suffer a blow. Snakes die when their health bar goes to zero. Any direct head shot or damage to the head will kill the snake immediately.
The purpose is to kill and collect the gold bar from the dead snake within 3 mins time. Player who collected the most gold bar win the tournament. 
More info Join our discord for more information https://discord.gg/7cG6Q8V5MA
www.meta-rivals.com

Players must be skilful at forcing opponents into mistakes by strategically cornering their snakes into awkward positions and grabbing as many gold bars as possible before time runs out. Having a longer and faster Snake makes it easier to hunt down other players.

Alternatively, players can damage an opponent's Snake with direct attacks from projectiles and bombs. Snakes can shoot flames at opponents or leave bombs that detonate on a timer. A Snake's health bar reduces every time they suffer a blow. Snakes die when their health bar goes to zero. Any direct head shot or damage to the head will kill the snake immediately.

The purpose is to kill and collect the gold bar from the dead snake within 3 mins time. Player who collected the most gold bar win the tournament. 

 
More info Join our discord for more information https://discord.gg/7cG6Q8V5MA
www.meta-rivals.com

bluejetty:00038139:ios.description:
Out exploring on your snowmobile? Take your own mobile trail assistant for the ride!
**NEW THIS SEASON**
► Track your trips: leave breadcrumbs for easier backtracking, get statistics on your average speed and distance traveled, and much more!
► List your equipment: keep track of how much distance you covered with a specific vehicle and keep notes on each one.
► Satellite View: enjoy the mobile app with a better basemap and add the Satellite View to your tools!
*****
The Snowmobilers Association of Nova Scotia (SANS) brings an enhanced version of its web application to your pockets, making for a better riding experience than ever. Working both with and WITHOUT mobile data coverage, you will be able to enjoy the app’s functionalities no matter where you are on the trails.
This app gives you access to the following *OFFLINE* features, anywhere, anytime, even in areas without cell coverage:
► See your location on the map through your phone’s GPS signal
► View nearby restaurants, gas stations, hotels, parking, and other services
► Access the trails conditions as per the last data connection available
► See the distance between you and a specific point
► Quickly save and load itineraries
Getting back to a zone with mobile coverage? Enjoy these additional *ONLINE* features :
► Keep an eye on updated trail statuses for the best riding experience
► Easily meet with friends by sharing your position with each other (no one else can see your location)
► Plan out an itinerary and share it with your group
Welcome to the GoSnowmobiling SANS mobile experience and enjoy the ride!
Notes:
►Continued use of the GPS and location sharing running in the background can significantly increase battery consumption. It is recommended to toggle it off when not needed to improve autonomy.
The Pro Version is a 3.99$ CAD per year auto-renewable subscription & The Pro S is a 4.99$ CAD per year auto-renewable subscription. Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Link to our privacy policy: https://www.evtrails.com/privacy-terms-and-conditions/
Link to our terms of use: https://www.evtrails.com/terms-and-conditions/

Lovers of classic word games like Scrabble, crosswords, or anagrams will love this word hunt and spell vocabulary game.

And connect all of them to get the final crossword solution. There are extra words to find on each level if you want to make a puzzle more challenging.
You will travel around this fun world of word link. Immerse yourself into the beautiful scenery backgrounds to relax and escape from the stresses of daily life. Play offline, anywhere, anytime!

- Free and offline game.
- Sharp your mind : power up your memory and improve your spelling skills.
- Challenge everyday: solve daily puzzles to get great rewards.

bluejetty:00063644:ios.description:
Take Care of Your Little Girl
Dress her up, feed her when she’s hungry, and keep her happy with fun activities. Make sure her energy stays above 30, and help her with everything from homework to hairstyling.
Earn and Spend Points
You earn points by feeding your daughter, taking care of her, going on egg hunts, and playing the Egg Match mini-game. Use your points to buy clothes, toys, and room items for the Bedroom, Kitchen, Family Room, and Backyard.
Karma Points – A Sign of Your Experience
Karma points build up over time, reflecting your progress and experience in taking care of your virtual daughter. Unlike regular points, which you spend on items, Karma points show how much time and effort you’ve put into the game.
Customize Her Look
Switch up her outfits and hairstyles—from casual to sporty, work-ready to evening wear. Unlock all available items to personalize her world.
Go on an Egg Hunt
Egg hunting is a fun part of the adventure! Find eggs in different locations, crack them open, and hatch unique mini creatures. Each egg requires three cracks before revealing your new collectible trophy creature.
Play the Egg Match Mini-Game
Egg Match is a classic match-3 puzzle game where you swap eggs to make matches. It features over 100 levels, with difficulty increasing as you progress. Playing Egg Match is another way to earn points and add to your overall score.
Full Support for VoiceOver
Little Girl Magic is fully accessible with VoiceOver support.
In Egg Match, tap a grid cell to hear the egg’s color and position. To move an egg, select it with a tap, start the move with a double-tap, and double-tap the destination (or direction) to complete the move.
Game Center Achievements & Leaderboards
Fully furnish any room to unlock Game Center achievements.
Compete on two leaderboards:
Karma Leaderboard – Tracks your overall babysitting experience through Karma points.
Egg Match Highest Level Leaderboard – Reflects the highest level you've reached in Egg Match.
In-Game Purchases
Want to speed things up? Tap the yellow coin in-game to buy points and remove ads.
Ready to Play?
Download Little Girl Magic and start your virtual parenting journey! Care for your daughter, celebrate milestones, play the mini-game, and collect adorable creatures.
Compatible with iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.
Follow us on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/lil.girls

bluejetty:00088051:ios.name: Pixel Art - Color House
bluejetty:00088051:ios.summary: Have you ever thought about how hard sometimes achieving relaxation is? A tricky thing, and sometimes it is achievable in a very unusual way. Let’s take coloring for example. Yes, of course, coloring by hand with pencils can be more annoyin
bluejetty:00088051:ios.description:
Have you ever thought about how hard sometimes achieving relaxation is? A tricky thing, and sometimes it is achievable in a very unusual way. Let’s take coloring for example. Yes, of course, coloring by hand with pencils can be more annoying than anything else because of how much mental concentration it requires. Don’t take us wrong, it can still be fun but not relaxing. While real things can be tiresome, we discovered that the mobile version of coloring is much closer to relaxation and even meditation. You just start this monotone tapping process, and you can be lost for hours.
We wanted to make something more than just a classic coloring app, which is why you will paint houses in our free game Pixel Art - Color House. It surely will bring you a whole other experience. Just imagine the whole house is yours, and all of the fashion decisions will be yours
So, let’s quickly look through the basics. How does number coloring work? You have a picture, and every color of it represents a number. Then you start tapping. Tap is how you color. Basically, that is it. And there are thousands of similar games without any differences. So, we thought that we needed to create something new for these games. That is why we decided that you will become a designer of houses! Instead of grinding and coloring picture after picture you will be creating on another level. You will be thinking about color patterns that you used and what matches better, how your house looks in general, maybe something is off. To make your painting process even more relaxing we added a music player. Now you can turn on and easily control calm music during coloring. This feature will help you to get lost in your thoughts or in the process even more.
- Play game and listen to calm music to achieve full relaxation
- Become a designer, paint houses and every little detail in them from the scratch
- Comfortable interface
- Pictures are part of the houses you paint
- Use your vision to create the house of your dream
- Share your pictures with friends
- Create your own collection of tapped painting
- You can play it offline
If you are looking for an easy way to relax, then play our free game with pixel coloring and you will find what you need. You can endlessly tap and listen to relaxing music while creating a house of your dreams.

bluejetty:00023420:ios.name: My PlayHome Plus
bluejetty:00023420:ios.summary:
My PlayHome Plus is a doll house for the iGeneration. 
Imagine a doll house where your child can use everything, even the closets, TV and shower. Where you can fry an egg and feed the family pizza. Where you can pour drinks, blow bubbles a
bluejetty:00023420:ios.description:
My PlayHome Plus is a doll house for the iGeneration. 
Imagine a doll house where your child can use everything, even the closets, TV and shower. Where you can fry an egg and feed the family pizza. Where you can pour drinks, blow bubbles and turn out the lights. 
Imagine a doll house where the pieces are impossible to lose and never break. 
Imagine if it was designed so that even a 2 year old could use it, yet detailed enough to entertain an 8 year old. 
Imagine a doll house that could excite and captivate your children for hours, months, and years...
My PlayHome is the original and best dolls house app. Massively interactive, your kids can explore and use everything in the house. The characters eat, sleep, shower, brush their teeth and more. Want the room to be darker? Close the drapes! Fancy a change in music? Pop a different CD into the stereo!
No other doll house app comes close in interactivity, detail, ease of use and just plain fun!
INTRODUCING MY PLAYHOME PLUS!
My PlayHome Plus takes all the original My PlayHome apps and combines them into one giant world! Now you can jump between houses, stores, school and hospital without having to flip between apps.
Includes the original My PlayHome house for free!
Already own the other My PlayHome apps? You'll be able to add them to the play town for free! My PlayHome Plus will detect which other My PlayHome apps you have installed and then offer those areas to you for no cost.
NEW AREAS!
A new mall is being built in town! They're still working on it but they've already opened the food court! There's 4 brand new fast food shops to relax in:
* Pizza parlor
* Sushi
* Coffee shop
* Burgers and hot dogs
THE CLASSIC APP FOR KIDS
My PlayHome apps have been captivating children for nearly a decade now and created a whole new genre of kids apps. My PlayHome is trusted by parents because it's made by parents who also care about what their kids are playing with on their devices.
* NO SOCIAL NETWORKS, PUSH NOTIFICATIONS OR REGISTRATION
* NO 3RD PARTY ADVERTISEMENTS
* NO NEED TO BE CONNECTED TO THE INTERNET
* NO SUBSCRIPTIONS
* NO CONSUMABLE IN-APP PURCHASES
For the first time in a My PlayHome app, My PlayHome Plus does feature In-App Purchases exclusively for obtaining new areas to play in. In the past, we would release these new areas as an entirely separate app which would link together with the other apps. However, over the years this become less practical so the decision was made to carefully use In App Purchases for this purpose. We will *never* use In App Purchases in exploitative ways such as for buying virtual money to "buy" things in the shops, or endless tiny purchases for a trivial virtual product. 
If you understandably don't want to use In App Purchases, the classic My PlayHome apps are still available with the same content and no In App Purchases:
* My PlayHome
* My PlayHome Stores
* My PlayHome Hospital
* My PlayHome School
However, new content, such as the mall food court are not available outside of My PlayHome Plus.
-----------------------------------------------

Fruit store music © Sam Semple - www.samsemple.com

Qick is the fast, fun, and eco-friendly way to explore the city. With our electric scooters, you can easily get to school, work, or just explore the city's sights in a convenient and exciting way.
Missed the bus or does the bus schedule not suit you? No problem! With Qick, you never have to wait for anyone else, or worry about expensive parking fees or environmental impact. Our electric scooters are always available when you need them.
Save time and money by choosing Qick, the most cost-effective option on the market. For only 10 kronor, you can easily start your journey and pay only 1.5-2.5 kronor per minute depending on where you are.
Living environmentally friendly has never been easier - and more fun! Take the first step towards a greener future by choosing Qick.

Download the app and log in.
Search the map for a Qick near you.
Scan the QR code to unlock your electric scooter.

Park and end your trip.

If you want to see Qick in your city or just want to learn more about us, we are here for you. Send an email to: support@qickscooters.com or visit our website: https://www.qickscooters.com/

Choose from 17 captivating characters, each with unique fighting styles. Mix and match their abilities to continuously alter combat mechanics mid-fight, gradually crafting a personalized fighting experience that's truly your own.

bluejetty:00145898:ios.description:
Swiss VPN - Your privacy is our priority
Always-On Protection, Ad Blocking & a Private Browser
Swiss VPN is a fast, secure VPN. Protect your connection with one tap on upgraded servers, block ads and trackers across your apps, and browse in a private browser with TOR mode. No account or registration needed to get started.
Swiss VPN is built to protect your data without adding complexity to your day. Whether you're on café Wi-Fi, traveling, studying on a shared network or browsing at home, Kill Switch and Wi-Fi Auto-Connect keep you covered on every network. Start free; Premium unlocks every feature with a free trial.
WHY CHOOSE SWISS VPN?
■ Kill Switch (Premium)
If the VPN connection drops, Kill Switch helps stop traffic leaving your device outside the encrypted tunnel.
■ Wi-Fi Auto-Connect (Premium)
Save trusted Wi-Fi networks and let Swiss VPN connect automatically when you join them.
■ Ad blocker for your apps and the private browser (Premium)
Turn on Ad Block on the home screen to block ads and trackers across your apps while connected. The private browser has its own blocker for ads, pop-ups, trackers and potentially harmful domains.
■ Private browser with TOR mode
Use the built-in private browser free in Native mode. Premium adds VPN and TOR modes; TOR mode routes supported browser traffic through the TOR network for an additional privacy layer.
■ Fast and flexible connections
Upgraded servers are built for faster speeds and quick connections. Choose a region worldwide, search for a location or use automatic selection, and get another IP address without changing region. Network Accelerator (Premium) and optimized routing help boost performance where available.
■ Safer public Wi-Fi
Swiss VPN creates an encrypted tunnel between your device and the VPN service, helping protect your connection in coffee shops, airports, hotels, schools, campuses, and other untrusted networks.
■ No browsing or VPN activity logs
Swiss VPN does not keep a history of the websites you visit, your browsing data, IP addresses, or VPN connection logs.
■ Organized service selection (Premium)
Find available services with categories such as Streaming, Social, and Live TV. Service and content availability can vary by region, provider, and network.
FREE AND PREMIUM
The core VPN and the private browser are free with ads; free VPN time is earned by watching ads. Premium unlocks Kill Switch, Wi-Fi Auto-Connect, Ad Block, the browser's VPN and TOR modes, Network Accelerator, service selection, all regions and no ads.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Does a VPN make me completely anonymous?
A VPN can hide your IP address from websites and encrypt traffic between your device and the VPN service, but no VPN can guarantee complete anonymity. Privacy also depends on the websites, accounts, apps, and services you use.
What affects VPN speed?
Performance depends on distance, network congestion, your internet provider, and the selected region. Automatic selection or another available region may provide a better connection.
How do I get free Premium?
Invite friends from the Rewards tab: every friend who uses your code gets 14 days of Premium, and you earn 14-day gifts as more friends join.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
■ Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase.
■ Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
■ Your Apple Account may be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
■ Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account subscription settings.
■ Any unused part of a free trial may be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
■ Available plans, prices, trials, and features are displayed in the app before purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.swissvpn.pro/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.swissvpn.pro/privacy-policy
Support: support@swissvpn.pro
Download Swiss VPN and protect your connection with one tap.

bluejetty:00026580:ios.name: Roku Smart Home
bluejetty:00026580:ios.summary: The simple way to a smarter home. The Roku Smart Home mobile app is the only smart home manager you need for your Roku Smart Home devices—indoor and outdoor home security cameras, video doorbells, smart bulbs, smart light strips, smart plug
bluejetty:00026580:ios.description:
The simple way to a smarter home. The Roku Smart Home mobile app is the only smart home manager you need for your Roku Smart Home devices—indoor and outdoor home security cameras, video doorbells, smart bulbs, smart light strips, smart plugs, and more. Easily set up your smart home devices, customize your settings, and more all in the Roku Smart Home device manager. See all your devices in one place and group them to control your entire house at once. 
The Roku Smart Home mobile app is your one and only home camera app. With your smart home manager, you can easily set up Roku home security cameras and video doorbells and customize camera settings in a tap. Monitor your home from anywhere with the app—get instant motion or sound notifications when there’s activity, pull up live footage, and even have a chat with two-way audio. You can customize notifications and motion detection zones, so you only get the alerts you want. With a Roku Smart Home subscription, you can unlock cloud storage and view motion-triggered recordings for up to 14 days. Also included in the subscription is smart detection, which identifies people, pets, packages, and cars and allows you to filter alerts—so you only get the ones you decide are important.* Home security has never been this easy. 
Roku smart lights brighten up any space in your home with customizable LED bulbs and smart light strips. bluejetty:00030604:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00030604:ios.description:
Kievan Rus’ is a strategy game with a focus on political maneuvering. Here war is just a tool of the trade.
This game enables you to play as the ruler of Kievan Rus’, one of the mightiest states of the world of that time. The Middle Ages is a setting that is truly a treasure for any strategy game fan. In the game, there are 35 states, and Barbarians, who have their own territory and resources. 
However, the ruler’s way to domination is not going to be a walk in the park. Get ready for deadly wars and backstairs politics – you will be confronted by the most powerful states of the game world, including England that dominates seas, Balkan states (Poland, Hungary, Croatia and Serbia), and the Arab state of Syria, with a huge army at its disposal. So you think the Roman Empire has made great progress? Perhaps, you prefer European states, such as France and Scotland? Or it is Byzantium that you consider to be a good example? Let them know you are ready to fight head-to-head and build your own empire, and that you are a dictator and a strategist. Their aim is to advance their own civilization while preventing yours from doing so. Put your political foresight to the test and find out whether you are good at strategy and diplomacy – lead your country through ages.
To succeed, engage in wars with your rivals. Raise your own army and fleet, declare wars or start fighting in them when they are in full swing. Deploy spies and send saboteurs to your enemy country to find out what they are going to do. Invade states, conquer lands and capture rare resources.
A sagacious dictator is key to state policy success. Manage foreign affairs, conclude non-aggression pacts, and make suggestions to be considered by other states. Remember that diplomacy and well-thought-out policy are often more effective options than war. 
Don’t forget about state economic activities: produce food, and manufacture weapons for your army. Use researches to increase the amount of manufactured goods and military capability. However, a single civilization cannot produce everything, so you will have to trade with other states and buy rare resources and goods. 
Introduce new laws and make your citizens abide by them. You can establish the civilization religion of your choice. Appoint army and fleet commanders, and tax, trade, economy and construction chiefs. Separatism will not be tolerated: quell riots occurring in your state. Your empire will be mightiest, and diplomacy, weapons and economy will help you achieve it. 
The game uses real-life states that existed at that time, with real historic events. The large and detailed map will enable you to see information about your own territory and that of other countries. These are just the game basics: you can find out how much it offers only by playing it. 
The game does not require Internet connection, and you can play it anywhere you like. There is no set time limit for turns: you can choose the game pace to your liking. The geopolitical strategy set in the Middle Ages with a special focus on the Slavs is available on smartphones and tablets. It is a good way to spend time, as it combines entertainment and brain exercise.

bluejetty:00119836:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00119836:ios.description:
ABC Dinos is an educational game for preschool kids and elementary school first graders to learn to read and write vowels and consonants. 
It adapts to each child's age group, allowing them to choose the letter that they want to learn whether in uppercase or lowercase. 
In addition, ABC Dinos has English voices which allows the youngest children (preschool) to hear the words without needing to know how to read.
DESCRIPTION
ABC Dinos is an educational game for children. With spectacular results, the game makes it possible to learn letters and improve reading and writing, regardless of each child's learning level. 
The screen interface is attractive and simple allowing children to play alone without needing an adult. 
All this learning is wrapped in a magical story full of emotions, action and fun surrounded by funny characters such as Finn's family, our Dino, and the ""crazy"" ogres and their dragons. Help Finn free his family by collecting the magic letters that make ogres transform into funny animals !
ENGLISH VOICES
We have incorporated English voices to repeat the literacy activity words and statements. With this we not only manage to make our activities accessible to all ages, but it also allows us to incorporate auditory recognition activities, which are so valuable at this stage in their learning (Preschool and 1st grade). 
OBJECTIVES
 - Learn to read
 - Visual and auditory memorization
 - Discrimination of vowels and consonants 
 - Discrimination of the letters of the alphabet
 - Improvement of understanding
 - Learn to draw the outline of all the letters of the alphabet (vowels and consonants). 
 - Expand vocabulary with: animals, professions, objects, clothing, nature, etc. 
LEARNING GAMES
- WRITE THE LETTER
In this educational game the kids have to draw the shape of each letter. As a prize they will receive an image that begins with that letter. They can choose the preferred mode of writing: joined up or printed handwriting. At the same kids will also have the possibility to trace each letter of the alphabet in uppercase or lowercase. 
- WORD FORM
This activity consists of the formation of level-appropriate words by dragging each letter to its corresponding place. And since we know that this quite difficult, we will help the little ones by changing the shape of each letter as if it were a puzzle piece that fits in. In this way all children, regardless of their age, can progress with word formations and then go on to expand their vocabulary and begin to learn to read. 
- WHERE ARE THE LETTERS?
This is, without doubt, one of the most fun learning games in our APP. The child has to find the matching letter of the two cards as quickly as possible. This game aims to strengthen visual recognition of vowels and consonants.
- WHICH LETTER DOES BEGIN WITH?
In this activity the kids will hear a word and see its picture. They have to guess the letter that the word begins with. The auditory recognition of each letter of the alphabet and the expansion of their vocabulary are the two main objectives of this educational game.
ADAPTS TO YOUR AGE
At the beginning of the game it will ask about the child's level so you don't need to worry if your son or daughter doesn't yet know how to read or write. It adapts to their learning level and you can choose which letters you want to work with and repeat at any point.
TRY IT, IT'S FREE
ABC Dinos is free, so what are you waiting for? Download it now. 
There is an in-app purchase which allows you to unlock the entire game. You can choose any letter of the alphabet and complete the whole adventure. 
Company: Didactoons
Recommended age: For children aged between 3 and 7 years old (preschool and 1st - 2nd grades of Primary).

CREATE A GAME
► The word games showdown starts here. Challenge your friends and family members to play, or use Smart Match to find your perfect opponent. Unscramble and search for the highest scoring words on the board and fill in the crossword style puzzle!
COMPLETE GOALS AND GET REWARDED

► Play against themed WordMaster characters to test and improve your spelling, vocabulary and word skills in this word puzzle ladder. Stay sharp, because as you move up, the WordMasters will get tougher to beat.

► Do you love crossword puzzles? Do anagrams get your brain wheels turning? Unscramble and challenge your brain by playing solo in this easy-to-play, limited time text twist mini-game.

► Show off your word game persona and play words with flair through Stickers, Tile Styles and Profile Frames! You can now also equip Widgets to stay updated with your ongoing matches and favorite events!

bluejetty:00066318:ios.description:
SPADES PLUS is FREE to download and includes optional in-game purchases (including paid random items).
Let’s join the SPADES COMMUNITY to play with millions of online players! Whether you're a seasoned spades player or a newcomer, Spades Plus offers you a great experience against many Spades players from all around the world! You can play in many different game modes such as Classic, Solo, Mirror, and Whiz.
Now playing Spades is much better with Tournaments, Knock-Out and many other different modes!
Spades is one of the traditional trick-taking classic card games like Bid Whist, Hearts, Euchre & Canasta, but this game is played in pairs in which spades is always the trump.
==SPADES PLUS FEATURES==
FREE COINS
Get thousands of coins as a one-time "Welcome Bonus," and earn even more coins by logging in daily to collect your "Daily Bonus" every day!
DIFFERENT MODES
Play Spades however you want!
CLASSIC: Make your bid with your partner and challenge other teams 
VIP: Play the classic Partnership Spades in custom Tables
SOLO: There is no partnership. Each player gets his/her own points
MIRROR: You bid the number of your Spades Cards in your hand
WHIZ: You can bid “NIL” or the number of your Spades Cards in your hand 
TOURNAMENTS & CHALLENGES
Win the 16 player-Tournament or Knock-Out Challenge to get amazing prizes in spades online with friends!
GREAT SOCIAL EXPERIENCE
Meet new people and add them as friends to play card multiplayer games! Use Public or Private Chat to stay in touch with other players - play solitaire card games.
CREATE YOUR OWN TABLES
You can create tables in different modes. Choose your “Game Rule” type, set the “Bet Amount” and the “Final Point” or decide if there will be “Nil”, “Blind Nil” or “Chat” options. If you don’t want to be found, create your own “Private Table” where games are “Invite Only”.
Additional information:
SPADES PLUS is FREE to download and includes optional in-game purchases (including paid random items). Information about drop rates for paid random items can be found in-game. To manage or disable in-game purchases, go to Settings on your device. 
SPADES PLUS is intended for an adult audience only and does not offer real money gambling or an opportunity to win real money or prizes. Practice or success at social gaming does not imply future success at real money gambling.
Requires an Internet connection (network fees may apply)
Use of this application is governed by our Terms of Service, found at https://www.take2games.com/legal. For questions about the game, please review our game support page https://spadesplus.zynga.com/contact/. 
For information about how Zynga uses personal data, please read our privacy policy at www.take2games.com/privacy.
Zynga Inc. 1200 Park Place San Mateo, California 94403
©2026

- NO time limit: Enjoy parking puzzle levels whenever you have time!

*The car parking game offers a range of buses to unlock, each with different handling characteristics, adding variety and excitement to your experience. With realistic graphics, immersive sound effects, and smooth controls, Bus Crazy: Jam Escape delivers a true parking simulation for bus enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike. Can you conquer the toughest parking challenges and become the ultimate bus parking champion?
Get behind the wheel and start solving these thrilling parking puzzle today!

bluejetty:00126680:ios.description:
Life Simulator is a realistic life simulation game that is both fun and educational! Choose a starting life scenario and see if you can go from rags to riches! Start as an uneducated bum living on a park bench and end as a yacht driving CEO living in a mansion.
The game contains subtle lessons about financial investment, relationship, career, time management, and life philosophies. Life is a balancing act between health, happiness, mental sanity, and wealth constrained by our limited lifespan, you get to decide how you want to live your life. There are many ways to win!
Features includes:
- 15+ starting life scenarios (high school dropout, indebted college student, etc)
- 10+ unlockable perks
- Travel to different countries
- Multiple achievable life goals
- Play casino games
- Trade stocks and cryptocurrency
- Save humanity from a pandemic!
- Buy, rent out, and flip properties for profit
- Buy a sports car, a private jet, a yacht and more
- Take a break, go camping, go to a concert, or go on an international vacation
- Meet, date, propose and marry partners with different personalities
- Have children and watch them grow to adulthood
- Live through many generations and inherit wealth from previous generations
- Earn degrees and learn life skills
- Spend time with family
- Get a job and climb your way to the top, or buy a car and drive for Uber
- Start a company, choose between a factory, software company, or a restaurant chain
- Produce YouTube videos, make apps, or release tracks as a DJ
- Choose the life of crime and work your way to a crime syndicate
- Treat your own illnesses or go see a doctor
- Eat unhealthy fast food or learn to cook and make healthier meals
- Save money, earn interest, or get bank loan
- Become a professional athlete and play basketball, football and baseball
- Invest your money and play the stock market
- Buy lottery tickets and pray for the jackpot
- Buy pets and feed them treats
- Check your weekly cash flow for a view of your finances
- More than 120 random events to make things interesting

bluejetty:00171680:ios.description:
Set customizable alerts on important metrics within the Bitcoin, DeFi and wider Crypto ecosystem. In addition to price alerts, we detect exchanges listings, volume spikes, BTC & ETH wallet transactions, whale alerts, the BTC Mempool size, ETH gas prices, and other on-chain metrics. You can also monitor traditional financial markets with our stock market alerts.
Key Features
* Price Alerts - Realtime, customizable price alerts for over 20,000 different cryptocurrencies across 30+ top crypto exchanges, including Coinbase Pro, Binance, Uniswap, PancakeSwap, BitMEX, FTX, Bittrex, Bitstamp, Bithumb, Kraken, Bitfinex and dozens more. We also offer price & volatility alerts for over 10,000 Stocks & ETFs.
* Exchange Listing Alerts - Immediately detect new and upcoming exchange listings.
* Percentage-based Price Alerts (aka volatility alerts) for both Stocks and Crypto.
* Volume Alerts - Get notified of unusual trading volume on crypto exchanges.
* Receive periodic price notifications at regular time intervals.
* Wallet Watch - Transaction monitoring for BTC, ETH and any ERC-20 token. We now also support Base, BSC, Polygon, Optimism, and AVAX wallets!
* Balance Alerts - Get notified if a wallet balance goes below a custom threshold.
* Crypto Whale Alerts - Get notified when the biggest crypto whales are moving funds.
* Bitcoin mempool size alerts
* Funding Rate Alerts
* BTC Dominance Alerts
* Crypto Marketcap Alerts 
* ETH Gas Price Alerts
* Blockchain Metric Alerts - for on-chain data, such as block height, difficulty and more.
Get notified however you’d like!
We support push notifications, email, sms (text messages), automated phone calls, Slack, Telegram, Discord, webhook events, and browser notifications.
Track Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, DOGE, SHIB, XRP, Chainlink, Uniswap, BNB and over 20,000 other altcoins. Measure prices in real-time relative to USD, BTC, EUR, GBP, and dozens of other fiat currencies and stablecoins.
Questions? Comments? Concerns?
Email us at contact@cryptocurrencyalerting.com or reach us on Twitter at twitter.com/crypto_alerting
We offer no financial or legal advice.
Your subscription to Cryptocurrency Alerting will automatically renew, unless you disable auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can turn off auto-renew or manage your subscription from your Apple account settings. Payment will be charged to your Apple account.

bluejetty:00116048:android.description:
Blood is the fountain of life, and the carrier of memories.
Before the dawn of the Continental Era, thirteen alchemists partook of Abel the Martyr's blood. With it, they unlocked the power to transfer memories through blood, achieving "immortality"—thus, the first Bloodborn were born.
Over a thousand years later, in the autumn of 1353, the Black Blood disease swept across the continent like an unrelenting tide. Noah, a young man from a small town, was branded a heretic and sentenced to burn at the stake for his affliction. Yet, as the flames closed in, a Bloodborn girl appeared—shattering his fate in an instant.
To her, Noah was the key to the Bloodborn's long-awaited "return to the moon." And so, his extraordinary journey began—
✦ Game Features ✦
[Gothic-Themed Visual Feast]
A dark fantasy unfurls across the medieval continent of Minexus. With high-quality anime-style cutscenes, striking skill animations, and a distinct gothic aesthetic, Silver and Blood unravels the mystery behind its name. Delve into the eternal struggle of "fate versus free will" and "life versus death," and carve your own legend in a world teetering on the edge of chaos.
 [Complex Strategy RPG]
This is a tale of blood and cycles, woven by those who refuse death. Follow the Threads of Fate to uncover an enthralling story. Strengthen your loyal Vassals and enter the Lost Courtyard. Prove your mettle in the Blood Arena, or seize control of the Twilight Citadel to shape its future... Though the end may be destined, a new chapter yet awaits.
 [Engaging Environments and Tactical Strategies]
Forests, rocky veins, deserts, plains... Once a land of prosperity, Minexus has become a hunting ground for the monstrous Blood Beasts. In this realm of fear and uncertainty, you must master strategy, command the shifting tides of battle, and harness the power of Blood to purge the horrors that lurk within.
[A Cast of Epic Medieval Characters and Romanticist Roles]
Over 50 Vassals across 5 factions, each with a distinct identity and untold secrets waiting to be uncovered. Strengthen their Blood Power through equipment, skills, and Spirit Siphon to forge your own unique Moonblessed lineup. In this age of awakening, forge unbreakable bonds with your Vassals and stand together against the encroaching darkness—until the day you reach the fabled Other Side of the Moon.
[Featuring Composer Yasunori Nishiki and a Star-studded Voice Cast]
Let the theme song "Moon and the Myth" guide you through a gothic masterpiece by the renowned composer, Yasunori Nishiki. Be enthralled by a stellar voice cast including Takehito Koyasu and Akari Kito as they bring the Vassals to life. It is a breathtaking audio experience you don't want to miss!
Facebook: Silver and Blood-SEA
YouTube：@Silver and Blood
System Permission Requirements:
1. Notification permissions: To send you notifications about important content and exciting events.
2. Calendar access: To add important game event schedules to your calendar.
4. Storage permissions: To save game screenshots on your device.

bluejetty:00015338:ios.name: Python IDE & Jupyter – Juno
bluejetty:00015338:ios.summary:
Zero-setup Python IDE that runs your code offline, an AI coding assistant, and a developer toolbox — in a first-class citizen app for iPad and iPhone.
Juno is designed to cover all your Python coding needs, supporting both Python scripts (
bluejetty:00015338:ios.description:
Zero-setup Python IDE that runs your code offline, an AI coding assistant, and a developer toolbox — in a first-class citizen app for iPad and iPhone.
Juno is designed to cover all your Python coding needs, supporting both Python scripts (.py) and Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) — a document format focused on applying Python to data analysis and computational science.
FREE FEATURES
- Navigate and manage files and folders, quickly preview documents and media
- Browse and edit Jupyter notebooks in a powerful, customizable notebook editor with beautifully rendered previews — editing is free
- Write and edit code sources, scripts, JSON, XML, and other text-based formats — one versatile editor for code and text alike, with syntax highlighting
- Add quick access bookmarks for file system locations outside the app's sandbox, or simply open documents in place
PRO FEATURES
Only one thing in Juno is Pro: running code. Even that is free to try — a generous trial allowance lets you run notebooks, scripts, projects, and the REPL before you buy. After the trial, running code unlocks with a one-time Pro purchase — not a subscription.
- Run Jupyter notebooks, Python scripts, and whole projects locally with the built-in Python 3.13 interpreter and a full suite of up-to-date, preinstalled scientific and data packages — entirely offline
- Explore interactively in a Python REPL — open a standalone prompt, or drop into it after running a script or project to keep exploring what it defined
- Search the variables, functions, and imports in your session with the Object Inspector — no need to print each one
- Open any folder as a project: file tree, multiple editor tabs, run any script, with a coding assistant aware of the whole project
- Keep side outputs — Preview, Browser, Console, Object Inspector — open as side-by-side tabs in an output sidebar
- View local web servers and HTML your code produces in a built-in browser with developer debug tools
- Long-running scripts and Jupyter sessions keep going in the background
- Automate with Shortcuts and Siri: App Intents run a Python file, run Python code, or open a file — pass arguments and files, capture output, and chain actions
- Leverage powerful data analysis, machine learning and developer tools: NumPy, pandas, Polars, DuckDB, Matplotlib, SciPy, Scikit-learn, OpenCV, pygame, and more
- Enjoy painless package management: install any pure Python package with an intuitive package manager
ON-DEVICE AI AND MACHINE LEARNING
Run LLMs locally with llama.cpp and MLX, train neural networks with Keras, and create images with Stable Diffusion. Hugging Face is built in. Start with five ready-to-run projects.
AI CODING ASSISTANT
The assistant runs on your account or your key, not ours: sign in with your account or add your OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini API key, and requests go straight from your device to your provider. You control what you spend and share — Juno never takes a cut.
GAMES AND EMULATORS
pygame is built in: write games with touch controls, sound, and full-screen graphics, and play them on your device. Eight complete games ship as examples, alongside NES, Game Boy, and CHIP-8 emulators written in Python, each with a library of freely licensed homebrew games — play them, then open the code to see how they work.
PYTHON MEETS iOS
Reach native iOS APIs straight from Python with the built-in juno modules: clipboard, Keychain, device info, location, motion sensors, contacts, reminders, photos, sound, notifications, sharing, and Bluetooth. Show native alerts and pickers, present full-screen image, video, and web previews, or call into UIKit, Foundation, and any Objective-C framework via the Objective-C bridge.
SCRIPTS AND NOTEBOOKS
Python scripts (.py) get intelligent code completion, a console with a full terminal emulator, and a media viewer for plots and web apps. Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) keep code, markdown, plots, and LaTeX equations in one file, outputs included.

Struggling to find the perfect haircut or communicate your style vision to your barber? Men's Hairstyles puts thousands of handpicked haircut ideas, styling tutorials, and grooming tips right in your pocket. Whether you're looking for a classic fade or modern undercut, discover your next look with confidence.
KEY FEATURES & BENEFITS
Extensive Style Library: Browse over 2,000 high-quality hairstyle images organized by length, texture, and occasion. From business professional to casual weekend looks, every style is carefully selected and regularly updated with emerging trends.
Personalized Recommendations: Answer a few quick questions about your hair type, face shape, and lifestyle to receive customized suggestions. Our smart algorithm learns your preferences and shows styles that truly work for you.
Barber Communication Tools: Save your favorite styles and bring them to your next haircut appointment. Show your barber exactly what you want with professional reference images and terminology guides.
Beard & Grooming Integration: Complete your look with matching beard styles and grooming routines. Discover how to coordinate your haircut with facial hair for a cohesive, polished appearance.
Seasonal Trend Updates: Stay current with the latest hairstyle trends across all seasons.
STYLE CATEGORIES YOU'LL LOVE
- Short Haircuts: Buzz cuts, crew cuts, Ivy League, and high-and-tight styles
- Medium Length: Pompadours, quiffs, side parts, and textured crops
- Long Hairstyles: Man buns, flowing locks, and shoulder-length styles
- Fade Variations: Low fade, mid fade, high fade, and skin fade techniques
- Curly & Wavy: Specialized cuts that embrace natural texture
- Professional Business: Conservative styles appropriate for corporate environments
- Trendy & Modern: Contemporary cuts featuring the latest fashion-forward trends
- Classic Timeless: Traditional styles that never go out of fashion
- Ethnic Specific: Styles optimized for different hair textures and cultural preferences
WHY MEN CHOOSE THIS APP
Unlike generic style apps, we focus exclusively on men's grooming, providing depth and expertise you won't find elsewhere.
Whether you're growing out your hair, considering a dramatic change, or maintaining your signature look, our app provides the knowledge and inspiration you need. Save time researching styles and avoid haircut disappointments.
PERFECT FOR EVERY OCCASION
Job interviews, weddings, dates, family events, or everyday confidence - the right hairstyle makes all the difference. Our occasion-based filtering helps you find appropriate styles for any situation.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Subscription includes a 3-day free trial. Find the right cut for your face shape, preview looks with virtual try-on, and explore 500+ men's hairstyles - free. Once the trial ends, you will be automatically charged the standard subscription rate unless cancelled.
Download now. Your next great haircut starts here - transform your look with confidence and clarity today.

bluejetty:00089331:ios.name: Opthy
bluejetty:00089331:ios.summary:
Pupillary Distance: The key to your perfect glasses. Discover Opthy, powered by global eyewear expert EssilorLuxottica.
Get your Pupillary Distance just right with Opthy, the solution backed by EssilorLuxottica’s eyewear experts. Swiftly m
bluejetty:00089331:ios.description:
Pupillary Distance: The key to your perfect glasses. Discover Opthy, powered by global eyewear expert EssilorLuxottica.
Get your Pupillary Distance just right with Opthy, the solution backed by EssilorLuxottica’s eyewear experts. Swiftly measure your Pupillary Distance (PD) with a few clicks, so you can find a comfortable and personalized fit for your perfect glasses. Moreover, experience the cutting-edge capability of turning your iPhone into a 3D body scanner and measurement device for purchasing prescription Rx glasses online with Opthy.
Key Features:
• Advanced contactless tool for PD measurements: Opthy's cutting-edge technology specializes in swiftly capturing Pupillary Distance (PD) measurement, revolutionizing the conventional process.
• Quick IPD measurements for far focal lengths: Opthy offers quick Interpupillary Distance (IPD) measurements for far vision, allowing you to find a comfortable viewing experience for distant distances.
• Order online prescription glasses with confidence: Opthy empowers you to confidently order prescription glasses online, knowing that you obtained personalized measurements for achieving a comfortable fit.
About Pupillary Distance:
Pupillary Distance is the distance between the center of your pupils, measured in millimeters. An average PD measurement is about 63mm. This crucial metric is essential when buying glasses, as it indicates the specific lens area you look through, helping you to achieve optimal comfort and clarity in your visual experience.
Swift and User-friendly:
Opthy has streamlined the process for you. All you need is your iPhone; the Opthy app will walk you through the quick and seamless scan. Once done, you'll receive the all-important Pupillary Distance measurement.
Suitable for Everyone:
Whether you wear glasses or not, Opthy caters to all adult users. It provides personalized Pupillary Distance measurements for compatible prescriptions.
Prescription Compatibility:
Opthy is compatible with single-vision prescription lenses between -5D and +5D. Please note that it is unsuitable for higher-powered prescriptions, bifocals, progressives, or multifocals. Professional in-person PD measurements are recommended for achieving the best fit and visual experience for individuals requiring more complex prescriptions.
Age Restriction:
For user safety, Opthy is not intended for use by persons under the age of 18. EssilorLuxottica prioritizes the well-being of our users and adheres to age-appropriate guidelines.
Experience Cutting-edge Technology:
Opthy harnesses cutting-edge technology to enhance your eyewear selection process. Its innovative approach to measuring Pupillary Distance (PD) empowers you with your personal PD so you can make confident decisions when purchasing glasses or adjusting your virtual reality (VR) headset.

bluejetty:00083493:ios.description:
The Field Interview Card app was created by LEOs for LEOs to easily take field interview notes and generate FI cards. I was made to replace field interview paper notebooks and speed up the note taking process and accuracy for LEOs.
APP FEATURES
---------------
INCIDENT NOTES
- Enter details about the incident (start time, incident #, incident type, address ...)
- No need to waste time searching for the address where the incident occurs. Just tap a button to lookup the address automatically (using the phone's GPS).
PERSON NOTES
- Enter details about each person involved (victim, witness, suspect, ...). Create as many persons profile as you need to.
- Scan people's ID to add all the ID's data into the FI card (name, home address, ID number, expiration date, ...). A real time saver!
- Use the physical appearance section to easily describe each person.
- Fill the contact information section to capture their phone number, email, ... in case you need to connect with them later on.
- Take photos of the persons you add to the app and add notes to each photo
VEHICLE NOTES
- Capture notes for each vehicle involved in the incident (model, make, VIN number, license plate, color, ...).
- Scan the vehicle VIN barcode or registration card to save time
FIELD INTERVIEW CARD GENERATION AND EXPORT
- Once all notes are entered, automatically generate the FI card with all the details inside
- FI Cards can be exported to your favorite app (Gmail, Yahoo mail, Outlook, Notes, ...).

The yearly membership subscription is US$19.99/year after a 1 week free trial period.

bluejetty:00024361:ios.description:

bluejetty:00022025:ios.name: MedCalX
bluejetty:00022025:ios.summary:
MedCalX is a tool that enables medical professionals to easily use complicated medical formulas, scores and classifications.
25 years of experience developing this tool for mobile platforms makes MedCalX the leading medical calculator, with
bluejetty:00022025:ios.description:
MedCalX is a tool that enables medical professionals to easily use complicated medical formulas, scores and classifications.
25 years of experience developing this tool for mobile platforms makes MedCalX the leading medical calculator, with an unparalleled user interface and powerful features.
MedCalX is free to download and use, but you have access only to a subset of formulas.
In-app purchase lets you unlock the whole range of formulas that MedCalX has to offer; more than 300 in total!
Main features:
• A very large selection (more than 300) of relevant formulas, scores, scales and classifications.
• Workflows: create your own series of formulas, text, links and images
• Many different ways to share results (and data): copy to clipboard, email report, print via AirPrint, save to patient database...
• Exclusive patient management feature for saving and accessing results, as well as images and notes. Results can be exported to the desktop as CSV files and shared between your and your colleaugues iOS devices.
• Detailed information and bibliographic references for each formula.
• Support for US and SI units, with easy switching from the keypad.
• Search for entries by name, keywords and categories.
• Takes advantage of iOS 9 – you can now use Spotlight to search for formulas
• Customizable list of favorite equations, synchronized via iCloud.
• Ability to add notes to individual formulas.
• Full support for external (hardware) keyboards
Formulas, scores and classifications include, amongst others:
• Anesthesiology (ASA, Bromage, Charlson, Cormack, Dermatome, Goldman)
• Cardiology (CC/AHA ASCVD, CHADS, EuroSCORE, GRACE, HAS-BLED, Killip, PROCAM, QT-c, TIMI)
• Electrolytes (Corrected Ca, Corrected Na, FENa, Osmolal gap)
• Evidence-Based Medicine (NNT, Odds, Sample size, Two-way table)
• ICU (ABCD2+3, APACHE, CAM-ICU, GCS, Parkland, SAPS, many PE-criteria and trauma scores)
• Neurology (AMTS, Aphasia, Canadian rules, NIHSS, WFNS)

bluejetty:00014623:ios.description:
QuickBooks helps millions of small businesses and self-employed professionals around the world manage invoicing, expense tracking, bookkeeping, and accounting on the go. 
GET MORE DONE IN LESS TIME
The QuickBooks mobile app lets you handle accounting, payments, and customers on the go.
SEE YOUR PROJECTED CASH FLOW
Check your upcoming cash flow position at a glance by running a detailed report. See where you’re headed—right from the app.
PERSONALIZED BUSINESS INSIGHTS

Create personalized automations or set up actions from a template. Simply tell Intuit Intelligence chat what you want it to do, and set a schedule as needed. [Beta]

Create professional invoices your customers can pay online right away, right from your phone. Keep work moving with voice-powered invoicing using Siri.
RECEIPTS IN A SNAP, NOT A PILE
Snap receipts, business cards and handwritten notes, and QuickBooks captures the details so your books and contacts stay up to date.
GET PAID RIGHT FROM YOUR PHONE 
Accept payments—from physical cards to digital wallets—right from your phone. Every transaction automatically syncs to QuickBooks.
AUTOMATICALLY TRACK MILES
Maximize your tax deductions with less effort. Your phone's GPS automatically tracks mileage, and you can categorize trips in a tap to stay organized.

bluejetty:00163096:ios.description:
Do you have medical questions? Do you want to be able to ask a reliable source? Stop looking for medical information on the Internet. Download mediQuo and ask a healthcare professional directly. They will provide you with a personalized and truthful opinion.
With mediQuo's medical chat, you'll be able to ask specialists in an easy and simple way through your smartphone. Being a part of the mediQuo community opens up hundreds of possibilities to manage your and your children's health from anywhere. You'll be able to chat as much as you need with doctors and specialists who will instantly answer your questions.
24-HOUR MEDICAL CHAT WITH HEALTHCARE SPECIALISTS
◉ Advantages
Doctors available 24/7
Immediate response from all medical specialists
Unlimited consultations, ask doctors as much as you need
Sending photos, videos, analyses and reports to the doctor
◉ What kind of consultations can I make?
Gynecology: pregnancy, fertility, maternity, breastfeeding, childbirth, contraception, period, vaginal infections
Pediatrics: vaccination, medication for children, baby feeding, chickenpox, measles
General Medicine: headache, fever, asthma, flu, cold, mucus, stomach pain, migraine, allergies, pharmacy, cholesterol, hypertension, diabetes, thyroid
Psychology: anxiety, stress, depression, self-esteem
Nutritionist: diets, overweight, recipes, obesity, fasting
And much more: chat with specialists in dermatology, cardiology, urology, sexology, personal trainer, or couples therapist.
◉ How does it work?
Ask your healthcare adviser online. First, they will analyze your history and symptoms in order to solve your doubts and guide you towards a personalized solution. They will then put you in contact with the different medical specialists who will give you specific recommendations on your health and well-being. Activate the Premium plan and get unlimited access to all these specialists. You can choose the day, month or year plan, depending on your needs.
◉ What will you find in mediQuo?
Medical chat
Chat with licensed doctors in different specialties. If you are looking for a dermatologist, cardiologist, gynecologist or pediatrician, you'll be able to chat with all of them. Lead a healthier life and improve your well-being. Chat with nutritionists and personal trainers to create your personalized training and diet plan. Your mental health and peace of mind are very important. Chat with an online psychologist who will guide you to better cope with your day to day life. When doctors are online, they will be marked in green, so you'll be able to make your medical questions. When they are offline, they will be marked in red, so they'll reply whenever they are online again.
Blog
Daily information on healthcare. You can find information on everything: From fertility, pregnancy, breastfeeding, baby feeding or medication for children, to detection and treatment of illnesses such as diabetes, hypothyroidism or hypertension. As well as articles related to nutrition, exercise and sport or psychology.
If you are a doctor and need to conduct consultations with your patients or mediQuo users, download the mediQuo Pro app.
DOWNLOAD MEDIQUO AND CHECK ANY MEDICAL QUESTION INSTANTLY

bluejetty:00178839:ios.name: Play 123, Alfie Atkins
bluejetty:00178839:ios.summary: Play with numbers and learn mathematics together with Alfie Atkins! Children love learning new things through play. This app, Play 123, Alfie Atkins, stimulates children’s learning skills by clearly connecting the function and purpose of nu
bluejetty:00178839:ios.description:
Play with numbers and learn mathematics together with Alfie Atkins! Children love learning new things through play. This app, Play 123, Alfie Atkins, stimulates children’s learning skills by clearly connecting the function and purpose of numbers and simple mathematical symbols in an experimental, playful way.
In his kitchen, Alfie has a recipe book with all kinds of amazing recipes that he likes cooking for himself, his family and friends. By tracing and writing the numbers on the screen, children will learn the appearance and sound of each number and train their motor skills and muscle memory. Using these numbers and simple mathematics children will then be able to cook dishes in the game that can be decorated with spices and other extras, which spawns creativity and results in many laughters as the dishes are served to Alfie and his family and friends. New decorations and recipes are unlocked as children progress in the game which motivates long-lived gameplay and enables continuous learning in a fun and pedagogic environment.
The app has been developed and tested in collaboration with teachers and students in schools in Finland and Sweden, the pedagogic parts have been developed together with researchers at the Faculty of Educational Sciences at the University of Helsinki. The app has been developed based on children's needs and does not feature points, time limits or other elements that could lead to failure or stress. Children will play and learn using the app on their own terms and at their own pace, in preschool, at school or at home.
Play and learn:
• The name and pronunciation of numbers
• The meaning and values of numbers
• To form and write numbers
• Fine motor skills and eye-hand coordination
• The basics of mathematics
• Creativity and experimenting
• To follow simple cooking recipes
The app is available in 6 different languages, and the full version allows the creation of individual profiles for multiple children.
Please note that family sharing of in-app purchases aren't supported by Apple. So if you want to purchase the full version of the app and share it with family members please purchase the separate premium, full version, of the app available on the Appstore instead.
Gro Play is an xEdu.co alumnus and member of the trade organization Swedish EdTech Industry. Gro Play collaborates with Playful Learning Center, the University of Helsinki, in the development of game-based learning. Please send your suggestions and feedback to info@groplay.com.

Solve every riddle in A Year of Riddles!

WHY PALMIST
A wealth of features awaits — unlike anything you’ll find in other apps. You’ll explore any part of your life: love, family, having children, career, business success, financial well-being, relocations, travel, and much more. By comparing every detail of your hands and analyzing the shape and direction of each palm line, Palmist gives you a clear bearing and a focused answer. Trust Palmist as a steady companion you can confide in — one that helps you find a way forward in difficult moments.
AI PALM READER
Receive daily predictions and answers to your questions. Palmist has a built-in AI that can help untangle even the most complicated situations. An exclusive AI Palm Reader feature has no equivalent on the App Store. All predictions and forecasts are guaranteed to guide you in your life.
HAND READING
Explore a complete hand reading with clear explanations for every detail. Learn what your hand type and shape suggest, how your fingers, phalanges, and fingerprints are structured, what each palm line means, and how to read the signs that appear on the lines. See how all these features connect to form a unique picture of your personality.
LIFE EVENTS
A dedicated Life Events section highlights key milestones across your personal, love/family, and professional life. You’ll find detailed predictions for many possible life events — so you can understand your potential and move forward with confidence.
BIORHYTHMS
Plan your life effectively with daily charts for your physical, sexual, intellectual, emotional, creative, intuitive, and spiritual activity levels. With Biorhythms, you can also calculate compatibility with anyone — see what you share, where you differ, and plan time together.
FIND COMPATIBLE PEOPLE
Find new friends and communicate with them thanks to the Search for Compatible People feature. Now you can find new friends, reliable business partners, or even find your love anywhere in the world. This is one of Palmist’s key goals — to help connect the most compatible people.
KEY HIGHLIGHTS
• Private chat with a professional AI palmist
• Answers to any questions
• Life event forecasts
• Detailed palm reading
• Hand map with descriptions
• Love, family, career, and money insights
• And so much more…

bluejetty:00128440:ios.description:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button in Settings under Subscriptions.
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”
Games: Users can enjoy a variety of games served in app. Games include: Sudoku, Solitaire, Jumble, Crossword, and Puzzles

bluejetty:00014784:ios.description:
Table Memo is simple memo app of spreadsheet form.
Each memo has a header of several columns, and has rows of memo.
You can add/delete columns, edit each item name, add/delete/copy/move rows of memo.
Created/edited memo can be sent by mail as CSV (with values encapsulated in double quotes) formatted data (UTF-8 encoding).
You can also use Table Memo app as simple CSV (with values encapsulated in double quotes) viewer(use iOS mail app).
How to use:
1. Create Memo
 At memo list view (first view of this app), tap add('+') button, and input the memo title.
 By tapping Edit button, you can edit memo name, delete memo, and reorder list.
2. Edit Memo data
 Select the created memo, and open memo table view.
 Tap each cell you want edit, and edit the data.
 If color mode is on, text and cell color also can be changed.
 To add new row, tap add('+') button.
 To copy or delete row, tap the row number of left side and select operation.
 By double tapping a cell, the entire contents of the cell is displayed, so you can check and copy the contents.
 At the bottom of memo table view, there are four buttons, 1) trash button, 2) action button, 3) table settings button, 4) reorder button, from left to right.
1) trash button
 You can delete current opened memo.
2) action button
 Current opened memo can be duplicated, or can be sent by mail as CSV formatted data.
3) table setting button
 Table settings view will open (see below).
4) reorder button
 By tapping this button (the reorder button changes to the edit button), memo table becomes the reorder mode, and you can reorder rows by dragging each row.
 To back to edit mode, tap the edit button.
3. Table Settings
1) Use Color switch
 If set ON, text and cell color becomes changeable.
 [[CAUTION]] If set OFF after using color, all color data will clear. 
2) MEMO TITLE section
 Select memo title and edit the title.
3) Left Inset setting
 You can adjust the space on the left side of the cell.
4) Font Size setting
 You can change the font size of the table.
5) Columns section
 To add new column, tap add('+') button.
 To delete column or reorder columns, tap Edit button.
 By selecting each ITEM of columns, column edit view will open (see below).
4. Column edit 
1) ITEM name section
 You can edit item name.
2) Column width section
 You can change column width by slider.
 By tapping the adjust button, the column width will be set to the width of existing data.
*You can also open this view by long press of header item at memo table view.
5. Settings
Tapping settings button at memo list view, SETTINGS view will open. 
You can change settings below:
1) THEME of this app
2) settings of CSV export/import
 - encoding of CSV data
 - export header
 - import 1st row as header
3) default column name and default number of columns.

bluejetty:00116962:ios.description:
Make your solitaire meaningful! Sharpen your mind while enriching your spirit... play The Official Bible Solitaire® today!
Discover a fresh take on the timeless classic solitaire, now beautifully blended with daily spiritual inspiration and Scripture. Engage in relaxing gameplay with responsive cards that glide effortlessly across your screen, offering a truly delightful gaming experience. Every hand you play brings tranquility and clarity, accompanied by uplifting Bible verses crafted to inspire your heart and enrich your spiritual journey.

• Fully Customizable Experience: Personalize your game with gorgeous card backs, peaceful backgrounds, and Night Mode cards and backgrounds for comfortable play in dim light.

Perfect for quick breaks, peaceful mornings, or restful evenings, The Official Bible Solitaire is your personal sanctuary for both relaxation and spiritual growth. Immerse yourself in meaningful gameplay that enhances your cognitive abilities while nurturing your faith.
Download The Official Bible Solitaire® now—your journey of inspiration and joyful gaming awaits!

bluejetty:00169524:ios.description:
Embark on a transformative journey today with our proven Quit Drinking Hypnosis Program and break free from the grips of alcohol forever!
By choosing to quit drinking with this program, you open the door to a plethora of positive changes in your life. Experience a rejuvenation of your health as you reclaim your energy, vitality, and increase your life expectancy. Bid farewell to stress, and revel in the benefits of younger-looking skin, fresh breath, whiter teeth, and shedding those extra pounds that often accompany excessive alcohol consumption. Your physical well-being will be revitalized, bringing a newfound confidence and vibrancy to your life.
Additionally, as you embark on this journey, anticipate a positive impact on your behavioral and professional aspects. Quitting alcohol can lead to improved focus, enhanced decision-making, and a more disciplined approach to your daily life. Say goodbye to the potential hazards of alcohol-related driving incidents and workplace issues, and welcome a renewed sense of control and responsibility.
According to numerous studies, hypnosis is recognized as one of the most effective methods for permanently changing habits and breaking free from addictions. Now, apply this powerful technique to your journey of quitting alcohol through our specialized Quit Drinking Hypnosis Program.
To truly QUIT drinking, it is essential to cultivate the belief and feeling that you are a non-drinker. Our hypnosis program enables you to delve directly into the root of the problem, facilitating a profound transformation in your beliefs and feelings about drinking.
Embark on our QUIT program now for a radical shift in your behavior, allowing you to quit drinking once and for all. Our easy-to-follow program peels back the layers, revealing how alcohol has manipulated your choices. Each hypnotic session is meticulously crafted to dismantle the various facets of your addiction, paving the way for a happier, healthier, and alcohol-free life.
While hypnosis is a potent tool, its effectiveness can be enhanced with complementary therapy or counseling sessions. Success is contingent on the user's commitment, and therefore, this series does not guarantee complete cessation of drinking for everyone.

bluejetty:00098529:ios.name: FIFA Rivals - Mobile Soccer
bluejetty:00098529:ios.summary:
PLAY FIFA: PLAY FAST, PLAY FUN
Jump into action-packed, arcade-style soccer gameplay with casual-friendly controls that make passing, shooting, and scoring effortless. Build a dream team of superstars, master football formations, refine off
bluejetty:00098529:ios.description:
PLAY FIFA: PLAY FAST, PLAY FUN
Jump into action-packed, arcade-style soccer gameplay with casual-friendly controls that make passing, shooting, and scoring effortless. Build a dream team of superstars, master football formations, refine offensive and defensive strategies, and make quick transfers with tactical depth and intuitive gameplay. Play the official FIFA experience anytime, anywhere and prepare your squad for the ultimate FIFA World Cup™ competition!
COMMAND THE ATTACK
Test your skills in turn-based soccer gameplay by strategizing key moments to score goals in unique scenarios, or dive into high-speed, real-time matches against live rivals in soccer league competitions. Train your squad for intense league battles and prepare them for FIFA World Cup™ style tournaments. Master every mode with tactical precision and lightning-fast gameplay to outplay the competition on the pitch in every match.
POWER UP WITH SUPER MODE
Turn the tide of any FIFA football match with Super Mode, an exclusive FIFA Rivals game-changing mechanic that doubles stats and unlocks special abilities like offside-immune passes and foul-free tackles. Score goals faster and crush rivals with ease. Strategically position your soccer team to activate Super Mode and unleash an unstoppable force on the pitch, securing victory over league challengers and high-stakes FIFA World Cup™ clashes.
BUILD YOUR DREAM FIFA RIVALS TEAM
Assemble your favorite FIFA superstars to build the ultimate football team in this officially licensed FIFA mobile game. Represent legendary football clubs (FC) and choose from the world’s most iconic soccer players. Customize formations to maximize their strengths, harness rival-crushing tactics, and strike your way to goal-scoring glory on the pitch. Compete in the league, perfect your FC, chase your FIFA World Cup™ dream, and become the ultimate football coach.
OWN THE PITCH (AND THE TEAM)
Collect, own, and trade exclusive limited-edition digital player items featuring legendary soccer superstars on the Pulse Market. Strengthen your team with authentic FIFA digital collectibles and seasonal items, including your boots and kits inspired by the FIFA World Cup™. You have full control to build and upgrade your ultimate dream squad and dominate league rivals on the pitch.
LIVE THE ACTION WITH REAL-TIME TOURNAMENTS
Test your skills in real-time PVP matches against players around the world. Compete in esports-centric competitions, special live events tied to real-life football events, and global tournaments leading up to the FIFA World Cup 26™. Face off against league rivals, represent your club, and climb the worldwide leaderboards to prove you’re the ultimate football coach!
RELIVE THE GLORY WITH FIFA WORLD CUP™ LEGACY MODE
Step back in time and relive or redeem the greatest FIFA World Cup™ tournaments. Select a FIFA World Cup™ year (2010, 2014, 2018, 2022), choose your nation, and take the pitch with that tournament's iconic squad featuring legendary players, kits, and unforgettable moments. Battle through each round of the bracket, from the group stage to the Final, to become a FIFA World Cup™ champion. Complete the journey and earn Legacy Players, historic FIFA World Cup™ legends you can bring back into your PvP squad to build a team that spans generations.
