bluejetty:00050147:android.description:
Title: BBC Arabic: breaking news from around the world
Local and international news from BBC Arabic
Catch up on the latest news from BBC Arabic and its global network of journalists. We provide you with the latest news and developments from Egypt, Sudan, Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Iraq and many other countries around the world.
Global news and sports at your fingertips
BBC Arabic News is categorized into: Latest News, Middle East, World News, Economy and Business, Science and Technology. Stay up-to-date with the news of the day through photo galleries, as well as video content and various articles.
Do not miss important news and use the feature to set the application according to your interests, whether it is breaking news or the latest reports and topics .. You can also share news stories on social networking sites to keep others informed of world news.
BBC Arabic application features
The BBC Arabic application offers you:
The latest global news and headlines.
Live news coverage.
Articles and Analytics
Video and audio content.
Watch live TV broadcasts
Listen to the live radio broadcast.
BBC Fact Check Unit reports
Share news via email and social media sites such as Facebook and Twitter
Set the text sizes according to your preference
The ability to update the content to display the latest important news for you
Application notifications
If you choose to receive notifications, your device will be stored with Airship on behalf of the BBC in order to provide you with this service.
It will not ask you for any personal information (such as your name and email). The BBC will take into account the security of your phone data and will not share it with any third party, in accordance with the Foundation's privacy protection policy, which can be found here: http://www.bbc.co.uk/privacy.
You can stop receiving notifications from the BBC News Service by adjusting the notification options on your device.
Help guide from BBC Arabic
http://www.bbc.com/arabic/institutional-40510622
Downloading this application means that you agree to the BBC's terms of use
https://www.bbc.co.uk/usingthebbc/your-data-matters/

1.Enter your time.

Timesheet Plus replaces the paper based or excel timesheet to create your weekly timesheet in one simple process.
Simply select Date and Client -> Enter Billable Hours -> Sign -> Send timesheet as PDF.
**Please Note - Free download is for EVALUATION and limited to 3 time sheets. 
To subscribe In-App 12, month auto renewing subscription is available. Read below for more details.
Features include:
• Multiple Clients, Projects.
• Set the default day when week starts.
• Default start, end & time interval i.e 1, 15, 20 minutes etc.. makes entry easier.
• Standard and overtime hours.
• Auto overtime calculation.
• Easy time selection using date picker.
• Custom logo from device photo library.
• Sign and send timesheet as PDF email attachment.
• Dual sign off for you and your manager.
• Sync to device Calendar (iCal).
• Export weekly totals history as CSV.
• Flag timesheets as sent/paid.

bluejetty:00016528:ios.description:
The original Hidden Camera Detector — featured by Forbes, Fox, and Yahoo News.
Checking into a hotel, rental, or Airbnb? Using a changing room, restroom, or office? Hidden Camera Detector helps you check your surroundings for hidden cameras, trackers, and suspicious devices using multiple detection methods in one easy app.
Scan again wherever you go to see if the same trackers or devices keep appearing with you over time.
Try every detection method before deciding if Pro is right for you.
Built on patented detection technology developed across our consumer and enterprise security products, Hidden Camera Detector brings multiple detection methods together in one consumer app.
BLUETOOTH & TRACKER SCAN
Find nearby Bluetooth devices and supported trackers. Many devices are identified by name, and live signal strength helps you physically locate them.
NETWORK / WI-FI SCAN
Scan your local network for connected devices. Hidden Camera Detector now identifies many devices by name and type, making unfamiliar cameras and other devices easier to recognize and investigate.
AI IMAGE RECOGNITION
Take a photo of a suspicious object and our AI compares it with known spy cameras, returning similar images, links, and descriptions.
LENS & IR REFLECTION DETECTOR
Scan the space around you live for reflections that may come from a camera lens using our classic lens-detection technology.
EXPERT VIDEO GUIDES — FREE
Watch security professionals show where hidden cameras are commonly concealed, along with quick demonstrations of the detection methods.
WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE HIDDEN CAMERA DETECTOR
• Scan again over time to see if the same devices keep appearing with you
• The original hidden camera detector app, built on patented detection technology and with over 2 million downloads
• Featured by Forbes, Fox, and Yahoo News
• Multiple detection methods — network device identification, Bluetooth and tracker locating, AI photo recognition, and live lens reflection scanning
• Many network and Bluetooth devices identified by name
• Live signal strength helps you locate nearby Bluetooth devices and supported trackers
• Simple enough for anyone — at home, traveling, or on the go
No app can guarantee it will find every hidden device, but Hidden Camera Detector gives you multiple practical ways to check a space and investigate suspicious devices with greater confidence.
SUBSCRIPTION
Hidden Camera Detector offers an auto-renewable subscription that unlocks full access to every detection tool. Both plans start with 3 days free — cancel anytime before they end and you won't be charged. Monthly and yearly plans are available; pricing is shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Service: https://www.hcdapp.com/tos.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.hcdapp.com/privacypolicy.html

bluejetty:00148276:ios.description:
Congratulations, you've passed the exams with excellent marks along with the hidden object games, so welcome to the Academy of Monster Hunters! It is your first day here, but things are already going haywire! In these detective games, it’s a trial by fire when a mysterious masked man declares war on Monster Hunters Academy on your first day! Dangerous monsters roam the halls, and nobody is safe, not even your mother, Professor Helen Lyngren. But who is this masked madman, and what caused his hatred of spirits and those who cooperate with them? Learn that in the new mystery adventure games Spirit Legends: Time for Change Collector’s Edition!
· SAVE EVERYONE FROM AN ANCIENT EVIL IN THE BONUS GAME!
It’s your first mission of the Monster Hunters Order of the mystery games! You don’t even have your own Bestiary yet, so it’ll be a test of your courage and wit! 
· DECORATE THE HEAD OF THE ACADEMY’S STUDY!
Find all the sapphires to furnish the study of the Monster Hunters Academy Head with the beautiful and useful items. In these hidden object adventure games, she’ll be really excited!
· EXAMINE SPECIAL MAGICAL INVENTIONS AND COLLECT GEODES TO LEARN ABOUT THE SPIRITS!
Learn more about the spirits and their relations. Find hidden pictures. Among them you’ll find those you met before! And in this hide & seek game the unusual magic devices will tell you how exactly humans and spirits collaborate with each other.
· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE WALLPAPERS, VIDEOS, CONCEPT ART, AND MORE!
Replay your favorite search & find games with hidden pictures and puzzles, download wallpapers and concept arts and enjoy many other bonuses, which you won’t have in a standard version!
· NEVER GET LOST WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
A helpful and useful Strategy Guide will always show you your next move and give advice while playing hidden objects.
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

Why Play Stickmen FightTuber?
-Quick & Fun: Perfect for short or long play sessions.
-Challenging: The more you play, the harder it gets!
-Rhythmic Action: Perfect for music lovers—fight while jamming out to awesome tunes!
Download Stickmen FightTuber now for endless, addictive fun!

bluejetty:00064713:ios.description:
New to our app?
The Co-operative Bank mobile banking app is designed to keep things simple & secure, helping you complete your everyday banking tasks quickly.
Benefits
• Access & manage your finances anywhere, at any time
• Quick & secure money transfers between your accounts & other people
• Search your transactions & view your pending payments to find your incomings & outgoings
Key features
Enjoy secure, convenient & efficient banking at your fingertips
• Quick & secure login with TouchID, FaceID or passnumber
• Browse & search transactions on your current, savings & loan accounts
• View your pending payments
• Create & pay new payees
• Pay, view & delete your saved payees
• Transfer money between your accounts (including to your credit card)
• View & delete your scheduled payments
• Freeze and unfreeze your card securely 24/7 for extra peace of mind or if you’ve temporarily misplaced your card
• View up to seven years of statements for current accounts, savings, ISAs & loans
• Use our easy to navigate account dashboard to help to you with your daily banking tasks
• Update your email address & phone number
• Share your account details with your contacts 
• Switch your current account to us & access exclusive savings accounts
• Use our mortgage calculator to check how quickly you could pay off your mortgage & how much interest you could save
• Apply for some products directly
• Find answers to your questions quickly on our help page
Fraud protection
The app also gives you additional protection from fraud. This is because we alert you of any account changes such as new device registration & if there are a change of details. 
We also have a fraud hub with a wide range of educational resources to help protect you from fraud.
Make sure you always install the latest update to get the latest improvements & security measures.
Logging in
You’ll need your online banking username, password & 6-digit security code to log in.
If you’re not registered for online banking, you can either do this by tapping 'Register for online banking' in the app, or register for online banking on our website.
Device compatibility
For security reasons, you’ll need to be using iOS 15 or above. You also will not be able to use the app if your device is jailbroken.
If you are not able to update, you can log into online banking to access your accounts.
Terms of use
We collect non-personal user data to monitor how well the app works. For example, measuring how long you spend on a particular screen. We collect a limited amount of personal data to allow you to use the app, for fraud prevention purposes & to help us to fix problems & improve the app for everyone. Everyone is opted in to this feature. If you do not want us to process your personal data in this way, please delete the app. If you download the app, you consent to sharing how you use it. Find out more about how we use this in our Privacy Policy, available within the app.
Important information
We will not charge you for downloading or using the app. However, your mobile network provider may charge you for data use, depending on your tariff or contract. Contact your operator for details. You may also use this service when connected to a Wi-Fi network.
Apple, Touch ID & FaceID are trademarks of Apple Inc. registered in the US & other countries.
The Co-operative Bank p.l.c. is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority (Financial Services Register No: 121885). Registered office: 1 Balloon Street, Manchester, M4 4BE. Registered in England and Wales (Company No: 990937).
Credit facilities are provided by The Co-operative Bank p.l.c. & are subject to status & our lending policy. The Bank reserves the right to decline any application for an account or credit facility.

bluejetty:00121656:ios.description:
Minesweeper Puzzle Bomb is the sequel to the classic retro PC game, bringing the nostalgic game you know and love to your mobile phone. The game is simple: use strategy and logic to avoid the bombs to clear the minefield. Challenge yourself and use the custom board builder to create your own puzzles. Track progress and game stats to beat your own times & scores.
If you like old classic games like chess, checkers, backgammon, solitaire, freecell, and classic puzzle games like sudoku, tetris, and crossword puzzles then this game is for you.
How to Play: Start with a covered mine field of square tiles and clear the field by tapping one square at a time. Beneath each tile is either a number to indicate how many mines are touching the tile, a blank space, or a mine that will explode when tapped. Use strategy and logic to navigate the mine map and win the game!
Features:
High Score leaderboard for each difficulty setting
Stats tracking to monitor your progress
Select level of difficulty: Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert, or Chaos
Customize your game for an even greater challenge
Flag Mode: Mark tiles you think are bombs
Easy to use interface, smooth gaming experience
Pinch to zoom
Use hints to reveal the location of a single bomb
Thanks for playing Minesweeper Puzzle Bomb! Have questions or feedback? Email us at contact@maplemedia.io for fast & friendly support.

bluejetty:00124367:ios.description:
Never get caught off guard by the weather
With Weather & Radar, you see the weather at a glance — with one WeatherRadar that brings rain, clouds, sun, lightning, fog, and temperature together on one map.
Wondering if rain is moving in, the sun will break through, or a thunderstorm is building nearby?
WeatherRadar shows how sun, rain, clouds, fog, thunderstorms, lightning, and temperature are developing now, over the next few hours, and up to 4 days ahead: minute by minute for short-term changes, for your local forecast in the US and around the world.
Your weather for everyday life, travel, and plans
• Weather for every plan: drive to work, walk the dog, go for a jog, take the kids to the park, camp, hike, fish, or plan a BBQ.
• Watch live as rain, storm cells, clouds, lightning, fog, and wind develop, where they are moving, and what that means for outdoor plans — from pop-up thunderstorms to hurricane-season weather.
• The 14-day weather forecast and daily forecasts help you plan outdoor activities, road trips, vacations, and game day weather.
Everything you need at a glance
From RainRadar and free 4-day WeatherRadar to temperature, wind speed, lightning tracker, UV index, and air quality index (AQI) — everything is clear, current, and easy to understand. The AQI view focuses on how pollution may affect your health. With the weather widget, you can bring your local weather, current weather, weather today, and daily forecast straight to your Home Screen.
We keep you updated
We monitor the weather around you and send weather alerts when a change matters for your day: severe storm alerts, thunderstorms, first snow, extreme heat, strong wind, or other significant conditions. No hype, no panic — just clear updates from our meteorologists so you know what is happening and what to consider next.
Forecasts, observations, webcams
For everyday planning and weather enthusiasts alike: get details for temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, rainfall amounts, and hours of sunshine. Check weather webcams, water temperatures where available, moon phases, and mountain weather and popular US ski regions with snow forecast and slope data for popular regions. 
You can also record and share videos of interesting weather near you with the Weather & Radar community. 
One look and you know what’s coming
No guessing, no complicated menus, no digging through layers — just local weather, live radar view that updates in real time and forecast information on your app home screen and in WeatherRadar.
Open the app and see what is happening outside right away. Now, in the next few minutes, and up to 14 days ahead.
Go Ad-Free
Use the weather app free of advertising with the in-app purchase and personalize your main page!
Terms of Use
Weather & Radar Ad-free is a subscription service that will be renewed on either a monthly or a yearly basis. Payment for the subscription will be charged to the user’s Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The user’s Apple account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Apple will identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of the Weather & Radar Ad-free, free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription thereof.
Terms and Conditions: http://www.weatherandradar.com/ios/terms-of-use/
Send your questions and feedback to info@weatherandradar.com
Weather & Radar. Your clear view of the weather.

bluejetty:00186162:ios.description:
An app for learning world geography in a game format. Learn countries and their location on the map, memorize capitals, flags and coats of arms, take quizzes, compete with friends and other players, and explore detailed statistics for each country.
World geography:
Countries of the world, their location on the map, capitals, flags and coats of arms in a convenient game format.
Detailed country information:
Population, languages, currency, GDP and over 30 other economic and social indicators for each country.
Data trends and comparison:
See how indicators have changed over different time periods and compare countries side by side right on the map.
Multiplayer:
Compete with friends or other players and test your knowledge in matches with real opponents.

Study not only the world political map but also maps of seas and oceans, rivers, mountains, country regions and historical periods.
Regional maps:
Study US states, Canadian provinces and territories, Mexican states and dozens of other regional maps.
Historical maps:
Explore world maps from different eras, including World War I, World War II and other historical periods.
Quiz modes:
Choose from many game modes and practice your knowledge in different formats.
Achievements and ranking:
Earn achievements, track your progress and climb the player rankings.
Customization:
Change the map style, adjust colors and choose a light or dark theme.
StudyGe. A convenient way to learn geography, explore countries in depth, compare data and compete with other players.

bluejetty:00139967:ios.description:
A Winning Tradition game.
Pro Football Coach 27 is a pro football GM and head coach sim. Take over a franchise, draft future stars, win free agency auctions, trade under the salary cap and call the plays on game day as you build a football dynasty across a 30-year coaching career.
BUILD THROUGH THE FOOTBALL DRAFT
• Scout prospects at the combine and on scouting missions
• See each prospect's overall, potential and gem or bust odds
• Follow three mock drafts as the media reads each prospect
• Run a live 7-round draft, then look back on every class in Draft History
RUN YOUR FRANCHISE AS GENERAL MANAGER
• Bid against rival teams in live free agency auctions
• Re-sign your core, extend contracts and use the franchise tag
• Manage a $205M salary cap and dead money
• Trade with every team, take offers and beat the trade deadline
• Keep a 16-player practice squad and call players up on game day
CALL THE PLAYS AS HEAD COACH
• Watch every snap of the football sim play out on the field
• Call plays on key downs, on offense, or on both sides of the ball, or let your coordinators call them
• 6 offensive and 4 defensive playbooks for real football strategy
COACH YOUR WAY
• Pick your offensive and defensive philosophy and sign players who fit it
• Hire coordinators, each with their own traits
• Earn 13 coach perks as your head coach levels up
• Take the phone calls: a star who wants out, a diva in trouble, a rival after your coordinator
• Run training camp and In-Season Training to develop your roster
• Follow every player you drafted, traded, released or lost in the Player Tracker
BUILD A FOOTBALL DYNASTY
• 32 teams in 2 conferences and 8 divisions, a 17-game division schedule and 7 playoff seeds per conference
• Division titles, the all-star game, awards, a Hall of Fame, league and team record books, milestones and history
• Job offers from other teams, and the hot seat when you lose
CREATION SUITE
• Edit players, teams, coaches and conferences, with your own logos and colors
• Build a custom league
• Export and import rosters and draft classes, and import draft classes from College Football Coach 27
Made for fans of football GM games, American football manager games and deep football franchise sims with a true franchise mode.
Sign in to save your career to the cloud and climb the global coaching rankings.

Run and monitor Xcode Cloud builds from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
Start workflows, track build progress, investigate failures, and download artifacts without opening App Store Connect in a browser.
YOUR BUILDS, AT A GLANCE
• Browse products, workflows, and build history
• Start regular or clean builds
• Rerun completed builds from the same source revision
• Follow pending and running builds with automatic refresh while you view them
• Inspect errors, warnings, test failures, and individual action results
• Review commit details and build actions
• Download and share logs, result bundles, archives, and other artifacts
START FREE
Connect one App Store Connect account and use core features for free. Subscribe to see all results in a single view, connect multiple accounts, and support ongoing development.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
XCRunway connects directly to the official App Store Connect API. Your API credentials are stored locally in the Keychain with device-only protection and aren’t synced between devices.
TRY IT BEFORE CONNECTING
Explore the built-in demo with sample data. When you’re ready, connect using an App Store Connect API key with access to your Xcode Cloud workflows.
